title.en: At least 27 dead and hundreds evacuated after strike on Kyiv warehouse
title.zh: 基辅仓库遭袭至少27人死亡，数百人被疏散

summary.en: A Russian strike hit a warehouse near Kyiv, Ukraine, causing a fire and explosions. At least 27 people were killed and nearly 400 evacuated. An investigation is underway to determine if ammunition was stored at the site. Separately, a 14-year-old was killed in another attack in the Boryspil district.
summary.zh: 俄罗斯的一次袭击击中乌克兰基辅附近的一个仓库，引发火灾和爆炸。至少有27人死亡，近400人被疏散。目前正在进行调查，以确定该地点是否储存了弹药。此外，在鲍里斯皮尔区另一次袭击中，一名14岁的男孩丧生。

body.en:
Twenty-seven people have been killed and almost 400 evacuated after a Russian strike hit a warehouse near Kyiv, triggering a fire and a series of explosions.

Regional governor Tymur Tkachenko said a further 42 people, including four children, were injured after the Russian drone strike in the Bucha district.

An investigation has been launched into whether ammunition was being stored at the site, where search and rescue operations were ongoing early on Saturday.

Meanwhile, Tkachenko said a 14-year-old was killed in a separate attack in the Boryspil district as President Volodymyr Zelensky reported overnight strikes across several regions.

In Russia, local officials say two people have been killed and 21 injured in strikes in the Belgorod and Rostov regions in the past 24 hours.

President Volodymyr Zelensky expressed his condolences to the families of the victims of the warehouse strike, saying that more than 300 emergency respondents had been deployed to the strike area.

He said an investigation into potential negligence had begun, writing on X: "The regulations are clear: ammunition must not be stored near houses or other residential buildings. Appropriate conclusions will certainly be drawn."

Russia's Ministry of Defence said in a statement that its forces had targeted "an ammunition depot" in the Kyiv region village of Myla, which stores "components and launch boosters for FP-1/FP-2 long-range unmanned aerial vehicles".

Zelensky also reported further overnight strikes in the regions of Odesa, Dnipropetrovsk, Sumy and Zaporizhzhia.

"Ukraine cannot be alone in finding solutions to protect against such strikes, and I thank everyone who helps with additional support packages and sanctions against Russia," he wrote on Telegram.

The Ukrainian army said it had shot down 233 Russia unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) overnight into Saturday.

Russia and Ukraine have been intensifying their attacks in recent months, with Kyiv focusing its operations on Russian economic targets.

Russian online retailer Ozon said one of its logistic centres had been hit in an overnight Ukrainian drone strike.

It said it had also suspended operations at a second logistics centre and evacuate staff "due to the danger in the area".

The retailer's facilities in Krasnodar, Dagestan, Stavropol and Adygea were targeted in strikes earlier this week, resulting in several injuries and widespread damage.

Ukraine has for weeks struck sites belonging to Wildberries, the country's biggest online retailer, describing the firm as a legitimate target because it supplied components to the military, which Moscow denies.
body.zh: 俄罗斯袭击基辅附近的一座仓库，引发火灾和一系列爆炸，造成 27 人死亡，近 400 人被疏散。 地区州长泰穆尔·特卡琴科 (Tymur Tkachenko) 表示，俄罗斯无人机袭击布查区后，另有 42 人受伤，其中包括 4 名儿童。 目前已对现场是否存放弹药展开调查，周六早些时候，搜救行动正在进行中。 与此同时，特卡琴科表示，一名 14 岁的青少年在鲍里斯波尔地区的另一起袭击中丧生，总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基报告称，多个地区发生夜间袭击。 俄罗斯当地官员称，过去24小时内别尔哥罗德和罗斯托夫地区的罢工已造成两人死亡、21人受伤。 泽连斯基总统向仓库罢工遇难者家属表示哀悼，并表示已向罢工地区部署了300多名紧急救援人员。 他说，对潜在疏忽的调查已经开始，并在X上写道：“规定很明确：弹药不得存放在房屋或其他住宅楼附近。肯定会得出适当的结论。” 俄罗斯国防部在一份声明中表示，俄罗斯军队袭击了基辅地区米拉村的“一个弹药库”，该弹药库储存“FP-1/FP-2远程无人机的组件和发射助推器”。 泽连斯基还报告称，敖德萨、第聂伯罗彼得罗夫斯克、苏梅和扎波罗热地区发生了进一步的夜间罢工。 他在 Telegram 上写道：“乌克兰不能独自寻找解决方案来防范此类袭击，我感谢所有提供额外支持计划和对俄罗斯实施制裁的人。” 乌克兰军方表示，截至周六夜间，已击落 233 架俄罗斯无人机。 近几个月来，俄罗斯和乌克兰不断加强攻击，基辅的攻击重点是俄罗斯的经济目标。 俄罗斯在线零售商 Ozon 表示，其一个物流中心在乌克兰夜间的无人机袭击中遭到袭击。 该公司表示，“由于该地区存在危险”，该公司还暂停了第二个物流中心的运营并疏散了员工。 该零售商位于克拉斯诺达尔、达吉斯坦、斯塔夫罗波尔和阿迪格的工厂本周早些时候成为罢工目标，造成多人受伤和大面积损坏。 乌克兰几周来一直在攻击该国最大在线零售商 Wildberry 的网站，称该公司是合法目标，因为它向军方提供零部件，但莫斯科对此予以否认。

reflection.en: The news from Kyiv paints a grim picture of war's indiscriminate destruction, where a strike on a warehouse results in the deaths of civilians and the displacement of hundreds. In such moments, when the instruments of war seem to multiply and rage, the prophetic vision of Psalm 46:9 offers a profound hope: that Yahweh will ultimately put an end to all...
reflection.zh: 来自基辅的新闻描绘了一幅战争无差别毁灭的严峻图景，一个仓库的袭击导致平民死亡，数百人流离失所。在这样的时刻，当战争的工具似乎不断增多并肆虐时，诗篇46:9的预言性愿景提供了一种深刻的希望：雅伟终将平息一切冲突，将武器变为和平的工具。

verse.textEn: He makes wars cease to the ends of the earth; he breaks the bow and shatters the spear.
verse.textZh: 他止息刀兵，直到地极；他折弓断枪。

title.en: Nepal-Tibet floods: number of missing climbs to nearly 3,000 as search for survivors enters fourth day – latest updates
title.zh: 尼泊尔-西藏洪水：失踪人数接近3000人，搜救幸存者进入第四天——最新消息

summary.en: The number of missing in the Nepal-Tibet floods has risen to nearly 3,000 as the search for survivors enters its fourth day. A Nepali minister stated that rebuilding costs are likely to run into billions of dollars, while the death toll has reached 626, with seven confirmed deaths in Tibet. Survivors are grieving for...
summary.zh: 尼泊尔-西藏洪水失踪人数已升至近3000人，搜救幸存者进入第四天。一位尼泊尔部长表示，重建费用可能高达数十亿美元，死亡人数已升至626人，另有7人在西藏确认死亡。幸存者们为被洪水冲走的亲人和家园悲痛不已，救援人员在边境口岸只发现了废墟。

body.en: Nepali minister says cost of rebuilding likely to be billions of dollars as death toll rises to 626, with seven confirmed dead in Tibet ‘The flood took everything I have’: survivors grieve for relatives and homes swept away in Nepal Chinese rescuers find ‘nothing but ruins’ at border crossing as Nepal seeks help to ID and store the dead Outside the army camp in the Nuwakot district of Nepal, people run their fingers down the sheets of paper pinned to the wall, scanning the growing list of those reported missing for news of loved ones. Nepali authorities said nearly 3,000 people are missing, while China reported more than 550 people unaccounted for. Nepal’s foreign minister, Shisir Khanal, has appealed for international support to help rebuild the country after the floods, saying reconstruction efforts could run into “billions of dollars” AFP reports. Continue reading...
body.zh: 尼泊尔部长表示，西藏死亡人数上升至 626 人，其中 7 人确认死亡，重建费用可能达数十亿美元 “洪水夺走了我所拥有的一切”：幸存者为在尼泊尔被冲走的亲人和家园感到悲痛 中国救援人员在边境口岸发现“除了废墟之外什么也没有”失踪亲人的消息。尼泊尔当局称有近3000人失踪，而中国则报告有超过550人下落不明。尼泊尔外交部长希西尔·卡纳尔呼吁国际社会提供支持，帮助该国在洪灾后重建，据法新社报道称，重建工作可能需要“数十亿美元”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The devastating floods in Nepal and Tibet have left a trail of destruction, with thousands missing and the immense task of rebuilding ahead. Amidst such widespread loss, the prophet Jeremiah reminds us that Yahweh's mercies are new every morning. Even in the face of overwhelming devastation, there is a persistent, enduring hope found in divine faithfulness.
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔和西藏的毁灭性洪水留下了满目疮痍，数千人失踪，重建家园的任务艰巨。面对如此广泛的损失，先知耶利米提醒我们，雅伟的慈爱每早都是新的。即使面对压倒性的毁灭，在神的信实中仍有持久的盼望。

verse.textEn: Because of Yahweh's great love we are not consumed, for his compassions never fail. They are new every morning.
verse.textZh: 我们不至消灭，是出于雅伟诸般的慈爱；是因他的怜悯不至断绝。每早晨这都是新的。

title.en: They laid down arms. Now ex-guerrillas in Colombia fear fate under new hardline president
title.zh: 哥伦比亚前游击队员放下武器，现在却担心在新强硬派总统的统治下的命运

summary.en: The previous government's 'Total Peace' plan resulted in only 99 out of Colombia's 30,000 armed combatants disarming. The new president, Abelardo De la Espriella, opposes peace agreements. In mid-June, 99 guerrilla fighters were flown to a rural settlement where they handed over their weapons, marking the start of a...
summary.zh: 前政府的“全面和平”计划仅促使哥伦比亚 30,000 名武装战斗人员中的 99 人解除武装。新总统阿韦拉尔多·德拉埃斯普里耶拉反对和平协议。六月中旬，99 名游击队员被直升机送往南部农村的一个小定居点，他们在那里放下武器，标志着他们摆脱持续了六十年的、已造成近 50 万人死亡的武装冲突，开始新生活。

body.en: ‘Total peace’ plan of previous government led only 99 of Colombia’s 30,000 armed combatants to disarm, but new president Abelardo De la Espriella opposes peace agreements In mid-June, 99 guerrilla fighters were flown by helicopter to a small settlement in a rural area of southern Colombia where they lined up and, one by one, handed their weapons to government officials: rifles, pistols, machine guns and grenade launchers. They also stripped off their heavy tactical vests, field packs and camouflage uniforms, which were each piled into a bonfire to mark the beginning of a new life away from an armed conflict that has claimed nearly half a million lives in the last six decades. Continue reading...
body.zh: 上届政府的“全面和平”计划仅导致哥伦比亚3万名武装战斗人员中的99人解除武装，但新总统阿韦拉多·德拉埃斯普里埃拉反对和平协议。6月中旬，99名游击队员乘直升机飞往哥伦比亚南部农村地区的一个小定居点，在那里他们排成一排，将武器一一递给政府官员：步枪、手枪、机枪和榴弹发射器。他们还脱下沉重的战术背心、野战包和迷彩服，将它们全部堆放在篝火中，以标志着远离武装冲突的新生活的开始，这场武装冲突在过去的六十年中夺走了近五十万人的生命。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In a rural settlement in Colombia, 99 former combatants symbolically laid down their arms, marking a transition from conflict to a new life. This act of disarmament echoes the ancient vision of nations beating their swords into plowshares, a profound hope for peace amidst ongoing struggles. May this gesture of relinquishing weapons inspire further steps...
reflection.zh: 在哥伦比亚的一个乡村定居点，99 名前战斗人员象征性地放下了武器，标志着他们从冲突转向新生活的过渡。这一解除武装的行为呼应了古代将刀剑打成犁头的异象，是在持续斗争中对和平的深刻希望。 愿这一放下武器的举动能激励更多走向持久和平的步伐，不仅是为了这些个人，也是为了整个哥伦比亚。

verse.textEn: They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks.
verse.textZh: 他们要将刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀。

title.en: Chinese rescuers find ‘nothing but ruins’ at border crossing as Nepal seeks help to ID and store the dead
title.zh: 中国救援人员在边境口岸发现“一片废墟”，尼泊尔寻求帮助辨认和安葬死者

summary.en: A Chinese rescue team reached the heavily damaged Gyirong border crossing complex in the Himalayas and found only ruins. This follows devastating flash floods that hit the Nepal-Tibet region, prompting ongoing search and rescue operations and efforts by Nepal to identify and store the deceased.
summary.zh: 中国救援队抵达喜马拉雅山脉受损严重的吉隆边境口岸综合体，发现那里已成一片废墟。此前，尼泊尔-西藏地区遭受了毁灭性的洪水袭击，搜救行动仍在进行，尼泊尔正努力辨认和安葬死者。

body.en: Nepal and China continue arduous search and rescue operations in flood-hit Himalayas Visual guide: how the deadly flooding unfolded Nepal-Tibet flash flood – latest updates A Chinese rescue team has reached the all-but-obliterated Gyirong border crossing complex for the first time and found “nothing but ruins” as Nepal and China continue their arduous rescue operations in the flood-hit Himalayas. Surveillance camera footage from the worst-hit Gyirong border crossing complex showed huge torrents of water and debris on Wednesday engulfing buildings and people trying to flee. Only ⁠on Friday were rescuers able to reach the area. Continue reading...
body.zh: 尼泊尔和中国在遭受洪水袭击的喜马拉雅山地区继续开展艰巨的搜救行动 视觉指南：致命洪水是如何展开的 尼泊尔-西藏山洪暴发——最新消息 随着尼泊尔和中国在遭受洪水袭击的喜马拉雅山地区继续开展艰巨的救援行动，中国救援队首次抵达几乎被摧毁的吉隆边境口岸综合体，发现“除了废墟之外什么也没有”。受灾最严重的吉隆边境口岸综合体的监控录像显示，周三，巨大的水流和碎片吞没了建筑物和试图逃离的人们。直到周五救援人员才抵达该地区。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The devastation at the Gyirong border crossing, where a Chinese rescue team found 'nothing but ruins,' speaks to the profound grief and loss that natural disasters inflict. In the face of such destruction and the immense task of identifying the dead, we can hold onto the divine promise of a future where all suffering is ended. Yahweh's ultimate plan is one...
reflection.zh: 吉隆边境口岸的毁灭景象，中国救援队在那里发现“一片废墟”，揭示了自然灾害所带来的深重悲痛与损失。面对如此的破坏以及辨认死者的艰巨任务，我们可以抓住神圣的应许，那是一个所有痛苦都将终结的未来。雅伟最终的计划是完全的修复，届时将不再有眼泪和痛苦。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: Man, 41, dies after large sign falls at Christian festival in West Sussex
title.zh: 西萨塞克斯郡基督教音乐节大型标牌倒塌，一名41岁男子身亡

summary.en: A 41-year-old man from Eastbourne died and six others were hospitalized after a large sign fell at the Big Church festival near Steyning in West Sussex. Police are investigating the incident, which occurred on Friday afternoon, and are providing support to the victim's family.
summary.zh: 在西萨塞克斯郡斯泰宁附近的“大教堂”（Big Church）音乐节上，一个大型标牌倒塌，导致一名来自东本的41岁男子死亡，另有至少六人受伤送医。警方表示，这起不幸事件发生在周五下午，目前正在为死者家属提供支持并调查事故原因。

body.en:
A 41-year-old man has died and at least six other people have been injured after a large sign fell at a Christian festival in West Sussex , police have said.

The man, from Eastbourne, East Sussex, was pronounced dead at the scene after the incident at the Big Church festival near Steyning on Friday afternoon.

His next of kin have been told and are being supported by specialist officers, Sussex police said. The force added that at least six other people had been taken to hospital for treatment.

DCS Richard McDonagh said: “This is a tragic incident and our thoughts go out to the man’s family and friends at this incredibly difficult time.”

Anyone with any information or relevant video footage has been asked to contact police.

In a post on Instagram shortly after 5.30pm, organisers told attenders that the show had been cancelled and all day visitors “must leave the site now”.

Organisers later said they had decided to cancel the rest of the festival, which had been scheduled to run until Sunday. “We are devastated by the serious incident that took place at Big Church festival 2026 today, in which a sign fell, injuring at least seven people, one of whom tragically lost their life,” the festival said in an online statement.

“First and foremost, all of our thoughts are with those who have been affected, their families and friends, and everyone who witnessed what happened.

“Following today’s incident, we have made the decision to bring Big Church festival 2026 to a close.”

Officers remained at the scene on Friday night and people were advised to avoid the area.

The incident has been reported to the Health and Safety Executive and local authority, Sussex police said.

McDonagh added: “I recognise the immense distress this will have caused people at the festival, and we are working with a number of partners as we seek to establish exactly what happened.

“We know there were thousands of people at the festival and we’re urging anyone with any information, or any relevant video footage, to please come forward.”
body.zh: 警方称，西萨塞克斯郡一个基督教节日的一块大标牌掉落后，一名 41 岁男子死亡，至少六人受伤。 周五下午，该男子来自东萨塞克斯郡伊斯特本，在斯泰宁附近的大教堂节日发生事件后，被宣布当场死亡。 苏塞克斯警方表示，他的近亲已被告知并得到了专业官员的支持。警方补充说，至少还有六人被送往医院接受治疗。 DCS 理查德·麦克唐纳 (Richard McDonagh) 表示：“这是一起悲惨事件，在这个极其困难的时刻，我们向该男子的家人和朋友表示慰问。” 任何有任何信息或相关视频片段的人都被要求与警方联系。 下午 5 点 30 分后不久，组织者在 Instagram 上发布了一条帖子，告诉与会者演出已被取消，全天参观者“现在必须离开现场”。 组织者后来表示，他们决定取消原定于周日举行的音乐节剩余活动。该节日在一份在线声明中表示：“我们对今天 2026 年大教堂节发生的严重事件感到震惊，其中一块标牌掉落，造成至少七人受伤，其中一人不幸丧生。” “首先，我们所有的想法都与那些受到影响的人、他们的家人和朋友以及目睹所发生事件的每个人同在。 “在今天的事件发生后，我们决定结束 2026 年大教堂节。” 周五晚上，警察仍留在现场，并建议人们避开该地区。 苏塞克斯警方表示，该事件已报告给健康与安全执行局和地方当局。 麦克唐纳补充道：“我认识到这会给音乐节上的人们带来巨大的痛苦，我们正在与许多合作伙伴合作，力求查明到底发生了什么。 “我们知道有数千人参加了音乐节，我们敦促任何有任何信息或相关视频片段的人挺身而出。”

reflection.en: The sudden loss of life at a festival intended for worship and fellowship brings a heavy silence to the community. In moments of such unexpected tragedy, we are reminded that faith does not exempt us from the sting of death, but provides a Savior who weeps alongside us. We pray for the family of the man from Eastbourne and for the recovery of those injured...
reflection.zh: 在一个旨在敬拜和团契的节日里，生命的突然逝去给整个群体带来了沉重的静默。在这样突如其来的悲剧面前，我们被提醒，信仰并不能让我们免于死亡的刺痛，但它赐予我们一位与我们一同哀哭的救主。我们为这位来自东本的男子的家人祈祷，也祈求雅伟医治那些在事故中受伤的人。

verse.textEn: Jesus wept.
verse.textZh: 耶稣哭了。

title.en: Dutch institute issues 'red alert' over Trump-shaped ecstasy pills
title.zh: 荷兰研究所就特朗普形状的摇头丸发出‘红色警报’

summary.en: The Dutch drug addiction and mental health institute has issued a 'red alert' regarding ecstasy pills shaped like former US President Donald Trump. These pills contain a high concentration of PMMA, a substance that can cause overheating and potentially fatal consequences, with the delayed effect increasing the risk of...
summary.zh: 荷兰药物成瘾和心理健康研究所已就形似美国前总统唐纳德·特朗普的摇头丸发出‘红色警报’。这些药丸含有高浓度的PMMA，这种物质可能导致过热并可能致命，其延迟生效的特性增加了过量的风险。

body.en:
A Dutch drug addiction and mental health institute has issued a "red alert" to users about potentially lethal ecstasy pills which resemble US President Donald Trump.

The Utrecht-based Trimbos Institute said several of the pills had been handed in at testing centres in August and were found to contain a "very high" amount of the chemical PMMA.

"Do not use this pill under any circumstance," the institute said in its warning, cautioning that the drug could cause "overheating with potentially fatal consequences".

It issued images of the pills, which feature a depiction of Trump's face on one side and the words "Trump" and "NL" stamped on the other.

PMMA, or para-methoxymethamfetamine, is a substance similar to MDMA – the active ingredient in ecstasy pills.

"However, the effect occurs later, and the stimulating effect is often absent," the health institute advised. "This increases the risk of overdose."

Users are being warned they could experience symptoms such as nausea, an increased heart rate and convulsions hours after ingesting the pills.

Trimbos Institute spokesperson Anniek Groothuis told the Associated Press that it had no reported cases of death or serious illness among possible users.

While producing, selling and using ecstasy is illegal in the Netherlands, a 2024 Dutch government report said the substance was "still quite popular as a party drug".

The report added that, in 2022, a "record 550,000 people" had taken the drug at least once.

This is not the first time Donald Trump's facial features appear to have been used as inspiration for the shape of ecstasy pills.

In 2017, German police confiscated about 5,000 carrot-coloured ecstasy tablets in the shape of the US president's head – which they believed had been promoted on the internet under the slogan "Trump makes partying great again".
body.zh: 荷兰一家毒瘾和心理健康研究所向用户发出“红色警报”，称其可能致命的摇头丸药丸与美国总统唐纳德·特朗普相似。 位于乌得勒支的 Trimbos 研究所表示，其中几颗药丸已于 8 月份送交测试中心，结果发现含有“非常高”含量的化学物质 PMMA。 该研究所在警告中表示：“在任何情况下都不要使用这种药丸”，并警告该药物可能会导致“过热，从而可能致命”。 它发布了这些药丸的图片，其中一侧印有特朗普的脸部图案，另一侧印有“特朗普”和“NL”字样。 PMMA（即对甲氧基甲基苯丙胺）是一种类似于摇头丸中的活性成分 MDMA 的物质。 “然而，这种影响发生得较晚，而且刺激作用往往不存在，”该健康研究所建议道。 “这增加了服用过量的风险。” 使用者被警告说，他们在服药数小时后可能会出现恶心、心率加快和抽搐等症状。 Trimbos 研究所发言人 Anniek Groothuis 告诉美联社，该研究所尚未收到可能使用者死亡或重病的报告。 虽然生产、销售和使用摇头丸在荷兰是非法的，但 2024 年荷兰政府的一份报告称，这种物质“作为派对药物仍然很受欢迎”。 该报告补充说，2022 年，“创纪录的 55 万人”至少服用过一次这种药物。 这并不是唐纳德·特朗普的面部特征第一次被用作摇头丸形状的灵感。 2017年，德国警方没收了约5000粒美国总统头像形状的胡萝卜色摇头丸——他们认为这些摇头丸是在互联网上以“特朗普让派对再次伟大”的口号进行宣传的。

reflection.en: The appearance of ecstasy pills in the likeness of a political figure serves as a stark reminder of how dangerous substances can be disguised. The warning from the Trimbos Institute about the high PMMA content and the risk of overdose underscores the destructive potential of illicit drugs. This situation calls to mind the biblical caution against the...
reflection.zh: 形似政治人物的摇头丸的出现，鲜明地提醒我们危险物质可能被如何伪装。特林博斯研究所关于高含量PMMA和过量风险的警告，凸显了非法药物的破坏潜力。这种情况令人想起圣经中关于追求有害事物（即使它们看起来有吸引力或与有权势的人物相关联）的告诫。

title.zh: 埃克塞特大学批准与沙特阿拉伯达成协议，培训军官和官员

title.en: South Korea leans toward military conscription for women
title.zh: 韩国倾向于对女性实行兵役征召

summary.en: South Korea is moving closer to the possibility of requiring women to perform mandatory military service. This consideration stems from a declining population, a shrinking pool of potential conscripts, and growing calls for gender equality in national defense. A recent survey indicates that nearly 60% of South Koreans...
summary.zh: 韩国正逐步接近实行女性强制兵役的可能性。这一考虑源于人口下降、潜在征兵人数减少以及对国家防务中性别平等呼声的日益高涨。一项最新调查显示，近60%的韩国人支持对年轻女性实行强制兵役。

body.en:
Facing a population decline, fewer potential service members and calls for social equality to be extended to national military service, Korea is inching closer to breaking the taboo on women on the front line.

Nearly 60% of South Koreans are now in favor of young women serving mandatory military service alongside their male counterparts, according to a recent survey, representing a significant shift in the long-held taboo against women being obliged to defend the nation.

Thousands of women already serve in the South Korean armed forces on a voluntary basis, but the debate over mandatory service has always been delicate.

Now, for a series of reasons that include a falling birth rate and shrinking number of recruits as well as an insistence that social equality means that women should also serve, the issue has re-emerged ahead of a reform of the national defense plan scheduled to be released this autumn.

Yet, there are still those who insist women should be kept away from the front lines and, instead, that South Korea should invest more in drones and other advanced technologies.

"South Korea's male-centered conscription system has long been closely connected to traditional gender roles," said Hyobin Lee, a professor at Sogang University in Seoul.

"Men were generally expected to protect the country and the family and to fight in wartime, while women were expected to take primary responsibility for childbirth, childcare and the household," she told DW.

A second factor is the intensifying debate about gender equality , a debate in large part driven by young men, she said.

"South Korean men generally perform their military service in their early 20s, which interrupts their education, employment or early career development," Lee said.

"At the same time, gender equality has become an increasingly important social value, and women's opportunities in education and employment have expanded."

"As a result, some younger men ask a very simple question: If society expects equality in rights and opportunities, why does one of the country's most significant civic obligations — military service — still fall only on men?"

Another contributing factor is the change in the nature of the military itself, with a shift away from physically demanding combat roles that were perceived as being more suited to men and the emergence of a national defense more heavily reliant on technology.

This includes unmanned systems, cyber capabilities, information and communications technology and others that do not require physical strength.

According to the study, carried out by the Reform Institute, the policy research arm of the conservative-leaning Reform Party, and published on August 20, almost 60% of the respondents were in favor of...
body.zh: 面对人口下降、潜在服役人员减少以及将社会平等延伸至国家兵役的呼声，韩国正一步步打破女性在前线的禁忌。 最近的一项调查显示，近 60% 的韩国人现在支持年轻女性与男性同行一起服义务兵役，这标志着长期以来反对女性有义务保卫国家的禁忌发生了重大转变。 已有数千名女性自愿在韩国武装部队服役，但关于强制服役的争论一直很微妙。 现在，由于出生率下降、入伍人数减少以及坚持社会平等意味着妇女也应该服役等一系列原因，这个问题在定于今年秋天发布的国防计划改革之前重新出现。 然而，仍然有人坚持认为女性应该远离前线，相反，韩国应该在无人机和其他先进技术上进行更多投资。 首尔西江大学教授李孝彬 (Hyobin Lee) 表示：“韩国以男性为中心的征兵制度长期以来与传统性别角色密切相关。” 她告诉德国之声：“人们普遍期望男性保护国家和家庭，并在战时参战，而女性则被期望承担生育、照顾孩子和家庭的主要责任。” 她说，第二个因素是关于性别平等的争论日益激烈，这场争论在很大程度上是由年轻男性推动的。 “韩国男性通常在 20 岁出头服兵役，这会中断他们的教育、就业或早期职业发展，”Lee 说。 “与此同时，性别平等已成为越来越重要的社会价值，女性受教育和就业的机会不断扩大。” “因此，一些年轻人提出了一个非常简单的问题：如果社会期望权利和机会平等，为什么这个国家最重要的公民义务之一——服兵役——仍然只落在男性身上？” 另一个影响因素是军队本身性质的变化，人们认为更适合男性的体力要求较高的战斗角色的转变，以及国防更加依赖技术的出现。 这包括无人系统、网络能力、信息和通信技术以及其他不需要体力的系统。 根据保守倾向改革党的政策研究机构改革研究所于 8 月 20 日发布的这项研究，近 60% 的受访者赞成……

reflection.en: As South Korea contemplates mandatory military service for women, it grapples with societal norms and the principle of equality. The idea that in Christ, traditional divisions of gender are transcended, offers a framework for considering how all members of society can contribute and be valued. This move reflects a broader conversation about shared...
reflection.zh: 随着韩国考虑对女性实行强制兵役，它正在应对社会规范和公平的原则。在基督里，传统的性别区分被超越的观念，为思考社会所有成员如何贡献和被重视提供了一个框架。这一举措反映了关于共同责任和打破长期存在的障碍的更广泛对话。

title.en: Serbia: Keeping EU, Russia in play ahead of key election
title.zh: 塞尔维亚：在大选前维持与欧盟和俄罗斯的平衡

summary.en: As Serbia approaches a critical election, President Aleksandar Vucic is navigating a complex foreign policy, maintaining relationships with both Russia and the European Union while facing increasing geopolitical pressures and domestic challenges that limit his options.
summary.zh: 塞尔维亚正走向一场不确定的选举，总统亚历山大·武契奇在与俄罗斯和欧盟的关系之间寻求平衡。然而，日益加剧的地缘政治紧张局势和国内压力正压缩他的回旋空间。

body.en:
As Serbia heads towards an uncertain election, President Aleksandar Vucic is balancing ties with Russia and EU ambitions. But growing geopolitical tensions and pressure at home are narrowing his room to maneuver.

Smoke from the wildfires still hangs over parts of Serbia , but as the flames slowly recede, another debate is taking shape in their wake — one that has less to do with firefighting and more with politics.

In early August, wildfires swept across Serbia, affecting more than 3,500 hectares (8,600 acres) in the Deliblato Sands Special Nature Reserve alone. For days, firefighters, soldiers and helicopters battled the flames.

Then a Russian Ilyushin Il-76 firefighting aircraft arrived in the southern city of Nis. Serbia had turned to Moscow for help, making Russia the first foreign country it asked to provide a firefighting aircraft. Pro-government media greeted its arrival with celebratory coverage, dubbing the aircraft the "Russian beast."

"Considering that there are no firefighting aircraft of this capacity available within the European Union , the arriving Russian aircraft will significantly strengthen our capacities to fight the fires," said Luka Causic, head of the Serbian Interior Ministry's Department for Emergency Situations.

The episode, however, was already being viewed through a geopolitical lens, as Serbia had sought Russian assistance before activating the EU's emergency mechanism.

When it did, the response was swift. Brussels mobilized four helicopters from its strategic rescEU reserve , based in Czechia, Romania and Slovakia, along with ground firefighting teams from Germany and Romania.

Vucic rejected the idea that turning to Russia first was a foreign-policy decision or a sign of Serbia's political alignment with Moscow.

"As far as equipment and resources are concerned, we are a European giant. The helicopters we received from Europe to fight the fires are less capable than ours and have a lower carrying capacity than our own," Vucic said during a visit to the Deliblato Sands.

The wildfire episode came less than two weeks after Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy made his first official visit to Serbia.

The two presidents reaffirmed their support for each other's territorial integrity, which is particularly significant for Belgrade because Ukraine does not recognise Kosovo's independence.

But Vucic is also trying to keep the other side on board, says Vuk Vuksanovic , a political scientist and foreign-policy lecturer at King's College London.

Vuksanovic argues that Vucic's engagement with Zelenskyy must therefore be portrayed in Moscow not as a fundamental shift in Serbia's relationship with Russia, but as a response to Western pressure and Serbia's own interests.

body.zh: 随着塞尔维亚大选走向不确定，总统亚历山大·武契奇正在平衡与俄罗斯和欧盟野心的关系。但日益加剧的地缘政治紧张局势和国内压力正在缩小他的回旋余地。 野火产生的烟雾仍然笼罩在塞尔维亚部分地区，但随着火焰慢慢消退，另一场辩论正在形成——这场辩论与消防无关，更多与政治有关。 8 月初，野火席卷了塞尔维亚，仅德利布拉托金沙特别自然保护区就影响了超过 3,500 公顷（8,600 英亩）的土地。连日来，消防员、士兵和直升机一直在与大火搏斗。 随后一架俄罗斯伊尔76型消防机抵达南部城市尼什。塞尔维亚向莫斯科寻求帮助，使俄罗斯成为第一个请求提供消防飞机的国家。亲政府媒体以庆祝性报道欢迎这架飞机的到来，称这架飞机为“俄罗斯野兽”。 塞尔维亚内政部紧急情况司司长卢卡·考西克表示：“考虑到欧盟境内没有具备这种能力的消防飞机，抵达的俄罗斯飞机将大大增强我们的灭火能力。” 然而，这一事件已经被从地缘政治的角度看待，因为塞尔维亚在启动欧盟紧急机制之前曾寻求俄罗斯的援助。 当它发生时，反应很快。布鲁塞尔从其驻捷克、罗马尼亚和斯洛伐克的战略救援储备中调动了四架直升机，以及来自德国和罗马尼亚的地面消防队。 武契奇否认首先转向俄罗斯是一项外交政策决定或塞尔维亚与莫斯科政治结盟的标志。 “就设备和资源而言，我们是欧洲巨头。我们从欧洲接收的用于灭火的直升机的能力不如我们的，运载能力也低于我们自己的，”武契奇在参观德利布拉托金沙时说道。 这场山火发生在乌克兰总统泽连斯基首次正式访问塞尔维亚后不到两周。 两国总统重申支持彼此的领土完整，这对贝尔格莱德尤为重要，因为乌克兰不承认科索沃独立。 但伦敦国王学院政治学家兼外交政策讲师武克·武克萨诺维奇 (Vuk Vuksanovic) 表示，武契奇也在努力让对方参与其中。 武克萨诺维奇认为，因此莫斯科必须将武契奇与泽连斯基的接触描述为塞尔维亚与俄罗斯关系的根本转变，而不是对西方压力和塞尔维亚自身利益的回应。 “武契奇现在...

reflection.en: In Serbia, President Vucic faces the difficult task of balancing competing international interests and domestic pressures as an election looms. This complex geopolitical situation underscores the profound need for wise counsel in leadership, especially when navigating uncertain times and significant challenges. As Proverbs 11:14 states, 'Where there is no...
reflection.zh: 在塞尔维亚，随着选举临近，武契奇总统面临着平衡相互竞争的国际利益和国内压力的艰巨任务。这种复杂的地缘政治局势凸显了领导层对明智建议的深切需求，尤其是在应对不确定的时期和重大挑战时。 正如《箴言》11:14所说：“在没有指导的地方，人民就倾跌；但许多谋士之处，便有安全。”愿领导者寻求并听取基于真理和公义的明智建议，以引导他们的国家度过动荡时期。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: Ex-White House teleprompter operator ordered to pay $172,000 for Trump speech bets
title.zh: 前白宫提词器操作员因对特朗普演讲下注被罚17.2万美元

summary.en: A former White House staffer was ordered to pay over $172,000 for using his advance knowledge of President Trump's speeches to place bets on a prediction market platform.
summary.zh: 一名前白宫工作人员因利用预先掌握的特朗普总统演讲内容在预测市场平台上进行投注，被勒令支付超过17.2万美元的罚金和赔偿。

body.en:
A former White House teleprompter operator has been ordered to pay more than $172,000 (£127,000) for using inside information to bet on US President Donald Trump's speeches.

Gabriel Perez was found to have made trades on what the president would say during addresses between December 2025 and February 2026 on Kalshi - a prediction markets platform where users can bet on real-world events.

Its regulator, the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC), said Perez would have to surrender profits of $107,539.02 (£79,452) and pay a civil penalty of $65,000 (£48,000).

The White House has not yet commented. In July, then-press secretary Karoline Leavitt said Perez was on unpaid leave and would not return to his post.

Announcing the settlement on Friday, the CFTC said Perez had "misappropriated" his prior knowledge of Trump's speeches to place bets "in breach of his duty of trust and confidence".

It said his civil penalty had been reduced due to his "exemplary co-operation" with the investigation.

Writing on X, Kalshi's lead lawyer Bobby DeNault welcomed the decision: "It doesn't matter who you are: violate our rules or federal law and you will face the consequences."

The company previously told the BBC its analysts had noticed unusual betting on "mention markets" – contracts where users predict whether a speaker will use common terms, such as specific countries, campaign slogans or words – in March.

It said it had used account data to find that the user was a federal employee operating White House teleprompters, and had reported the activity to the regulator.

"The words of political leaders like Presidents and Fed chairs cause billions of dollars of movement in FX markets, oil futures, [and] the stock market," it said in a statement in July.

The same month, the White House Management Office had sent a letter to aides telling them not to place bets on prediction markets, administration officials told the BBC's US media partner CBS News.
body.zh: 一名前白宫提词器操作员因利用内幕信息押注美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的演讲而被勒令支付超过 172,000 美元（127,000 英镑）。 加布里埃尔·佩雷斯被发现在 2025 年 12 月至 2026 年 2 月期间在 Kalshi（一个预测市场平台，用户可以对现实世界事件进行投注）上根据总统在演讲中所说的话进行交易。 其监管机构商品期货交易委员会 (CFTC) 表示，佩雷斯必须交出 107,539.02 美元（79,452 英镑）的利润，并支付 65,000 美元（48,000 英镑）的民事罚款。 白宫尚未发表评论。 7月，时任新闻秘书卡罗琳·莱维特表示，佩雷斯正在休无薪假，不会重返岗位。 美国商品期货交易委员会在周五宣布和解时表示，佩雷斯“挪用”了他对特朗普演讲的事先了解，“违反了他的信任和信心义务”进行投注。 声明称，由于他对调查的“模范合作”，他的民事处罚已被减轻。 Kalshi 的首席律师 Bobby DeNault 在 X 上撰文对这一决定表示欢迎：“无论你是谁：违反我们的规则或联邦法律，你将面临后果。” 该公司此前告诉 BBC，其分析师在 3 月份注意到了对“提及市场”的不寻常押注，即用户预测演讲者是否会使用常见术语（例如特定国家、竞选口号或词语）的合同。 该公司表示，已使用账户数据发现该用户是一名操作白宫提词器的联邦雇员，并向监管机构报告了这一活动。 该机构在 7 月份的一份声明中表示：“总统和美联储主席等政治领导人的言论导致外汇市场、石油期货和股市发生数十亿美元的波动。” 政府官员告诉英国广播公司(BBC)美国媒体合作伙伴哥伦比亚广播公司新闻(CBS News)，同月，白宫管理办公室致函助手，告诉他们不要在预测市场上下注。

reflection.en: Integrity is not reserved only for those in the spotlight; it is required of everyone who holds a position of trust, no matter how behind-the-scenes it may be. By using private information for personal profit, this staffer compromised the dignity of public service for a temporary financial gain. Yahweh values the quiet faithfulness of those who handle small...
reflection.zh: 正直并非仅仅是对聚光灯下的人的要求；每一个身处信任岗位的人，无论多么幕后，都被要求保持诚实。这名工作人员利用私人信息谋取私利，为了暂时的经济利益损害了公共服务的尊严。雅伟看重那些在小事上尽忠职守的人，正如祂看重那些处理大事的人一样。

verse.textEn: Whoever can be trusted with very little can also be trusted with much, and whoever is dishonest with very little will also be dishonest with much.
verse.textZh: 人在最小的事上忠心，在大事上也忠心；在最小的事上不义，在大事上也不义。

title.en: Forget Starbucks coffee - Gen Z like their drinks ice cold
title.zh: 星巴克咖啡忘了它吧——Z世代喜欢冰镇饮料

summary.en: Young consumers are choosing cold, customizable drinks, and coffee chains are racing to adapt. Starbucks reports that three out of every four drinks it now sells are cold, a significant shift from its origins as a coffee shop.
summary.zh: 年轻消费者正选择冰镇、可定制的饮品，咖啡连锁店正争相迎合。星巴克报告称，其售出的饮品中四分之三是冰镇的，这与其最初作为一家咖啡店的定位已大不相同。

body.en:
Elaine Ling splits her time between New York and California, but wherever she is and needs a coffee, she doesn't visit a Starbucks.

She only goes there for her cold drinks. Her "real coffee" comes from local cafes.

"I don't really like to go to Starbucks for coffee. I think their coffee is like too sweet," Ling, 21, told the BBC. "I'm more of a refresher girl when it comes to going to Starbucks."

Though founded as a coffee shop more than five decades ago, Starbucks says that three out of every four drinks it now sells are cold. Think iced fruity drinks, protein shakes and so-called dirty sodas - a concoction of foam, syrups and juices.

Gen Z consumers - people born between 1997 and 2012 - are increasingly choosing cold drinks that they can customise themselves over traditional coffee.

Tristan Höver, global insight manager for hot drinks at Euromonitor International, says younger consumers increasingly see drinks as something they can tailor to a specific moment or need.

He says Gen Z is price-sensitive but willing to pay more if the drink feels special, larger, or functional.

With cold drinks, he says, size, layers and visual appeal help justify the higher price.

Jerry Sheldon, an analyst at IHL Group, sees these habits as part of a larger cultural shift.

"Cold drinks are a form of self-expression," he says. It is another way to signal identity, much like clothing or hair colour.

Kelly Goldsmith, a Professor of Marketing at Vanderbilt University, says consumers are "not paying for what's in the cup, but what's on the cup," comparing Starbucks to an affordable luxury handbag made by the likes of Louis Vuitton.

Starbucks' Unicorn Frappuccino was much-hyped on TikTok and available for only three days in August.

The dense, brightly coloured blended drink with swirls of pink, blue and purple, topped with whipped cream and a crunchy topping lifted foot traffic at Starbucks by 44% during its brief emergence, according to Placer.ai, a data analytics firm.

Dunkin' Donuts is experimenting with protein-boosted drinks and customisable cold options, recently partnering with celebrities like Kylie Jenner to promote limited‑time drinks.

TikTok food‑and‑drink creator Natalie Ludwig, who has more than 500,000 followers, has sampled Dunkin's cold drinks.

She says the campaign with Jenner is one example of how the chain is trying to tap into a younger audience, adding that if the promotion succeeds "maybe that younger audience sticks".

Fast food chains like McDonald's, Chick-fil-A, and Taco Bell have launched fruit-based so-called refreshers and coffee-adjacent options and other non-caffeine cold drinks aimed at the same audience.

Isabella Reeve, a consumer insight director at Worldpanel by Numerator, says shoppers under 25 buy more cold drinks than...
body.zh: 伊莱恩·林 (Elaine Ling) 的时间往返于纽约和加利福尼亚，但无论她身在何处，需要喝咖啡，她都不会去星巴克。 她只去那里喝冷饮。她的“真正的咖啡”来自当地的咖啡馆。 “我不太喜欢去星巴克喝咖啡。我觉得他们的咖啡太甜了，”21 岁的 Ling 告诉 BBC。 “说到去星巴克，我更像是一个恢复活力的女孩。” 尽管星巴克在五十多年前成立时只是一家咖啡店，但它表示，现在每四分之三的饮料都是冷饮。想想冰镇水果饮料、蛋白质奶昔和所谓的脏苏打水——泡沫、糖浆和果汁的混合物。 Z 世代消费者（1997 年至 2012 年出生的人）越来越多地选择可以定制的冷饮，而不是传统咖啡。 欧睿国际 (Euromonitor International) 热饮全球洞察经理 Tristan Höver 表示，年轻消费者越来越多地将饮料视为可以根据特定时刻或需求定制的产品。 他表示，Z 世代对价格敏感，但如果饮料感觉特别、容量大或功能强大，他们愿意支付更高的价格。 他说，对于冷饮来说，尺寸、层次和视觉吸引力有助于证明较高的价格是合理的。 IHL Group 分析师杰里·谢尔登 (Jerry Sheldon) 将这些习惯视为更大的文化转变的一部分。 “冷饮是自我表达的一种形式，”他说。这是表明身份的另一种方式，就像衣服或头发的颜色一样。 范德比尔特大学营销学教授凯利·戈德史密斯表示，消费者“不是为杯子里的东西买单，而是为杯子上的东西买单”，他将星巴克比作路易威登等公司生产的价格实惠的豪华手提包。 星巴克的独角兽星冰乐在 TikTok 上大肆宣传，并且在 8 月份仅供应三天。 根据数据分析公司 Placer.ai 的数据，这种浓稠、颜色鲜艳的混合饮料带有粉色、蓝色和紫色的漩涡，上面涂有生奶油和松脆的配料，在其短暂出现期间，星巴克的客流量增加了 44%。 唐恩都乐 (Dunkin' Donuts) 正在尝试富含蛋白质的饮料和可定制的冷饮，最近与凯莉·詹纳 (Kylie Jenner) 等名人合作推广限时饮料。 拥有超过 50 万粉丝的 TikTok 食品和饮料创作者 Natalie Ludwig 品尝了 Dunkin 的冷饮。 她表示，与詹纳合作的活动是该连锁店试图吸引年轻观众的一个例子，并补充说，如果促销成功，“也许年轻观众会坚持下去”。 麦当劳、福来鸡和塔可钟等快餐连锁店针对同一受众推出了以水果为基础的所谓清凉饮料、咖啡替代品以及其他不含咖啡因的冷饮。 伊莎贝拉·里夫 (Isabella Reeve) 是 Worldpanel by Numerator 的消费者洞察总监，她表示 25 岁以下的购物者购买的冷饮比...

reflection.en: The story of Gen Z's preference for cold, customizable drinks over traditional coffee at chains like Starbucks illustrates a shift in consumer desires. This trend prompts reflection on what truly satisfies us, echoing Jesus' teaching that one cannot serve both God and money, urging us to examine our priorities and allegiances.
reflection.zh: Z世代消费者偏爱星巴克等连锁店的冰镇、可定制饮品而非传统咖啡的故事，体现了消费者需求的转变。这一趋势促使我们反思什么才能真正满足我们，呼应了耶稣的教导：人不能事奉两个主——雅伟和玛门，提醒我们要审视自己的优先事项和忠诚所在。

verse.textEn: No one can serve two masters... You cannot serve both God and Mammon.
verse.textZh: 一个人不能事奉两个主……你们不能又事奉神，又事奉玛门。

title.en: Footage of Tibet floods isn't being shown in China - and we know little about victims there
title.zh: 西藏洪水画面未在中国境内播放——我们对当地受害者知之甚少

summary.en: Dramatic footage of deadly flash flooding in Tibet, specifically at Gyirong Port, which swept away everything in its path and claimed hundreds of lives, has been largely hidden from public view in China. State media has shown only a single still-frame, and information about the victims is difficult to find on the...
summary.zh: 西藏吉隆口岸发生致命山洪，洪水冲毁一切，造成数百人死亡。然而，相关视频和详细信息在中国境内却鲜为人知。官方媒体仅播放了一张静止画面，在严格审查的网络上也很难找到有关受害者的信息。

body.en:
The dramatic footage was almost impossible to miss. A torrent of water tearing through Gyirong Port, one of the main border crossings between Nepal and Tibet, sweeping away all in its path as hundreds of people fled for their lives.

The scenes, captured by CCTV cameras, quickly spread on social media and onto screens around the world.

Only a single still-frame shot has been broadcast so far by the country's state-run flagship news bulletin.

It has also been difficult to find the video on China's heavily censored internet. It is just as hard to even find posts describing the flash flooding that has claimed hundreds of lives, with just as many still unaccounted for since Wednesday.

Beijing has launched a massive rescue operation involving hundreds of emergency workers, which is continuing, and President Xi Jinping chaired an emergency meeting with officials to co-ordinate efforts.

But when you compare the country's internet content to what much of the world has been seeing online these past few days, China's firewall becomes more visible than ever.

Tibet, which Beijing annexed in the 1950s, had long resisted rule by the Chinese Communist Party.

China has quashed protests over the years, sometimes violently, and has been accused of grave rights violations in the Buddhist region. It has labelled the exiled spiritual leader, the Dalai Lama, a separatist.

That history means the very name Tibet draws China's censors. Beijing's sensitivities are especially apparent at times likes this.

There have been daily updates on the missing and the dead, and Beijing has also been posting updates on the rescue operations, as well as the dangers posed by a barrier lake that has been at risk of overflowing.

On Saturday, new footage from Chinese state media showed rescue teams wandering in a wasteland of mud and rock while calling out to anyone trapped.

But there is little detail beyond that. There are no accounts from survivors in Tibet, and almost no user-generated footage showing the deadly moments or their aftermath.

We are yet to hear from anxious families of those missing. Trying to contact people there is near-impossible during regular times.

As a journalist who has covered North Korea, it has often been easier for me to contact interviewees in Pyongyang than it is in the Tibetan capital, Lhasa.

On Thursday night, as global headlines led on the devastation in a Himalayan valley, China's state broadcaster opened its main bulletin with the launch of Xi's new book, a selection of his "most important and fundamental works".

Foreign journalists cannot travel to Tibet without government permission. We have just a few hours to get as much information as we can on huge stories like this before videos are scrubbed and voices stifled.

Instead, we have to rely...
body.zh: 戏剧性的镜头几乎不可能被错过。尼泊尔和西藏之间的主要边境口岸之一吉隆口岸发生洪流，洪水冲垮了沿途的一切，数百人逃命。 这些场景被闭路电视摄像机捕捉到，迅速在社交媒体和世界各地的屏幕上传播。 到目前为止，该国官方旗舰新闻公报只播放了一个静态画面。 在中国严格审查的互联网上也很难找到这段视频。同样很难找到描述这场夺去了数百人生命的山洪的帖子，自周三以来仍有同样多的人下落不明。 北京已启动了涉及数百名应急人员的大规模救援行动，该行动仍在继续，国家主席习近平主持召开了官员紧急会议，协调救援行动。 但当你将中国的互联网内容与过去几天世界上大部分地区在网上看到的内容进行比较时，中国的防火墙变得比以往任何时候都更加明显。 北京在 20 世纪 50 年代吞并的西藏长期以来一直反抗中国共产党的统治。 多年来，中国镇压了抗议活动，有时甚至是暴力镇压，并被指控在佛教地区严重侵犯人权。它给流亡精神领袖达赖喇嘛贴上了分离主义者的标签。 这段历史意味着中国审查机构用“西藏”这个名字来命名。北京的敏感性在这种时候尤其明显。 每天都有关于失踪和死亡的最新消息，北京也一直在发布救援行动的最新消息，以及堰塞湖面临溢出风险所带来的危险。 周六，中国官方媒体的新镜头显示，救援队在一片泥泞和岩石的荒地上徘徊，同时向被困人员呼救。 但除此之外就没有什么细节了。没有西藏幸存者的叙述，也几乎没有用户生成的视频显示致命时刻或后果。 我们还没有收到失踪者焦急的家人的消息。平时想要联系那里的人几乎是不可能的。 作为一名报道朝鲜的记者，我在平壤联系受访者往往比在西藏首府拉萨更容易。 周四晚上，当全球头条新闻报道喜马拉雅山谷的灾难时，中国国家广播公司以习近平新书的发布作为其主要公报的开篇，该书精选了他的“最重要和最基础的著作”。 未经政府许可，外国记者不得前往西藏。在视频被删除、声音被压制之前，我们只有几个小时的时间来尽可能多地获取有关此类重大事件的信息。 相反，我们必须依靠...

reflection.en: The tragic flash flooding in Tibet, particularly at Gyirong Port, has claimed hundreds of lives, yet dramatic footage and details remain largely hidden from public view in China. Proverbs 31:8-9 calls us to speak for those who are mute and for the rights of the destitute. This reminds us of the moral imperative to acknowledge and advocate for those...
reflection.zh: 西藏吉隆口岸发生的洪灾造成数百人丧生，然而，相关的灾情视频和详细信息在中国境内却鲜为人知。箴言31:8-9教导我们要为不能自辩的人开口，为一切困苦的人伸冤。这提醒我们，当受苦者的声音被压制或他们的故事被掩盖时，我们有道德责任去承认他们的苦难并为他们发声。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Nepal suspends search and rescue operations as flood death toll rises to 626
title.zh: 尼泊尔暂停搜救行动，洪水死亡人数升至626人

summary.en: As survival stories emerge from Nepal, authorities have been forced to temporarily suspend the search for thousands of people still missing following a devastating flash flood that has claimed 626 lives.
summary.zh: 在尼泊尔出现幸存者故事的同时，当局被迫暂时中止搜寻数千名失踪人员的行动。此前，一场毁灭性的洪水已造成626人死亡。

body.en:
The death toll from a devastating flash flood in Nepal and Tibet has risen to 626 as search and rescue operations were suspended due to bad weather.

Rescue workers have been working around the clock since Wednesday's disaster after a glacier collapse unleashed a huge torrent of rock, ice, mud and debris through Himalayan mountain river systems as it swallowed buildings, bridges and power stations in its path.

Nearly 3,000 people are still missing — about 2,426 in Nepal and at least 558 in Tibet's Gyirong County — many of them Hindu pilgrims from India. Of those missing in the disaster, at least 540 are foreigners, including 41 Australians.

Only on Friday were rescuers able to reach Gyirong. State media reported the Chinese team of 21 rescuers and a search-and-rescue dog crossed mountains and valleys and used ropes to navigate forests and cliffs after roads to the complex, hemmed in by steep Himalayan slopes, were destroyed.

Authorities suspended rescue operations on Saturday because of rain ⁠and foggy weather, Narendra Pariyar, the top bureaucrat for the badly hit Rasuwa district, told Reuters.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

More than 90,000 people are estimated to have been affected by the disaster, the Red Cross said.

The flooding led to the formation of a lake, which on Friday began overflowing into the Lhende Khola and Trishuli rivers.

The overflow sparked panic and warnings from authorities in Nepal, leading to rescue operations being suspended for ‌about three hours. The risk prompted ‌all Chinese rescue personnel and vehicles to withdraw as ⁠well, China Central Television said.

Both resumed rescue operations after the threat eased, with Nepali officials saying that they were still hopeful of finding survivors.

Nepal is continuing to monitor two barrier lakes upstream of the flood zone, with an official warning that flood risks will persist until both lakes fully drain.

Chinese and Nepali authorities have warned further flooding may occur, complicating rescue efforts and posing a risk to communities in the area.

Meanwhile, extraordinary stories of survival are emerging from areas struck by the disaster.

A man who was working at a bank in Timure, a Nepali village devastated by the floods, has recalled the harrowing moments as he escaped to safety from "three or four stories of water".

After hearing a loud noise that he feared was an earthquake or landslide, and seeing people running, he left everything behind and ran, he told SBS News.

"Just between 25 seconds, everything was gone," Gaurav Thapa Magar, 32, recalled, adding that as he climbed upwards to safety, he looked back but...
body.zh: 尼泊尔和西藏发生毁灭性山洪，搜救行动因恶劣天气而暂停，死亡人数已上升至626人。 自周三灾难发生以来，救援人员一直在昼夜不停地工作，此前冰川崩塌导致喜马拉雅山脉河流系统释放出巨大的岩石、冰、泥土和碎片，吞没了沿途的建筑物、桥梁和发电站。 目前仍有近 3,000 人失踪，其中尼泊尔约有 2,426 人，西藏吉隆县至少有 558 人，其中许多人是来自印度的印度教朝圣者。在这场灾难中失踪的人中，至少有540人是外国人，其中包括41名澳大利亚人。 直到周五，救援人员才抵达吉隆。官方媒体报道称，在通往被喜马拉雅山陡坡包围的建筑群的道路被摧毁后，由21名救援人员和一只搜救犬组成的中国救援队翻越山脉和山谷，并使用绳索在森林和悬崖中穿行。 受灾严重的拉苏瓦地区最高官员纳伦德拉·帕里亚尔 (Narendra Pariyar) 告诉路透社，由于降雨和大雾天气，当局于周六暂停了救援行动。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 红十字会表示，估计有超过 90,000 人受到这场灾难的影响。 洪水导致形成了一个湖泊，该湖于周五开始溢出，流入 Lhende Khola 河和 Trishuli 河。 溢流引发了尼泊尔​​当局的恐慌和警告，导致救援行动暂停约三个小时。据中央电视台报道，这一风险也促使所有中国救援人员和车辆撤离。 威胁缓解后，两国都恢复了救援行动，尼泊尔官员表示，他们仍然希望找到幸存者。 尼泊尔正在继续监测洪水区上游的两个堰塞湖，并发出官方警告，在这两个湖泊完全排干之前，洪水风险将持续存在。 中国和尼泊尔当局警告称，可能会发生进一步的洪水，使救援工作变得更加复杂，并给该地区的社区带来风险。 与此同时，受灾地区不断涌现出非凡的生存故事。 一名在被洪水摧毁的尼泊尔村庄蒂穆尔的银行工作的男子回忆起他从“三四层楼高的水”逃到安全地带时的悲惨时刻。 他告诉SBS新闻，在听到他担心是地震或山体滑坡的巨响后，看到人们在奔跑，他抛下一切逃跑了。 32 岁的高拉夫·塔帕·马加尔 (Gaurav Thapa Magar) 回忆道：“仅仅 25 秒之间，一切都消失了。”他补充道，当他向上爬到安全地带时，他回头看了一眼，但是……

reflection.en: The devastating flash flood in Nepal and Tibet has tragically claimed 626 lives, with thousands still missing. Amidst such profound loss and the suspension of rescue efforts due to weather, Lamentations 3:22 reminds us that Yahweh's mercies are new every morning. Even in the face of overwhelming devastation, this truth offers a flicker of hope for sustained...
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔和西藏发生的毁灭性洪水已造成626人不幸遇难，仍有数千人失踪。在如此巨大的损失和因天气原因搜救行动暂停的情况下，《耶利米哀歌》3:22提醒我们，雅伟的慈爱每早都是新的。即使面对压倒性的毁灭，这一真理也为持久的忍耐提供了一线希望。

verse.textEn: Because of Yahweh's great love we are not consumed, for his compassions never fail. They are new every morning.
verse.textZh: 我们不至消灭，是出于雅伟诸般的慈爱；是因他的怜悯不至断绝。每早晨这都是新的。

title.en: What next? Kurds say yes, Druze still say no to united Syria
title.zh: 下一步？库尔德人同意，德鲁兹人仍说不，要分裂的叙利亚

summary.en: Syria's Druze minority in Sweida remains the only group not to accept central government authority. The recent decision by Syria's Kurdish minority to dissolve their independent rule raises questions about the future of the Druze's own plans for a divided Syria.
summary.zh: 叙利亚德鲁兹少数民族聚居的斯韦达地区是唯一尚未接受中央政府管辖的地区。叙利亚库尔德少数民族近期决定解散其独立统治，这引发了关于德鲁兹人自身对分裂叙利亚计划未来的疑问。

body.en:
The Druze minority in Sweida, Syria, is now the only group that hasn't accepted central government authority. How does the end of an independent Kurdish area impact Druze plans for a different, divided kind of Syria?

This week, Syria's Kurdish minority agreed to dissolve what had been their almost 14-year-long experiment in independent rule.

During the Syrian civil war, which began in 2011, the Kurds consolidated their authority over a large part of northeastern Syria, and wanted to maintain that after the civil war ended. But as Kurdish leader Mazloum Abdi said this week, "circumstances have changed."

Kurdish fighting forces, which go by the name of the Syrian Democratic Forces, or SDF, will now be integrated into the general Syrian military, and the oil-rich area they ruled will come under the authority of the central government.

All this means that Sweida province, home to much of Syria's Druze minority, is now the only area not to have accepted the authority of the central government.

There is no doubt that the change in the situation with Syria's Kurdish community will affect what is happening in Sweida, experts say.

When Omer Ozkizilcik, a nonresident senior fellow at US think tank, the Atlantic Council's Syria Project, met with Sheikh Hikmat al-Hijri in early 2025, the Druze leader said he was in daily phone contact with Abdi.

"He said that they were coordinating all their efforts and that they had a similar political vision for Syria — that is, decentralized with autonomous regions," said Ozkizilcik. "He basically repeated the Israeli approach, where they believe Syria should be divided, with an autonomous zone on the coast for the Alawite [minority], for the SDF in the northeast, and then in the south for the Druze. That shows that al-Hijiri's political vision was highly dependent on his alliance with the SDF."

That idea is no longer feasible. "Basically it puts an end to this vision of a fragmented, weak and decentralized Syria," the Ankara-based analyst argued.

That is also probably the reason why, earlier this week, al-Hijri again emphasized the Druze ties to Israel, Ozkizilcik suggested.

On Monday in Sweida, al-Hijiri declared the Druze an "inseparable part of the state of Israel."

​​​​​​But it's clear that having Israel annex Sweida would be very difficult for a number of reasons, including geography and demographics. Sweida is also still dependent on the central Syrian government. Despite it being impossible for government forces to enter the area, Sweida still receives public services, salaries, pensions, power and water from Damascus.

The exclusion of government forces began after intercommunal violence in Sweida in July 2025 . Fighting started between Druze and Bedouin locals. Government forces...
body.zh: 叙利亚苏维达的德鲁兹少数民族是目前唯一不接受中央政府权威的群体。独立库尔德地区的终结如何影响德鲁兹人建立一个不同的、分裂的叙利亚的计划？ 本周，叙利亚库尔德少数民族同意终止他们长达近 14 年的独立统治实验。 在 2011 年开始的叙利亚内战期间，库尔德人巩固了对叙利亚东北部大部分地区的权力，并希望在内战结束后维持这种权力。但正如库尔德领导人马兹鲁姆·阿卜迪本周所说，“情况已经发生了变化。” 名为“叙利亚民主力量”（SDF）的库尔德武装现在将并入叙利亚军队，他们统治的石油资源丰富的地区将置于中央政府的管辖之下。 所有这一切意味着，叙利亚德鲁兹少数民族大部分人居住的苏韦达省现在是唯一不接受中央政府权威的地区。 专家表示，毫无疑问，叙利亚库尔德社区局势的变化将影响苏韦达的局势。 2025 年初，当美国智囊团大西洋理事会叙利亚项目的非常驻高级研究员奥马尔·奥兹克兹吉克 (Omer Ozkizilcik) 会见谢赫·希克马特·希吉里 (Sheikh Hikmat al-Hijri) 时，这位德鲁兹领导人表示，他每天都与阿卜迪保持电话联系。 厄兹基济尔奇克说：“他说，他们正在协调所有努力，并且对叙利亚有类似的政治愿景，即通过自治区进行权力下放。” “他基本上重复了以色列的做法，他们认为叙利亚应该被划分，在沿海为阿拉维派（少数民族）建立一个自治区，在东北部为自卫队建立一个自治区，然后在南部为德鲁兹人建立一个自治区。这表明圣希里的政治愿景高度依赖于他与自卫队的联盟。” 这个想法已经不可行了。这位驻安卡拉的分析人士认为，“基本上，它结束了叙利亚支离破碎、虚弱和权力分散的愿景。” 厄兹克兹齐克表示，这也可能是本周早些时候阿尔希里再次强调德鲁兹派与以色列关系的原因。 周一，阿尔希吉里在苏维达宣布德鲁兹派是“以色列国不可分割的一部分”。 ​​​​​​但很明显，由于地理和人口等多种原因，让以色列吞并苏韦达将非常困难。苏维达还仍然依赖叙利亚中央政府。尽管政府军无法进入该地区，苏维达仍然从大马士革获得公共服务、工资、养老金、电力和水。 2025 年 7 月苏韦达发生部族间暴力事件后，政府军开始被排除在外。德鲁兹人和贝都因人当地人之间爆发了战斗。政府军...

reflection.en: As the Syrian civil war's landscape shifts, the Druze minority in Sweida faces a complex future, being the last holdout against central government authority. The situation underscores the persistent challenge of achieving lasting peace and stability in a fractured region, where dialogue and mutual understanding are crucial for any path forward.
reflection.zh: 随着叙利亚内战的格局发生变化，斯韦达地区的德鲁兹少数民族面临着复杂的未来，他们是反对中央政府管辖的最后一个群体。这一局势凸显了在一个分裂的地区实现持久和平与稳定的持续挑战，在此背景下，对话和相互理解是任何前进道路的关键。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Uganda: World's 'youngest monarch' dies aged 34
title.zh: 乌干达：“世界最年轻君主”34岁逝世

summary.en: Oyo Nyimba, recognized as the world's youngest reigning monarch when he took the throne of Uganda's Tooro kingdom in 1995 at age 3, has died in his mid-30s.
summary.zh: 乌干达托罗王国君主奥约·宁巴于34岁英年早逝。他于1995年三岁时登基，曾被认为是世界上最年轻的在位君主。

body.zh: 奥约·宁巴（Oyo Nyimba）曾被认为是世界上最年轻的在位君主，现已去世，年仅 30 多岁。作为乌干达传统君主之一，他于1995年登上托罗王国王位，年仅3岁。 托罗总理周四晚间宣布，乌干达前殖民传统王国托罗的国王奥约·宁巴 (Oyo Nyimba) 去世，年仅 34 岁。 托罗地区领导人卡尔文·阿姆斯特朗·卢米埃尔·阿基基 (Calvin Armstrong Rwomiire Akiiki) 在社交媒体上表示：“我怀着深切的悲伤和沉重的心情宣布托罗的奥穆卡马国王奥约·宁巴·卡班巴·卡班巴·伊古鲁·鲁基迪四世去世。” 乌干达是一个共和国，由议会和名义上选举产生的国家元首、长期任职的总统约韦里·穆塞韦尼（Yoweri Museveni）统治，他自 1986 年以来一直执政。 但该国保留了几个传统的君主制，这些君主制仍然按照前殖民时期的方式统治着它们的王国。他们的权力在很大程度上是象征性的，但他们具有相当大的文化和社会影响力。 尽管 1962 年脱离英国殖民统治独立后，一位共和党总统表示他希望统一这个新生国家，从而禁止了传统君主制，但穆塞韦尼还是在 1993 年恢复了传统君主制。 奥约·宁巴 (Oyo Nyimba) 可以说是其中最知名的一个，尤其是因为他不寻常的故事，他于 1995 年年仅 3 岁就登上了王位。 地区领导人阿基基 (Akiiki) 表示，国王于周四晚些时候去世，但没有透露死因。他表示，稍后将发表一份包含葬礼和哀悼安排等更多细节的官方声明。 他呼吁托罗人民“在这个困难时期保持团结、冷静和祈祷”。 阿基基还对这位未婚的年轻国王发表了一项令人惊讶的说法，他从很小的时候起就被视为乌干达最有资格的单身汉。 “王室的连续性是有保证的，”他说。 “陛下留下一位王子作为继承人，他的身份将在适当的时候按照托罗王国的传统和习俗正式公布。” 奥约·宁巴（Oyo Nyimba）的去世引发了网上的悲痛和乌干达全国的广泛报道。 奥约出生于1992年4月16日，是已故奥姆卡马·帕特里克·大卫·马修·卡博约·奥利米三世和女王贝斯特·凯米吉萨·卡博约​​的第二个孩子，有两个姐妹。 1995年，他父亲去世后，他在乌干达西部靠近刚果边境的托罗地区继承了王位。 他作为现代“男孩国王”的不同寻常的地位在他统治初期引起了相当大的兴趣，包括多次访问托罗的前利比亚强人穆阿迈尔·卡扎菲等世界领导人。 奥约的母亲是他年轻时的重要顾问之一，总统约韦里也是如此……

reflection.en: The news of Oyo Nyimba, who became the Tooro kingdom's monarch at just three years old and died at 34, reminds us of the universal truth of human mortality. Despite his unique position and early ascent to power, his life, like all others, was appointed a finite span. This poignant reminder encourages us to reflect on the preciousness of each day and the...
reflection.zh: 乌干达托罗王国君主奥约·宁巴三岁登基，却在34岁英年早逝，这则新闻提醒我们人类生命有限的普遍真理。尽管他地位独特，年幼即位，但他的生命，如同所有人的生命一样，都有其注定的期限。这个令人深思的提醒，促使我们反思每一天的宝贵，以及所有人都将面对的最终现实。

verse.textEn: Just as people are destined to die once, and after that to face judgment.
verse.textZh: 按着定命，人人都有一死，死后且有审判。

title.en: Australian woman feared missing in Nepal flood makes contact as disaster worsens
title.zh: 尼泊尔洪灾中失踪的澳大利亚女性已与家人取得联系，灾情持续恶化

summary.en: An Australian woman has survived catastrophic flooding and an ice avalanche on the Nepal-China border, making contact with her family from a remote area. At least 38 other Australians remain missing as heavy rain and debris flows continue to hamper rescue efforts in the country's worst natural disaster in more than a...
summary.zh: 一名在尼泊尔与中国边境遭遇灾难性洪水的澳大利亚女性已与家人取得联系。在尼泊尔十多年来最严重的自然灾害中，至少仍有38名澳大利亚人失踪，而持续的大雨和泥石流使救援工作变得异常困难。

body.en:
Australian authorities are urgently trying to reach a woman who made contact with family after surviving catastrophic flooding on the Nepal-China border.

The Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT) is engaging with local authorities on plans to assist the woman, who is understood to have been last reported in a remote area several days' hike from Kathmandu.

At least 38 Australians remain missing after an ice avalanche on Wednesday triggered Nepal's worst natural disaster in more than a decade.

Heavy continued rainfall is making rescue conditions difficult and unpredictable.

Further severe flooding, landslides and debris flows are predicted in the affected areas of Nepal and Tibet while a lake formed by the landslide has started to overflow.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

At least 538 people have died, Nepalese authorities said, while almost 1,000 remain missing.

Australian woman Sumi Adhikari was on a pilgrimage on the China-Nepal border when the catastrophic flash flooding hit.

Her husband Kailash Mansowar, who has not heard from her since, has travelled to the region from Sydney to find her, guided only by her iPhone's last location.

"I am here in Nepal now (since) yesterday and working with local authorities to find further information," he told the Australian Associated Press (AAP) on Friday.

Like many missing Australians, Adhikari was undertaking a group tour, in her case with the Isha Foundation.

She left Kathmandu on 14 August after flying from Sydney to trek to a sacred site near Tibet's Mount Kailash.

"Even the smallest piece of information could help bring her home," a widely shared post on social media announcing her disappearance reads.

A separate group of 15 Australians, including two boys aged 11 and 14, were travelling with US-based tourism operator Himalayan Glacier Adventure and Travel Company.

Sydney doctor Manoj Dharmaratnam, who was invited to join the sacred pilgrimage but chose not to go, prescribed several of his friends altitude medication and conducted injury assessments before they left Australia.

"One of them had an injury and I did tell her, maybe you're not fit to go on this trek," Dr Dharmaratnam told AAP.

"She actually called up and cancelled her trip ... but then she said I've bought the ticket, so I might as well go."

The Himalayan Glacier group included a well-respected Sydney couple with two sons in their 20s, both studying medicine in NSW, he said.

At least four Australians were travelling separately to tour groups, Foreign Minister Penny Wong said on Friday.

Wong said the federal government would send additional personnel to the region and unveiled a $5 million assistance package and...
body.zh: 澳大利亚当局正在紧急联系一名在中尼边境灾难性洪水中幸存下来并与家人取得联系的妇女。 外交和贸易部（DFAT）正在与地方当局合作制定援助该女子的计划，据了解，该女子最后一次被报告是在距离加德满都徒步旅行几天的偏远地区。 周三发生的冰雪崩引发了尼泊尔​​十多年来最严重的自然灾害，目前至少有 38 名澳大利亚人失踪。 持续的强降雨使救援条件变得困难且难以预测。 预计尼泊尔和西藏受影响地区将出现进一步严重的洪水、山体滑坡和泥石流，山体滑坡形成的湖泊已开始溢出。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 尼泊尔当局称，至少 538 人死亡，近 1,000 人仍失踪。 灾难性山洪爆发时，澳大利亚妇女苏米·阿迪卡里 (Sumi Adhikari) 正在中尼边境朝圣。 她的丈夫凯拉什·曼索瓦 (Kailash Mansowar) 从悉尼前往该地区寻找她，此后一直没有她的消息，只能依靠她 iPhone 的最后位置来引导。 “从昨天起，我现在就在尼泊尔，并与地方当局合作寻找更多信息，”他周五告诉澳大利亚美联社（AAP）。 和许多失踪的澳大利亚人一样，阿迪卡里正在参加团体旅行，她的团队是伊莎基金会。 8月14日，她从悉尼飞往西藏冈仁波齐附近的一处圣地，随后离开加德满都。 “即使是最小的信息也能帮助她回家，”社交媒体上一篇广泛转发的宣布她失踪的帖子写道。 另一个由 15 名澳大利亚人组成的团体，其中包括两名年龄分别为 11 岁和 14 岁的男孩，与美国旅游运营商喜马拉雅冰川探险和旅游公司一起旅行。 悉尼医生马诺吉·达马拉特南（Manoj Dharmaratnam）受邀参加神圣的朝圣活动，但选择不去，他给他的几位朋友开了高原药物，并在他们离开澳大利亚之前进行了伤情评估。 达马拉特南博士告诉澳联社：“其中一人受了伤，我确实告诉她，也许你不适合进行这次长途跋涉。” “她实际上打电话取消了行程……但后来她说我已经买了票，所以我还是走吧。” 他说，喜马拉雅冰川小组包括一对德高望重的悉尼夫妇，他们有两个 20 多岁的儿子，两人都在新南威尔士州学习医学。 外交部长黄英贤周五表示，至少有四名澳大利亚人分别参加旅行团。 黄表示，联邦政府将向该地区派遣更多人员，并公布了 500 万美元的援助计划，...

reflection.zh: 这名幸存者从距离加德满都数天路程的偏远地区传回消息，在巨大的灾难中带来了一线希望。然而，随着冰崩后仍有数十人失踪，我们被提醒在自然力量的剧变面前，生命是何等脆弱。我们仰望雅伟，祈求祂保佑那些仍被困的人，并赐予在变幻莫测的环境中工作的救援队坚韧的力量。

title.en: Norway's King Harald V, a unifying force who weathered family storms, dies at 89
title.zh: 挪威国王哈拉尔五世逝世，享年89岁，他是一位团结力量，曾经历家庭风暴

summary.en: King Harald V of Norway, Europe's oldest living monarch, died on Friday at the age of 89 after more than three decades on the throne. He was known as a unifying figure and reformer who navigated multiple crises for the royal family.
summary.zh: 挪威国王哈拉尔五世于周五去世，享年89岁，他曾是欧洲在位时间最长的君主，在位三十多年。他以团结国家的力量和改革者的形象而闻名，曾带领王室度过多次危机。

body.en:
Norway's King Harald, a reformer who emerged from the shadow of his well-loved, extrovert father and spent more than three decades on the throne, died on Friday at the age of 89, the royal palace said, at a time of multiple crises for the Norwegian royal family.

"King Harald passed away peacefully at Oslo University Hospital on Friday 28 August," the royal palace said on its website.

Harald, who was Europe's oldest living monarch, was taken to hospital on 17 August. The palace said doctors were treating him for a bacterial infection in his blood.

In 2024, he had been hospitalised for an infection while on holiday in Malaysia and received a temporary pacemaker at a hospital there. The Norwegian armed forces flew him back home, and he was later fitted with a permanent device.

That same year, Harald, Norway's ceremonial head of state since 1991, said he would reduce the number of official engagements he took part in but ruled out abdication, insisting that his oath as king was for life.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Crown Princess Mette-Marit, married to Harald's son Crown Prince Haakon, is facing intense scrutiny for her friendship with the late sex offender Jeffrey Epstein, a relationship for which she has apologised.

Her son Marius Hoiby, born from a relationship predating her marriage to Haakon, was found guilty in June of two out of four counts of rape and one count of domestic violence and sentenced to four years in prison after a seven-week trial. Both he and the prosecution have appealed the sentence.

Two days after Marius was convicted, the palace said Mette-Marit had undergone a successful lung transplant, without specifying when the procedure took place.

After several weeks of recovery in hospital, she returned home and celebrated her silver wedding anniversary with Haakon in August.

Support for the monarchy dropped to 60 per cent in February 2026, from 70 per cent the previous month, according to a Norstat poll published by state broadcaster NRK, rising slightly to 64 per cent in May.

Harald has remained consistently popular with Norwegians. According to the February poll, he was the royal who best represented the Norwegian royal family, with a score of 9.2, on a scale of one to 10.

A great-great-grandchild of Britain's Queen Victoria, Harald acceded to the throne in 1991 and gradually introduced modern touches that brought a ceremonial post, seen mainly as a symbol of national independence, into the 21st century.

The popular king played a crucial role in comforting the nation in times of mourning.

When far-right, anti-Islam convicted terrorist Anders Behring Breivik killed 77 people in 2011 in Oslo and on Utøya...
body.zh: 王宫称，挪威国王哈拉尔是一位改革家，他摆脱了深受爱戴、性格外向的父亲的影响，在位三十多年，于周五去世，享年 89 岁，当时挪威王室正面临多重危机。 王宫在其网站上表示：“哈拉尔国王于 8 月 28 日星期五在奥斯陆大学医院平静地去世。” 哈拉尔德是欧洲在世最年长的君主，他于 8 月 17 日被送往医院。白金汉宫表示，医生正在治疗他血液中的细菌感染。 2024年，他在马来西亚度假时因感染住院，并在当地医院接受了临时起搏器。挪威武装部队把他送回了家，后来他被安装了永久性装置。 同年，自 1991 年起担任挪威礼仪国家元首的哈拉尔表示，他将减少参加的官方活动次数，但排除退位的可能性，并坚称他的国王誓言是终身的。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 与哈拉尔德儿子哈康王储结婚的王储妃梅特-玛丽特因与已故性犯罪者杰弗里·爱泼斯坦的友谊而面临严格审查，她已为这种关系道歉。 她的儿子马吕斯·霍伊比 (Marius Hoiby) 是她与哈康 (Haakon) 结婚前的一段关系所生，六月份被判犯有四分之二的强奸罪和一项家庭暴力罪，经过七周的审判后被判处四年监禁。他和检方都对判决提出上诉。 马吕斯被定罪两天后，宫殿表示梅特-马里特已成功接受肺移植手术，但没有具体说明手术何时进行。 在医院康复几周后，她回到家，并于八月与哈康庆祝了银婚纪念日。 根据国家广播公司 NRK 发布的 Norstat 民意调查显示，2026 年 2 月，对君主制的支持率从上个月的 70% 降至 60%，5 月份略有上升至 64%。 哈拉尔一直深受挪威人的欢迎。根据2月份的民意调查，他是最能代表挪威王室的王室成员，得分为9.2（从1到10）。 哈拉尔德是英国维多利亚女王的曾曾孙，他于 1991 年继承王位，并逐渐引入现代风格，将主要被视为国家独立象征的礼仪职位带入了 21 世纪。 这位受欢迎的国王在哀悼时刻安慰国家方面发挥了至关重要的作用。 2011 年，极右翼反伊斯兰恐怖分子安德斯·贝林·布雷维克 (Anders Behring Breivik) 在奥斯陆和于特岛杀害了 77 人……

reflection.en: King Harald V's long reign as a unifying force in Norway, even through family crises, reminds us of the profound impact leaders can have when they prioritize justice and righteousness. His role as a reformer over more than three decades reflects a commitment to the well-being of his people. Yahweh calls all those in authority to govern with integrity and...
reflection.zh: 挪威国王哈拉尔五世长期以来作为国家的团结力量，即使在家庭危机中也如此，这提醒我们，当领导者优先考虑公义和正直时，他们能产生深远的影响。他三十多年来的改革者角色，反映了他对人民福祉的承诺。雅伟呼召所有掌权者以正直和怜悯治理，成为他们国家稳定的存在。

title.en: How Australians can help those impacted by devastating Nepal floods
title.zh: 澳大利亚人如何帮助受尼泊尔毁灭性洪水影响的人们

summary.en: Australian charities have launched a joint appeal to aid communities devastated by floods and landslides along the Nepal-China border. Thousands are in urgent need of shelter, food, clean water, and medical care after their homes and infrastructure were destroyed.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚慈善机构已发起联合募捐，以援助尼泊尔-中国边境受洪水和山体滑坡摧毁的社区。在房屋和基础设施被毁后，成千上万的人迫切需要住所、食物、清洁饮用水和医疗援助。

body.en:
Entire communities have been devastated by severe flooding and landslides along the Nepal-Tibet border, with homes, roads, bridges and critical infrastructure destroyed.

Search and rescue operations remain underway, while thousands of people are in urgent need of shelter, food, clean drinking water and medical assistance.

In response, 14 Australian charities have joined forces to launch a national appeal.

The Emergency Action Alliance (EAA) has launched the Nepal Flood Disaster Appeal, bringing together a variety of charities to support communities affected by the disaster.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The alliance says donations will help provide immediate humanitarian assistance, including emergency shelter, food, safe drinking water, hygiene supplies and medical care.

Access to some affected communities remains difficult, with damaged roads and ongoing weather conditions hampering efforts to reach people in need.

Australians are encouraged to donate through the EAA website or by calling 1300 939 000.

The charities participating in the appeal are Save the Children Australia, Plan International Australia, Oxfam Australia, Australia for UNHCR, ActionAid Australia, CARE Australia, Caritas Australia, ADRA, Act for Peace, Anglican Overseas Aid, Australian Lutheran World Service, Baptist World Aid Australia, CBM Australia and Tearfund Australia.

EAA executive director Kerren Morris said the appeal provided Australians with a trusted way to support people affected by the disaster.

"Emergency shelter, food, safe drinking water and medical support are urgently needed now, while longer-term recovery efforts will continue for many months," she said in a statement.

The charities involved bring different areas of humanitarian expertise to the response, with organisations and their local partners working to provide immediate assistance to affected communities.

Save the Children is focusing on supporting children and families affected by humanitarian emergencies.

Oxfam Australia's humanitarian work includes support for essential services such as clean water, sanitation and emergency assistance.

Australia for UNHCR is the UN refugee agency's national partner in Australia, and is supporting humanitarian assistance through the UNHCR network.

The charities involved are continuing to assess the scale of the disaster and humanitarian needs in affected communities.

The EAA says its members are working to determine where support is most urgently needed as search and rescue operations continue.

The appeal has been endorsed by the Australian Council for International Development (ACFID), the peak body for Australian non-government organisations...

This situation calls us to action, reminding us of our responsibility to advocate for the vulnerable and provide tangible support to those facing such immense hardship. Proverbs 31:8-9 urges us to 'Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for...
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔毁灭性的洪水使整个社区迫切需要基本生活必需品。这种情况呼唤我们采取行动，提醒我们有责任为弱势群体发声，并为那些面临巨大困难的人提供切实的支持。《箴言》31:8-9 敦促我们：“你们要为不能说话的辩护，为所有孤苦者伸张正义。你们要开口说话，公正地审判，为困苦和贫穷的人伸张正义。”

Rescuers are finding only ruins, and the cost of rebuilding is estimated to be billions of dollars as survivors mourn their...

body.en: Nepali minister says cost of rebuilding likely to be billions of dollars as death toll rises to 626, with seven confirmed dead in Tibet ‘The flood took everything I have’: survivors grieve for relatives and homes swept away in Nepal Chinese rescuers find ‘nothing but ruins’ at border crossing as Nepal seeks help to ID and store the dead Outside the army camp in the Nuwakot district of Nepal, people run their fingers down the sheets of paper pinned to the wall, scanning the growing list of those reported missing for news of loved ones. Nepal’s foreign minister, Shisir Khanal, has appealed for international support to help rebuild the country after the floods, saying reconstruction efforts could run into “billions of dollars” AFP reports.
