Surveillance camera footage from the worst-hit Gyirong border crossing complex showed huge torrents of water and debris on Wednesday engulfing buildings and people trying to flee. Only ⁠on Friday were rescuers able to reach the area. Continue reading...
body.zh: 尼泊尔和中国在遭受洪水袭击的喜马拉雅山地区继续开展艰巨的搜救行动 视觉指南：致命洪水是如何展开的 尼泊尔-西藏山洪暴发——最新消息 随着尼泊尔和中国在遭受洪水袭击的喜马拉雅山地区继续开展艰巨的救援行动，中国救援队首次抵达几乎被摧毁的吉隆边境口岸综合体，发现“除了废墟之外什么也没有”。受灾最严重的吉隆边境口岸综合体的监控录像显示，周三，巨大的水流和碎片吞没了建筑物和试图逃离的人们。直到周五救援人员才抵达该地区。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The surveillance footage of the Gyirong border complex being engulfed by debris is a sobering reminder of how quickly our physical security can vanish. As rescuers sift through the ruins in the Himalayas, we are reminded that human strength has limits against the elements. In such moments of total loss, we look to Yahweh as a refuge and strength that...
reflection.zh: 吉隆口岸被泥石流吞没的监控画面令人警醒，它提醒我们物质的安全感是多么转瞬即逝。当救援人员在喜马拉雅山的废墟中搜寻时，我们看到人类的力量在自然灾害面前是有限的。在这样彻底丧失保障的时刻，我们仰望雅伟，祂是我们的避难所和力量，即便在脚下的土地崩塌之时，祂依然是那随时的帮助。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: Death toll from Nepal-Tibet floods rises to over 600
title.zh: 尼泊尔-西藏洪灾死亡人数升至600多人

summary.en: Heavy rain is complicating an already difficult rescue effort, as hundreds remain missing three days after deadly flash floods hit the Nepal-Tibet border region. The latest death toll from the devastating flash flood along the Nepal-Tibet border was reported on Saturday to be over 600, as frantic rescue operations to...
summary.zh: 致命的山洪袭击尼泊尔-西藏边境地区三天后，大雨使本已艰难的救援工作更加复杂，仍有数百人失踪。据报道，周六尼泊尔-西藏边境地区毁灭性山洪的最新死亡人数已超过600人，搜寻数百名失踪人员的紧急救援行动进入第四天。根据尼泊尔灾害机构的数据，尼泊尔的死亡人数现已达到626人，包括外国人在内的2,426人仍然失踪。在边境另一侧的...

body.en:
Heavy rain is complicating an already difficult rescue effort, as hundreds remain missing three days after deadly flash floods hit the Nepal-Tibet border region.

The latest death toll from the devastating flash flood along the Nepal-Tibet border was reported on Saturday to be over 600, as frantic rescue operations to search for hundreds of missing people entered a fourth day.

According to Nepal 's disaster agency, the death toll in Nepal now stands at 626, with 2,426 people — including foreigners — still missing.

Across the border in Tibet, China's state news agency, Xinhua, has confirmed seven deaths and reported 554 missing individuals.

A glacial collapse on Wednesday sent rock, ice, mud and debris surging through the Himalayan mountain river systems below.

The flood swept through areas near the Chinese border, ravaging entire towns and damaging hydropower plants.

Nepal army spokesperson Raja Ram Basnet told the media on Saturday that helicopter operations were on hold until the weather improved.

Rescuers are battling thick layers of mud in the affected areas, which is making it difficult for helicopters to land and take off.

The army has located people trapped in a tunnel of the Trishuli 3A hydropower project in Nepal's Rasuwa District. Over 100 people are believed to be inside the tunnel filled with mud.

Basnet said that rescuers were struggling to locate the entry points of the tunnel and had made use of  baskets and ropes to reach some people. There are also limited places for helicopters to land in the area.

On Friday, Nepal's Army shared visuals of some people being rescued from the tunnel. The survivors were seen stuck in the mud, while officials crawled through the sludge and held out their hands to them.

Nepalese authorities said that the bodies of many flood victims have also been found dozens of kilometers from the disaster zone in Chitwan District in southern Nepal, which borders India.

Meanwhile, Indian authorities said they recovered the bodies of seven people who were swept downstream from Nepal and believe them to be flood victims.

Late on Friday, Nepal's Foreign Minister Shisir Khanal told the Reuters news agency that his country needed equipment, along with technical knowledge in tunnel rescue operations.

Khanal also told Reuters that Nepal did not need help with search and rescue operations but needed assistance in opening transport and communication lines in places where bridges were destroyed, identification of dead bodies, DNA testing and storage of bodies for a longer timeframe.

"We have already made requests for such ⁠specialized ​services and technical assistance in areas where we don't have enough expertise and technical know-how,"  ​Reuters quoted Khanal as...
body.zh: 大雨使本已困难的救援工作变得更加复杂，在致命的山洪袭击尼泊尔和西藏边境地区三天后，仍有数百人失踪。 周六，据报道尼泊尔-西藏边境毁灭性山洪造成的最新死亡人数已超过 600 人，搜寻数百名失踪人员的疯狂救援行动已进入第四天。 据尼泊尔救灾机构称，尼泊尔目前死亡人数为 626 人，仍有 2,426 人失踪，其中包括外国人。 在边境另一边的西藏，中国官方通讯社新华社已确认 7 人死亡，并报告了 554 人失踪。 周三的冰川崩塌使岩石、冰、泥土和碎片涌入下面的喜马拉雅山区河流系统。 洪水席卷了中国边境附近的地区，摧毁了整个城镇并损坏了水电站。 尼泊尔陆军发言人拉贾·拉姆·巴斯内特 (Raja Ram Basnet) 周六对媒体表示，直升机行动暂停，直至天气好转。 救援人员正在受影响地区与厚厚的泥浆作斗争，这使得直升机难以着陆和起飞。 尼泊尔拉苏瓦地区Trishuli 3A水电项目隧道内，军队已找到被困人员。据信，隧道内有超过 100 人，里面充满了泥土。 巴斯内特说，救援人员正在努力找到隧道的入口点，并使用篮子和绳索来救助一些人。该地区直升机的降落地点也有限。 周五，尼泊尔军队分享了一些人从隧道中被救出的画面。人们看到幸存者被困在泥里，而官员们则爬过污泥并向他们伸出双手。 尼泊尔当局表示，在与印度接壤的尼泊尔南部奇旺地区，距离灾区数十公里的地方也发现了许多洪水遇难者的尸体。 与此同时，印度当局表示，他们找到了从尼泊尔下游被冲走的七人的尸体，并认为他们是洪水受害者。 周五晚些时候，尼泊尔外交部长希西尔·卡纳尔告诉路透社，尼泊尔需要设备以及隧道救援行动的技术知识。 卡纳尔还告诉路透社，尼泊尔不需要搜救行动方面的帮助，但需要援助来开通桥梁被毁地区的交通和通讯线路、尸体身份识别、DNA测试以及尸体的长期储存。 路透社援引卡纳尔的话称：“我们已经在我们没有足够专业知识和技术知识的领域提出了此类专业服务和技术援助的请求。”

reflection.en: The devastating flash floods along the Nepal-Tibet border, leaving over 600 dead and hundreds missing, bring immense sorrow. In moments of such profound loss, the shortest verse in the Bible, "Jesus wept," reminds us that grief is a deeply human and even divine response to suffering and death. Our hearts go out to the families in the Nepal-Tibet border...
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔-西藏边境地区毁灭性的山洪造成600多人死亡，数百人失踪，带来了巨大的悲痛。在如此深重的损失面前，圣经中最短的经文“雅伟哭了”提醒我们，悲伤是对苦难和死亡的一种深刻的人性甚至神性的回应。我们的心与尼泊尔-西藏边境地区那些正在应对这场悲剧的家庭同在。

verse.textEn: Jesus wept.
verse.textZh: 耶稣哭了。

title.en: Hilarity, unease and relief: games show China is not over the finish line in humanoid robot race
title.zh: 好笑、不安和宽慰：机器人大赛表明中国在人形机器人竞赛中尚未冲过终点线

summary.en: The World Humanoid Robot Games in Beijing demonstrated China's progress in humanoid robotics, but also highlighted current limitations, including technical malfunctions. The event generated a mixed public reaction of amusement, concern, and reassurance, as US rivals prepare their own robot launches.
summary.zh: 北京世界人形机器人大赛展示了中国在人形机器人技术方面的进步，但也凸显了当前的局限性，包括技术故障。此次活动引发了公众好笑、不安和宽慰的复杂反应，与此同时，美国竞争对手也正准备推出自己的机器人产品。

body.en: World Humanoid Robot Games showcased leaps Beijing has made in the tech, but also highlighted limitations as US rivals prepare their own launches With exploding pelvises, enough comic pratfalls for a Buster Keaton show reel and the odd moment of ruthless violence, the World Humanoid Robot Games in Beijing gripped the world this week with an unsettling mixture of hilarity, trepidation and relief. The five-day showcase staked out China’s claim to undisputed leadership in humanoid robotics as android martial artists landed knockout roundhouse kicks and robot teams marched into the arena heralded by flag-waving captains astride giant robotic dogs. The games’ blue-riband event, the 100m, did not disappoint when the robot-sprinters ran quicker than Usain Bolt before slamming mindlessly into a padded wall in a blaze of sparks, flames and flying mechanical limbs. Continue reading...
body.zh: 世界人形机器人运动会展示了北京在技术方面取得的飞跃，但也凸显了美国竞争对手准备推出自己的产品时的局限性。本周在北京举行的世界人形机器人运动会，伴随着爆炸的骨盆、巴斯特·基顿表演录像中足够的喜剧性失误以及残酷暴力的奇怪时刻，给世界带来了一种令人不安的欢闹、恐惧和宽慰的混合体。为期五天的展示会凸显了中国在人形机器人领域无可争议的领导地位，机器人武术家们踢出了致命的回旋踢，机器人队在挥舞着旗帜的队长骑着巨型机器狗的带领下步入竞技场。本届奥运会的蓝丝带项目 100 米赛并没有让人失望，机器人短跑运动员跑得比尤塞恩·博尔特更快，然后在火花、火焰和飞行的机械肢体中漫无目的地撞到了有衬垫的墙上。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The recent World Humanoid Robot Games in Beijing showcased impressive technological leaps, yet also revealed limitations like 'exploding pelvises' and 'comic pratfalls,' leaving observers with a mix of 'hilarity, trepidation and relief.' This reminds us that while human ingenuity can achieve many things, as 1 Corinthians 10:23 suggests, not everything that...
reflection.zh: 最近在北京举行的世界人形机器人大赛展示了令人瞩目的技术飞跃，但也暴露出“骨盆爆炸”和“滑稽摔倒”等局限性，让观察者们感到“好笑、不安和宽慰”。这提醒我们，正如哥林多前书10:23所说，人类的聪明才智可以成就许多事，但并非所有可能之事都真正有益或具建设性。在我们持续发展先进技术时，智慧呼唤我们不仅要思考我们“能”做什么，更要思考什么才能真正造福全人类。

verse.textEn: "I have the right to do anything," you say — but not everything is beneficial. "I have the right to do anything" — but not everything is constructive.
verse.textZh: 凡事都可行，但不都有益处；凡事都可行，但不都造就人。

title.en: Footage of Tibet floods isn't being shown in China - and we know little about victims there
title.zh: 西藏洪水画面未在中国境内播放，受害者信息鲜为人知

summary.en: Dramatic footage of deadly flash flooding in Tibet, specifically at Gyirong Port, which swept away everything in its path and claimed hundreds of lives, has been largely hidden from public view and censored on the internet within China.
summary.zh: 西藏吉隆口岸发生致命山洪，洪水冲毁一切，造成数百人死亡，但相关震撼画面和信息在中国境内被大量隐藏，并在互联网上受到审查。

body.en:
The dramatic footage was almost impossible to miss. A torrent of water tearing through Gyirong Port, one of the main border crossings between Nepal and Tibet, sweeping away all in its path as hundreds of people fled for their lives.

The scenes, captured by CCTV cameras, quickly spread on social media and onto screens around the world.

Only a single still-frame shot has been broadcast so far by the country's state-run flagship news bulletin.

It has also been difficult to find the video on China's heavily censored internet. It is just as hard to even find posts describing the flash flooding that has claimed hundreds of lives, with just as many still unaccounted for since Wednesday.

Beijing has launched a massive rescue operation involving hundreds of emergency workers, which is continuing, and President Xi Jinping chaired an emergency meeting with officials to co-ordinate efforts.

But when you compare the country's internet content to what much of the world has been seeing online these past few days, China's firewall becomes more visible than ever.

Tibet, which Beijing annexed in the 1950s, had long resisted rule by the Chinese Communist Party.

China has quashed protests over the years, sometimes violently, and has been accused of grave rights violations in the Buddhist region. It has labelled the exiled spiritual leader, the Dalai Lama, a separatist.

That history means the very name Tibet draws China's censors. Beijing's sensitivities are especially apparent at times likes this.

There have been daily updates on the missing and the dead, and Beijing has also been posting updates on the rescue operations, as well as the dangers posed by a barrier lake that has been at risk of overflowing.

On Saturday, new footage from Chinese state media showed rescue teams wandering in a wasteland of mud and rock while calling out to anyone trapped.

But there is little detail beyond that. There are no accounts from survivors in Tibet, and almost no user-generated footage showing the deadly moments or their aftermath.

We are yet to hear from anxious families of those missing. Trying to contact people there is near-impossible during regular times.

As a journalist who has covered North Korea, it has often been easier for me to contact interviewees in Pyongyang than it is in the Tibetan capital, Lhasa.

On Thursday night, as global headlines led on the devastation in a Himalayan valley, China's state broadcaster opened its main bulletin with the launch of Xi's new book, a selection of his "most important and fundamental works".

Foreign journalists cannot travel to Tibet without government permission. We have just a few hours to get as much information as we can on huge stories like this before videos are scrubbed and voices stifled.

Instead, we have to rely...
body.zh: 戏剧性的镜头几乎不可能被错过。尼泊尔和西藏之间的主要边境口岸之一吉隆口岸发生洪流，洪水冲垮了沿途的一切，数百人逃命。 这些场景被闭路电视摄像机捕捉到，迅速在社交媒体和世界各地的屏幕上传播。 到目前为止，该国官方旗舰新闻公报只播放了一个静态画面。 在中国严格审查的互联网上也很难找到这段视频。同样很难找到描述这场夺去了数百人生命的山洪的帖子，自周三以来仍有同样多的人下落不明。 北京已启动了涉及数百名应急人员的大规模救援行动，该行动仍在继续，国家主席习近平主持召开了官员紧急会议，协调救援行动。 但当你将中国的互联网内容与过去几天世界上大部分地区在网上看到的内容进行比较时，中国的防火墙变得比以往任何时候都更加明显。 北京在 20 世纪 50 年代吞并的西藏长期以来一直反抗中国共产党的统治。 多年来，中国镇压了抗议活动，有时甚至是暴力镇压，并被指控在佛教地区严重侵犯人权。它给流亡精神领袖达赖喇嘛贴上了分离主义者的标签。 这段历史意味着中国审查机构用“西藏”这个名字来命名。北京的敏感性在这种时候尤其明显。 每天都有关于失踪和死亡的最新消息，北京也一直在发布救援行动的最新消息，以及堰塞湖面临溢出风险所带来的危险。 周六，中国官方媒体的新镜头显示，救援队在一片泥泞和岩石的荒地上徘徊，同时向被困人员呼救。 但除此之外就没有什么细节了。没有西藏幸存者的叙述，也几乎没有用户生成的视频显示致命时刻或后果。 我们还没有收到失踪者焦急的家人的消息。平时想要联系那里的人几乎是不可能的。 作为一名报道朝鲜的记者，我在平壤联系受访者往往比在西藏首府拉萨更容易。 周四晚上，当全球头条新闻报道喜马拉雅山谷的灾难时，中国国家广播公司以习近平新书的发布作为其主要公报的开篇，该书精选了他的“最重要和最基础的著作”。 未经政府许可，外国记者不得前往西藏。在视频被删除、声音被压制之前，我们只有几个小时的时间来尽可能多地获取有关此类重大事件的信息。 相反，我们必须依靠...

reflection.en: The tragic flash flooding in Tibet, particularly at Gyirong Port, has left hundreds dead or unaccounted for, yet dramatic footage and details remain largely hidden from the Chinese public. Proverbs 31:8 calls us to open our mouths for the mute, reminding us of the moral imperative to acknowledge and amplify the suffering of the vulnerable. Even when...
reflection.zh: 西藏吉隆口岸的洪水灾情造成数百人死亡或失踪，然而，相关的震撼画面和详细信息在中国公众面前却被大量隐藏。箴言31:8呼吁我们为不能发声的人开口，提醒我们有道德责任去承认并放大弱势群体的苦难。即使信息被压制，受苦者的呼声依然回荡，敦促我们为他们的困境发出同情和声音。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Search continues as number missing in Nepal-Tibet floods rises to 2,478 – as it happened
title.zh: 尼泊尔-西藏山洪：尼泊尔失踪人数升至1924人——最新消息

summary.en: Nepal's disaster authority confirms a jump of over 400 in the total number of unaccounted for, with 579 deaths confirmed in Nepal and five in Tibet. Rescue efforts are underway, including a challenging operation to save people trapped in a tunnel at a hydropower project.
summary.zh: 尼泊尔灾难管理局证实，失踪总人数增加超过400人，尼泊尔已确认579人死亡，西藏5人死亡。救援工作正在进行中，包括一项艰难的行动，以营救被困在水电站项目隧道中的人员。

body.en: This live blog is now closed ‘The flood took everything I have’: survivors grieve for relatives and homes swept away in Nepal Visual guide: how the deadly flooding unfolded Tell us: have you been affected by the flash floods? More now on the Nepali army’s rescue operation to save about 100 people trapped in a tunnel at a hydropower project swamped by Wednesday’s flooding . “Two helicopters have been dispatched but it is challenging because it is tough to even locate the entry points of the tunnel,” army spokesperson Raja Ram Basnet told AFP. Relief efforts are also under way to provide the rescued people what they need. The army is still working to safely evacuate more than 100 people trapped in the same tunnel. Continue reading...
body.zh: 尼泊尔救灾当局确认下落不明人数激增400多人，尼泊尔确认579人死亡，西藏确认5人死亡 洪水救援工作恢复 视觉导览：致命洪水是如何展开的 告诉我们：您受到山洪暴发的影响吗？现在更多关于尼泊尔军队的救援行动，以拯救周三被洪水淹没的水力发电项目隧道中被困的约 100 人。陆军发言人拉贾·拉姆·巴斯内特告诉法新社：“已经派出两架直升机，但这具有挑战性，因为甚至很难找到隧道的入口点。”救援工作也在进行中，为获救人员提供他们所需要的东西。军队仍在努力安全疏散被困在同一条隧道中的 100 多人。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news from Nepal paints a grim picture of loss and devastation following the flash flood, with nearly 2,000 people still missing and hundreds confirmed dead. In moments of such profound tragedy, we are reminded of the ultimate hope found in Revelation 21:4, which speaks of a future where suffering, death, and mourning will be no more. This promise offers...
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔山洪爆发后，新闻报道了巨大的损失和破坏，近2000人仍下落不明，数百人确认死亡。在如此深切的悲剧中，我们被提醒启示录21:4所应许的终极盼望——一个不再有痛苦、死亡和哀伤的未来。这应许在当下的悲伤中带来慰藉。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: Satellite images reveal scale of flood devastation in Nepal villages
title.zh: 卫星图像揭示尼泊尔村庄洪灾破坏规模

summary.en: Satellite imagery has revealed the scale of devastation along Nepal's Trishuli River following a deadly flash flood triggered by a glacier collapse on Wednesday. The torrent destroyed villages, bridges, and a key Nepal-Tibet border crossing, leaving hundreds dead and thousands missing.
summary.zh: 卫星图像揭示了周三因冰川坍塌引发的特大山洪对尼泊尔特里舒利河沿岸造成的破坏规模。洪流摧毁了村庄、桥梁和尼泊尔与西藏之间的一个关键边境口岸，造成数百人死亡，数千人失踪。

body.en:
New satellite imagery has revealed the scale of the devastation along Nepal's Trishuli River caused by Wednesday's deadly flash flood, triggered by a glacier collapse.

Before-and-after images show how sections of the valley, where a torrent of floodwater and debris surged through, destroyed villages, bridges and hydroelectric power stations.

Hundreds of people have been killed and thousands more are missing, Nepalese officials say.

Among the worst-hit locations reviewed by BBC Verify was a key Nepal-Tibet border crossing, which was engulfed by a rush of floodwater and captured on camera.

The satellite imagery from US-based intelligence firm Vantor, shows the site has been almost entirely washed away. Shocking CCTV footage showed the moment as the deluge of water swept over buildings as people tried to escape.

Damage and mud can be seen more than 2.5km (1.5 miles) upstream, reaching 100m (330 ft) above the area it first hit.

A few miles further south is the village of Timure, which has now largely disappeared.

The walls of the valley at this point are steep, reaching up to 50m above the water line. The image shows most of the houses perched on this slope are now gone or covered in mud.

A further 10km (eight miles) downstream, where the Trishuli River winds through Syapru Besi, satellite imagery now shows the village covered by mud, rock and other debris. Houses and other structures have disappeared, including bridges and a hydroelectric power station.

One of the larger villages to be struck by the full force of the flood was Trishuli, where some of the earliest verified footage of the disaster emerged from.

A satellite image of the town and surrounding agricultural land, which is about 45km (28 miles) downstream from the border, show an entire neighbourhood has been essentially washed away.

Verified videos of the town show a bridge collapsing as the river surges forward. At the very same moment from ground level, footage filmed from inside a bus shows people crying out in distress and trying to flee as they see the water rushing down the river.

Other dramatic videos show people sheltering inside a house, peering over the edge of a balcony as they watch a torrent of floodwater wash away almost everything around them, knocking large metal debris and a vehicle toward the building.

Somehow the house remains intact and survivors can be seen in a second verified video standing surrounded by mud once the floodwater had receded.

Imagery from satellite provider Planet Labs released today has also provided a clearer view of the disaster's origins at the collapsed glacier, the moment of which has been captured on a verified drone video.

The satellite image shows an enormous chunk of the glacier has fallen away, carving an enormous path of rock...
body.zh: 新的卫星图像揭示了周三冰川崩塌引发的致命山洪对尼泊尔特里苏利河沿岸造成的破坏规模。 前后照片显示了洪水和瓦砾汹涌而过的山谷部分地区如何摧毁了村庄、桥梁和水力发电站。 尼泊尔官员称，数百人死亡，数千人失踪。 BBC verify 审查的受灾最严重的地点之一是尼泊尔和西藏的一个重要过境点，该过境点被洪水淹没，并被摄像机拍摄到。 美国情报公司 Vantor 的卫星图像显示，该地点几乎完全被冲毁。令人震惊的闭路电视画面显示，当人们试图逃离时，洪水席卷建筑物。 在上游超过 2.5 公里（1.5 英里）处可以看到损坏和泥浆，到达其首次袭击区域上方 100 m（330 英尺）。 再往南几英里是蒂穆尔村，该村现已基本消失。 此时的山谷壁很陡，高出水线高达 50m。该图像显示，坐落在这个斜坡上的大多数房屋现在都已经消失或被泥土覆盖。 再往下游 10 公里（8 英里）处，Trishuli 河蜿蜒穿过 Syapru Besi，卫星图像现在显示该村庄被泥土、岩石和其他碎片覆盖。房屋和其他建筑物都消失了，包括桥梁和水力发电站。 Trishuli是遭受洪水全面袭击的较大村庄之一，一些最早经过核实的灾难镜头就来自那里。 该镇及周边农田（距离边境下游约 45 公里（28 英里））的卫星图像显示，整个社区基本上已被冲走。 经核实的该镇视频显示，随着河流汹涌澎湃，一座桥梁倒塌。就在同一时刻，从地面拍摄的公交车内拍摄的视频显示，人们看到河水顺流而下，痛苦地呼喊并试图逃跑。 其他戏剧性的视频显示，人们躲在房子里，从阳台边缘往外看，看到洪水冲走了他们周围的几乎所有东西，将大块金属碎片和一辆汽车冲向建筑物。 不知何故，房子仍然完好无损，在第二段经过验证的视频中可以看到洪水退去后幸存者被泥土包围。 卫星提供商 Planet Labs 今天发布的图像也提供了冰川崩塌灾难起源的更清晰视图，经过验证的无人机视频捕捉到了这一瞬间。 卫星图像显示，一大块冰川已经消失，形成了一条巨大的岩石道路……

reflection.en: The images of the Trishuli River valley being engulfed by debris remind us of the 'groaning' of a world subject to sudden, overwhelming natural forces. As we see homes and vital crossings washed away, we are confronted with the fragility of our earthly structures and the deep grief of those who have lost everything. We look to Yahweh to be near the...
reflection.zh: 特里舒利河谷被瓦砾和洪流吞没的景象提醒我们，受造之物在面对突如其来的巨大自然力量时正处于“叹息劳苦”之中。当我们看到家园和关键通道被冲走，我们直面人类建筑的脆弱以及那些失去一切的人们深重的悲哀。我们仰望雅伟，祈求祂亲近尼泊尔那些伤心的人，并为正在进行的搜救工作提供力量。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: ‘Erased before their eyes’: desperate rescue efforts continue after Nepal-Tibet floods - The Latest
title.zh: “在他们眼前消失”：尼泊尔与西藏洪水过后，绝望的搜救行动仍在继续

summary.en: Rescue teams in Nepal and Tibet are struggling to reach remote areas after flash floods killed hundreds and left many missing. The mission is complicated by the threat of a landslide-formed lake that could overflow, potentially triggering a second wave of catastrophic flooding.
summary.zh: 尼泊尔和西藏的救援队正努力进入偏远地区，此前的山洪已导致数百人死亡，多人失踪。由于山体滑坡形成的堰塞湖存在溃坝风险，可能引发第二次灾难性洪水，救援任务变得更加复杂。

body.en: Rescue efforts are continuing in Nepal and Tibet after flash floods that have killed hundreds and left many more missing. But fears that a lake formed by the landslide could overflow and cause fresh flooding, along with difficulty accessing disaster-hit areas, are hindering rescue and recovery missions. Lucy Hough speaks with south Asia correspondent Hannah Ellis-Petersen, who is in Nepal, about the situation on the ground Continue reading...
body.zh: 尼泊尔和西藏的山洪爆发导致数百人死亡、多人失踪，救援工作仍在继续。但由于担心山体滑坡形成的湖泊可能溢出并引发新的洪水，以及进入受灾地区的困难，正在阻碍救援和恢复任务。露西·霍夫与在尼泊尔的南亚记者汉娜·埃利斯-彼得森谈论当地局势继续阅读...

reflection.en: As hundreds are lost and entire communities face the threat of being "erased," we see the terrifying power of a groaning creation. Yet, in the tireless persistence of rescuers facing landslide-blocked paths and rising waters, there is a reflection of a love that refuses to give up. We pray for those in the shadow of the landslide-formed lake, that they...
reflection.zh: 当数百人丧生、整个社区面临被“抹去”的威胁时，我们看到了受造之物在叹息中所爆发的恐怖力量。然而，在救援人员面对被滑坡阻断的道路和上涨的水位仍不懈努力的过程中，我们看到了那份永不放弃的爱的影子。我们为那些处于堰塞湖威胁之下的人们祈祷，愿他们在这一漫长的悲痛之夜中，能寻得雅伟那份支撑他们不至消灭的怜悯。

verse.textEn: Because of Yahweh's great love we are not consumed, for his compassions never fail. They are new every morning.
verse.textZh: 我们不至消灭，是出于雅伟诸般的慈爱；是因他的怜悯不至断绝。每早晨这都是新的。

title.en: On the ground in decimated Nepal flood zone – The Latest
title.zh: 尼泊尔洪灾区现场：搜救工作在废墟中艰难进行

summary.en: Rescue operations are ongoing in Nepal and Tibet following flash floods that have claimed hundreds of lives, though efforts are hampered by difficult terrain and the threat of a landslide-formed lake overflowing.
summary.zh: 尼泊尔和西藏在遭遇造成数百人死亡的突发洪水后，搜救工作仍在继续。然而，由于地形险要以及担心滑坡形成的堰塞湖可能溃决，救援和恢复任务面临巨大阻碍。

body.en: Rescue efforts are continuing in Nepal and Tibet after flash floods that have killed hundreds and left many more missing. But fears that a lake formed by the landslide could overflow and cause fresh flooding, along with difficulty accessing disaster-hit areas, are hindering rescue and recovery missions. Lucy Hough speaks with south Asia correspondent Hannah Ellis-Petersen, who is in Nepal, about the situation on the ground - watch on YouTube Continue reading...
body.zh: 尼泊尔和西藏的山洪爆发导致数百人死亡、多人失踪，救援工作仍在继续。但由于担心山体滑坡形成的湖泊可能溢出并引发新的洪水，以及进入受灾地区的困难，正在阻碍救援和恢复任务。露西·霍夫与身在尼泊尔的南亚记者汉娜·埃利斯-彼得森谈论当地局势 - 在 YouTube 上观看 继续阅读...

reflection.en: As rescue teams navigate the decimated landscapes of Nepal and Tibet, their persistence serves as a testament to human resilience in the face of tragedy. This grueling work of searching through mud and debris is the beginning of a long journey from suffering toward a restored hope. We pray that Yahweh would grant safety to the responders and comfort to...
reflection.zh: 当救援队在尼泊尔和西藏满目疮痍的灾区搜寻时，他们的坚持见证了人类在悲剧面前的韧性。在泥泞和瓦砾中搜寻的艰巨工作，是开启从苦难走向希望重建之漫长旅程的第一步。我们为救援人员的安全祈祷，也求雅伟安慰那些在焦急等待失踪亲人消息的人们。

verse.textEn: We also glory in our sufferings, because we know that suffering produces perseverance; perseverance, character; and character, hope.
verse.textZh: 就是在患难中也是欢欢喜喜的；因为知道患难生忍耐，忍耐生老练，老练生盼望。

title.en: Nepal-Tibet flood deaths pass 500, thousands still missing
title.zh: 尼泊尔-西藏洪灾死亡人数超500，数千人仍失踪

summary.en: The Red Cross says more than 93,000 people are affected by the deadly floods and landslides on the China-Nepal border. Rescue efforts were temporarily paused after an overflowing lake threatened to trigger more floods.
summary.zh: 红十字会表示，中尼边境的致命洪灾和山体滑坡已影响超过93,000人。由于一个溢流的湖泊可能引发更多洪水，救援工作曾一度暂停。

body.en:
The Red Cross says more than 93,000 people are affected by the deadly floods and landslides on the China-Nepal border. Rescue efforts were temporarily paused after an overflowing lake threatened to trigger more floods.

Rescue workers have resumed a search for hundreds of people still missing two days after  catastrophic flash flooding  hit the border between  Nepal and  China . 

Their efforts were briefly put on hold on Friday after a lake formed by debris began overflowing, threatening areas already devastated by the disaster.  

"We have received a notice saying that the lake has broken its banks," Narendra Pariyar, the most senior bureaucrat of the hard-hit Rasuwa district, told DW. "We can see that the level of water in the river is rising."

Residents in Nepal's border district of Rasuwa were seen fleeing up hillsides as they braced for a surge in river levels, Reuters reported.

Authorities later said the threat had eased but that they were closely monitoring the situation. 

Meanwhile, Nepal said the death toll had risen to 579,  up from 390 a day earlier . China has updated its earlier count of three to five deaths in Tibet.

More than 2,000 are still believed to be missing, including over 500 foreigners from more than 30 countries.

The International Red Cross estimated that over 93,000 people have been directly affected by the catastrophe and are in urgent need of humanitarian assistance.

"We're of course very concerned about a secondary flood," said spokesman David Fisher at a press briefing in Geneva, adding that Red Cross relief trucks had been blocked by the lake which formed following the landslide.

Kamal Kishore, Head of the United ​Nations Office for Disaster Risk Reduction, warned of further "cascading hazards that might unfold" and said: "The disaster is ⁠not ​yet completely over. It is still ​unfolding in some ways."

The World Health Organization (WHO) warned of the risk of disease in the wake of the disaster.

"Following a disaster of this scale, displacement, overcrowding ⁠and disruption ​to water, sanitation and health services can increase the risk of infectious diseases, including diarrhoea and respiratory illnesses," said spokesman Tarik ​Jasarevic.

Wednesday's disaster, triggered by a glacial collapse that sent rock and meltwater surging into rivers below, left a new danger in its wake: a barrier lake formed upstream by debris dams. 

China's Ministry of Water Resources said the lake held roughly 2 million cubic meters of water as of Thursday and was expected to receive another 3 million cubic meters — equivalent to about 1,200 Olympic swimming pools — over the following three days, with peak flow expected around September...
body.zh: 红十字会表示，超过 93,000 人受到中尼边境致命洪水和山体滑坡的影响。由于湖水泛滥，可能引发更多洪水，救援工作暂时停止。 尼泊尔和中国边境发生灾难性山洪暴发两天后，救援人员已重新开始搜寻仍失踪的数百人。 周五，由于碎片形成的湖泊开始泛滥，威胁到已经遭受灾难破坏的地区，他们的努力被短暂搁置。 受灾最严重的拉苏瓦地区最高官员纳伦德拉·帕里亚尔 (Narendra Pariyar) 告诉德国之声：“我们收到通知，称该湖已决堤。” “我们可以看到河里的水位正在上升。” 据路透社报道，尼泊尔边境拉苏瓦地区的居民纷纷逃上山坡，以应对河流水位上涨的情况。 当局后来表示，威胁已经缓解，但他们正在密切关注事态发展。 与此同时，尼泊尔表示死亡人数已从一天前的 390 人上升至 579 人。 中国更新了此前西藏三至五人死亡的统计数据。 据信仍有 2,000 多人失踪，其中包括来自 30 多个国家的 500 多名外国人。 国际红十字会估计，超过93,000人直接受到这场灾难的影响，急需人道援助。 发言人大卫·费舍尔在日内瓦举行的新闻发布会上表示：“我们当然非常担心二次洪水。”他补充说，红十字会的救援卡车被山体滑坡后形成的湖泊堵塞。 联合国减少灾害风险办公室主任卡迈勒·基肖尔警告称，“可能会出现更多连锁危险”，并表示：“灾难尚未完全结束。在某些方面，它仍在继续发展。” 世界卫生组织（WHO）就灾难发生后的疾病风险发出警告。 发言人塔里克·贾萨雷维奇 (Tarik Jasarevic) 表示：“如此规模的灾难发生后，流离失所、过度拥挤以及供水、卫生和医疗服务中断可能会增加感染腹泻和呼吸道疾病等传染病的风险。” 周三的灾难是由冰川崩塌引发的，冰川崩塌导致岩石和融水涌入下面的河流，随之而来的是一个新的危险：上游由碎片坝形成的堰塞湖。 中国水利部表示，截至周四，该湖的蓄水量约为 200 万立方米，预计在接下来的三天内将再接收 300 万立方米的水，相当于约 1,200 个奥运游泳池，预计 9 月左右将达到峰值流量。

reflection.en: The devastating floods and landslides along the China-Nepal border, affecting over 93,000 people and leaving thousands missing, remind us of the relentless nature of some crises. Even as rescue efforts are paused due to further threats, the promise of Yahweh's mercies, new every morning, offers a steadfast hope. In the face of such sustained devastation, we...
reflection.zh: 中尼边境毁灭性的洪灾和山体滑坡影响了超过93,000人，并导致数千人失踪，这提醒我们有些危机是持续不断的。即使救援工作因新的洪水威胁而暂停，雅伟的慈爱每天早晨都是新的，这提供了坚定的盼望。面对如此持续的破坏，我们为那些承受巨大损失和不确定性的人们祈求每日的力量和安慰。

verse.textEn: Because of Yahweh's great love we are not consumed, for his compassions never fail. They are new every morning.
verse.textZh: 我们不至消灭，是出于雅伟诸般的慈爱；是因他的怜悯不至断绝。每早晨这都是新的。

title.en: Watch: Why rescuers fear new barrier lake could cause another Nepal-Tibet flood
title.zh: 尼泊尔-西藏边境山体滑坡形成堰塞湖，引发二次洪灾担忧

summary.en: Chinese authorities have issued a high-risk warning for a barrier lake formed by a recent landslide near the Nepal-Tibet border, which could breach and cause a second flood downstream following a deadly glacier-triggered event on Wednesday.
summary.zh: 中国官方发布警告称，尼泊尔与西藏边境近期因山体滑坡形成的堰塞湖存在“高风险”溃决可能，或将引发下游二次洪灾。此前，该地区周三刚发生过由冰川坍塌引发的致命闪洪。

body.en:
China has warned there is a "high risk" that a lake which formed after the recent landslide near the Nepal-Tibet border may breach its banks, causing a second flood downstream.

The warning comes after Wednesday's deadly flash flood in the same area which scientists say was triggered by the collapse of a mountain glacier into a river.
body.zh: 中国警告称，最近尼泊尔和西藏边境附近发生山体滑坡后形成的湖泊存在“高风险”，可能会冲破河岸，导致下游发生第二次洪水。 这一警告是在周三同一地区发生致命的山洪之后发出的，科学家称这场洪水是由山地冰川崩塌入河引发的。

reflection.en: The formation of this barrier lake serves as a sobering reminder of the volatility of our natural world, where one disaster often sets the stage for the next. While scientists and officials monitor the 'high risk' of a breach, we are reminded that wisdom involves recognizing these looming threats and seeking safety before the waters rise. In a world that...
reflection.zh: 这座堰塞湖的形成清醒地提醒着我们自然界的动荡不安，一场灾难往往会为下一场埋下伏笔。当科学家和官员们监测着溃决的“高风险”时，我们也领悟到智慧在于识别这些迫在眉睫的威胁，并在洪水上涨前寻求避难。在这个如同山体滑坡般不稳定的世界里，我们仰望雅伟，祈求祂赐予我们预见危险的洞察力，以及唯有祂能提供的庇护。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: How Australians can help those impacted by devastating Nepal floods
title.zh: 澳大利亚人如何帮助受尼泊尔毁灭性洪水影响的人们

summary.en: Australian charities have launched a joint appeal to aid communities devastated by floods and landslides along the Nepal-China border. Thousands are in urgent need of shelter, food, clean water, and medical care after their homes and infrastructure were destroyed.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚慈善机构已发起联合募捐，以援助尼泊尔-中国边境受洪水和山体滑坡摧毁的社区。在房屋和基础设施被毁后，成千上万的人迫切需要住所、食物、清洁饮用水和医疗援助。

body.en:
Entire communities have been devastated by severe flooding and landslides along the Nepal-Tibet border, with homes, roads, bridges and critical infrastructure destroyed.

Search and rescue operations remain underway, while thousands of people are in urgent need of shelter, food, clean drinking water and medical assistance.

In response, 14 Australian charities have joined forces to launch a national appeal.

The Emergency Action Alliance (EAA) has launched the Nepal Flood Disaster Appeal, bringing together a variety of charities to support communities affected by the disaster.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The alliance says donations will help provide immediate humanitarian assistance, including emergency shelter, food, safe drinking water, hygiene supplies and medical care.

Access to some affected communities remains difficult, with damaged roads and ongoing weather conditions hampering efforts to reach people in need.

Australians are encouraged to donate through the EAA website or by calling 1300 939 000.

The charities participating in the appeal are Save the Children Australia, Plan International Australia, Oxfam Australia, Australia for UNHCR, ActionAid Australia, CARE Australia, Caritas Australia, ADRA, Act for Peace, Anglican Overseas Aid, Australian Lutheran World Service, Baptist World Aid Australia, CBM Australia and Tearfund Australia.

EAA executive director Kerren Morris said the appeal provided Australians with a trusted way to support people affected by the disaster.

"Emergency shelter, food, safe drinking water and medical support are urgently needed now, while longer-term recovery efforts will continue for many months," she said in a statement.

The charities involved bring different areas of humanitarian expertise to the response, with organisations and their local partners working to provide immediate assistance to affected communities.

Save the Children is focusing on supporting children and families affected by humanitarian emergencies.

Oxfam Australia's humanitarian work includes support for essential services such as clean water, sanitation and emergency assistance.

Australia for UNHCR is the UN refugee agency's national partner in Australia, and is supporting humanitarian assistance through the UNHCR network.

The charities involved are continuing to assess the scale of the disaster and humanitarian needs in affected communities.

The EAA says its members are working to determine where support is most urgently needed as search and rescue operations continue.

The appeal has been endorsed by the Australian Council for International Development (ACFID), the peak body for Australian non-government organisations...
body.zh: 尼泊尔和西藏边境沿线的严重洪水和山体滑坡摧毁了整个社区，房屋、道路、桥梁和重要基础设施被毁。 搜救行动仍在进行中，数千人迫切需要住所、食物、清洁饮用水和医疗援助。 作为回应，14家澳大利亚慈善机构联手发起全国呼吁。 紧急行动联盟（EAA）发起了尼泊尔洪灾呼吁，汇集了各种慈善机构来支持受灾社区。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 该联盟表示，捐款将有助于提供紧急人道主义援助，包括紧急住所、食品、安全饮用水、卫生用品和医疗服务。 进入一些受影响的社区仍然很困难，道路受损和持续的天气状况阻碍了援助有需要的人的努力。 我们鼓励澳大利亚人通过 EAA 网站或致电 1300 939 000 进行捐款。 参与呼吁的慈善机构包括澳大利亚救助儿童会、澳大利亚国际计划、澳大利亚乐施会、澳大利亚难民署、澳大利亚行动援助组织、澳大利亚援外社、澳大利亚明爱、ADRA、和平行动、圣公会海外援助、澳大利亚路德会世界服务社、澳大利亚浸信会世界援助组织、澳大利亚 CBM 和澳大利亚泪基金。 EAA 执行董事 Kerren Morris 表示，这一呼吁为澳大利亚人提供了一种值得信赖的方式来支持受灾难影响的人们。 她在一份声明中说：“现在迫切需要紧急住所、食物、安全饮用水和医疗支持，而长期恢复工作将持续数月。” 参与其中的慈善机构将不同领域的人道主义专业知识融入到应对工作中，组织及其当地合作伙伴致力于为受影响的社区提供即时援助。 救助儿童会的重点是支持受人道主义紧急情况影响的儿童和家庭。 澳大利亚乐施会的人道主义工作包括支持清洁水、卫生设施和紧急援助等基本服务。 联合国难民署澳大利亚办事处是联合国难民署在澳大利亚的国家合作伙伴，并通过难民署网络支持人道主义援助。 相关慈善机构正在继续评估灾难的规模和受影响社区的人道主义需求。 EAA 表示，随着搜救行动的继续，其成员正在努力确定哪里最需要支持。 该呼吁得到了澳大利亚非政府组织最高机构澳大利亚国际发展委员会（ACFID）的认可......

reflection.en: The devastating floods in Nepal have left entire communities in urgent need of basic necessities. This situation calls us to action, reminding us of our responsibility to advocate for the vulnerable and provide tangible support to those facing such immense hardship. Proverbs 31:8-9 urges us to 'Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for...
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔毁灭性的洪水使整个社区迫切需要基本生活必需品。这种情况呼唤我们采取行动，提醒我们有责任为弱势群体发声，并为那些面临巨大困难的人提供切实的支持。《箴言》31:8-9 敦促我们：“你们要为不能说话的辩护，为所有孤苦者伸张正义。你们要开口说话，公正地审判，为困苦和贫穷的人伸张正义。”

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Number of Australians missing in Nepal floods climbs to 35
title.zh: 尼泊尔洪水和山体滑坡造成数百人失踪，其中包括澳大利亚人

summary.en: Aid workers have described scenes of complete destruction, with entire settlements "wiped out".
summary.zh: 救援人员描述了彻底毁灭的景象，整个定居点“被夷为平地”。

body.en:
The Nepal Tourism Board says 35 Australians are missing after a massive flood and landslide disaster on the Nepal-Tibet border killed at least 273 people on Wednesday, with hundreds more unaccounted for.

That number had been 34 until the tourism board published an update Thursday afternoon.

Another 823 people, including 644 Nepali and foreign tourists, remained out of contact in Nepal, according to the country's disaster agency.

On Thursday afternoon, China's foreign minister said nearly 100 Chinese nationals were missing, revising down earlier reporting in Chinese state media that 558 people, including 260 foreigners, were missing in Gyirong Port, Tibet.

"At this point, there are 34 Australians who are missing," Albanese told a press conference on Thursday morning. "People would have seen some of the footage, which is a truly horrific event."

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Albanese said it was difficult to obtain information from Nepali authorities and appealed to anyone with information to come forward.

"At this point, Nepal is a developing country. It doesn't have the resources that an event like that would have in Australia, so information is difficult.

"Our thoughts are with all those who will be concerned about their loved ones today."

Defence minister Penny Wong echoed the Prime Minister's statements, noting that the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT) was working "urgently" to ascertain the welfare and location of the missing Australians.

"We are currently deploying further DFAT personnel, including crisis response experts to the region to ensure that we do provide the support needed to these posts, particularly our post in Nepal," Wong in a press conference on Thursday.

"At this stage, access and information are very limited given the scale of disaster. We will do our best, to ascertain whatever information we can."

A US-based tour company Himalayan Glacier Adventures told ABC News that 15 Australians, part of a group of 47 people, were on a hiking tour in the Lantang Valley at the time of the landslides.

The group of Australians was comprised of nine men and six women. Two of those Australians were reportedly boys aged 11 and 14, and a woman aged 64.

Tilak Pokharel, president of the Australian Nepalese Multicultural Centre, said there were "a lot" of people in Melbourne waiting anxiously to hear from loved ones.

"There are a lot of people affected by the flood. There are many people from that area living in Melbourne," Pokharel said.

"But several of them lost their property. I was just talking to someone who is from that area and they lost their houses, they lost their property and they have nothing left at...
body.zh: 周三，尼泊尔和西藏边境发生大规模洪水和山体滑坡灾害，造成至少 160 人死亡，数百人失踪，其中据报道有 34 名澳大利亚人。 援助人员表示，整个定居点已被“摧毁”。法新社证实的监控录像显示，一股故事高的碎片撞向边境地区的中国一侧，将卡车和公共汽车抛到一边，数十人逃命。 中国官方媒体报道称，西藏边境枢纽发生泥石流，造成“重大人员伤亡”，其中三人死亡，另有 265 人失踪。 尼泊尔警方表示，他们在“毁灭性洪水”后已找到 157 具尸体，官员“正在努力将洪水风险地区的家庭转移到更安全的地方”。 洪水淹没了多层建筑的较低楼层后，救援人员在泥浆中涉水寻找幸存者。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 据尼泊尔旅游部称，灾难发生后数小时内，约 403 名游客（其中 341 名外国人）下落不明。 旅游局发言人向美国广播公司新闻提供的一份名单显示，失踪的澳大利亚人人数为 34 人。 外交贸易部 (DFAT) 尚未确认该数字。 外交贸易部发言人告诉 SBS 新闻：“我们知道该地区有许多澳大利亚人，澳大利亚官员正在紧急努力确认他们的福利。” “我们正在与地方当局以及旅行社联络。” 旅游局称，失踪的外国人包括 142 名印度人，以及来自澳大利亚、英国、马来西亚、荷兰、葡萄牙、南非、韩国和美国的其他人。 红十字会与红新月会国际联合会（IFRC）尼泊尔负责人戴维·费舍尔（David Fisher）表示：“整个村庄和市场区域都被夷为平地。” 该公司表示正在发送紧急物资，包括毯子、急救箱、担架和裹尸袋。 他在社交媒体上发表声明说：“你们所遭受的痛苦和损失并不小。” “但我想向你们保证，在这个困难时期，你们并不孤单——国家将竭尽全力与你们同在。” 当地人受到了创伤，而专家警告说，河流的持续堵塞可能会引发额外的洪水。 “今天早上我接到（我姐夫）的电话，他们哭着说他们的整个房子都被冲走了。三名家庭成员获救，但他的兄弟仍然失踪，”当地56岁的拉朱·巴德尔说。 但尼泊尔外交部长希希尔·卡纳尔表示，地震可能引发山体滑坡，从而阻碍了...

reflection.en: The news of hundreds missing and entire settlements "wiped out" by floods and landslides in Nepal brings immense sorrow. In moments of such widespread devastation and loss of life, the brevity of "Jesus wept" reminds us that grief is a natural and holy response. Yahweh, in Christ, shares in our human pain, offering a compassionate presence when words fail.
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔洪水和山体滑坡造成数百人失踪、整个定居点“被夷为平地”的消息，带来了巨大的悲痛。在如此大规模的毁灭和生命损失面前，“雅伟哭了”这简短的经文提醒我们，悲伤是一种自然而神圣的回应。雅伟在基督里分担我们人类的痛苦，当言语无法表达时，祂提供了一个充满怜悯的同在。

verse.textEn: Jesus wept.
verse.textZh: 耶稣哭了。

title.en: How bird flu could spread among Australia's mammals, and what it means for your pets
title.zh: 禽流感如何在澳大利亚哺乳动物中传播，以及这对您的宠物意味着什么

summary.en: After weeks of spreading among birds, H5 bird flu has been confirmed in three Australian mammal species: a red fox, a dolphin, and a fur seal. Health officials are monitoring the situation as the virus crosses species boundaries, a trend already observed on other continents.
summary.zh: 在鸟类中传播数周后，H5禽流感已在澳大利亚的三种哺乳动物中得到证实：一只红狐、一只海豚和一只毛皮海狮。随着病毒跨越物种界限，卫生官员正密切监测局势。

body.en:
Bird flu has begun its spread beyond birds in Australia, with cases confirmed in three different mammal species since last weekend.

On Friday, Australia's chief veterinary officer, Beth Cookson, said H5 bird flu had been confirmed in a red fox found in metropolitan Adelaide, marking the first in a land mammal in Australia.

A dead dolphin found on South Australia's Fleurieu Peninsula also tested positive this week, days after a long-nosed fur seal found dead at Beachport became the country's first mainland mammal case.

Bird flu has been detected in many different mammals on other continents, including cats and dogs, farm animals, dolphins, seals, foxes, tigers, leopards and polar bears.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Infected birds spread the virus through droppings, feathers and other bodily fluids. It can also be transmitted via contaminated clothing, footwear, equipment and vehicles.

Under favourable conditions, the virus can survive in the environment for months, Australian government authorities have said.

While the virus primarily spreads from infected birds, there is evidence it can also spread between some mammals, including during outbreaks in seals and dairy cattle overseas.

Among scavengers like foxes and cats, infections have been linked to eating or interacting with bird carcasses.

Cookson said there was no evidence of mammal-to-mammal transmission of the virus in Australia.

"This detection in a fox is a good reminder that people and their pets should avoid sick or dead wildlife," Cookson said on Friday.

"Although this is a concerning development, it is not unexpected given that H5 bird flu has been detected in other wildlife in areas where there are high levels of infection in wild birds."

The government's H5 bird flu risk assessment ranks multiple dolphin, seal and sea lion species among Australia's most vulnerable native mammals, and experts fear the virus could have devastating consequences for endangered species such as the Australian sea lion.

Seal populations around the world have proved particularly vulnerable to bird flu outbreaks.

The virus decimated southern elephant seal populations on Heard Island after reaching the Australian sub-antarctic territory last year, killing an estimated 75 per cent of pups.

Jane Younger, senior lecturer in Southern Ocean vertebrate ecology at the University of Tasmania, said it was "devastating news for wildlife" that bird flu had been detected in a mainland Australian mammal.

"My biggest concern now is the endangered Australian sea lion, which is found nowhere else in the world," she said.

"Infected and dying seabirds have already been found at important sea lion breeding...
body.zh: 禽流感已开始在澳大利亚的鸟类以外传播，自上周末以来，三种不同的哺乳动物中均出现了病例。 周五，澳大利亚首席兽医官贝丝·库克森 (Beth Cookson) 表示，在阿德莱德大都会发现的一只红狐中已证实感染 H5 禽流感，这是澳大利亚首次在陆地哺乳动物中发现这种病毒。 本周，在南澳大利亚弗勒里厄半岛发现的一只死去的海豚也呈阳性，几天前，在海滩港发现的一只长鼻海狗死亡，成为该国首例大陆哺乳动物病例。 其他大陆的许多不同哺乳动物中也发现了禽流感，包括猫和狗、农场动物、海豚、海豹、狐狸、老虎、豹子和北极熊。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 受感染的鸟类通过粪便、羽毛和其他体液传播病毒。它还可以通过受污染的衣服、鞋类、设备和车辆传播。 澳大利亚政府当局表示，在有利的条件下，该病毒可以在环境中存活数月。 虽然该病毒主要通过受感染的鸟类传播，但有证据表明它也可以在一些哺乳动物之间传播，包括海外海豹和奶牛的疫情爆发期间。 在狐狸和猫等食腐动物中，感染与食用或接触鸟类尸体有关。 库克森表示，没有证据表明该病毒在澳大利亚存在哺乳动物之间的传播。 库克森周五表示：“在狐狸身上发现的这一发现很好地提醒人们和他们的宠物应该避免接触生病或死亡的野生动物。” “尽管这一事态发展令人担忧，但考虑到在野鸟感染率高的地区的其他野生动物中也发现了 H5 禽流感，这并不令人意外。” 政府的 H5 禽流感风险评估将多种海豚、海豹和海狮列为澳大利亚最脆弱的本土哺乳动物，专家担心这种病毒可能对澳大利亚海狮等濒临灭绝的物种造成毁灭性后果。 事实证明，世界各地的海豹种群特别容易受到禽流感爆发的影响。 去年，该病毒抵达澳大利亚亚南极地区后，导致赫德岛上的南象海豹数量大量减少，估计导致 75% 的幼崽死亡。 塔斯马尼亚大学南大洋脊椎动物生态学高级讲师简·杨格（Jane Younger）表示，在澳大利亚大陆的哺乳动物中发现了禽流感，这对野生动物来说是“毁灭性的消息”。 “我现在最担心的是濒临灭绝的澳大利亚海狮，这种动物在世界其他地方都找不到，”她说。 “在重要的海狮繁殖场所已经发现了受感染和垂死的海鸟......

reflection.en: The discovery of bird flu in a red fox in Adelaide and a dolphin on the Fleurieu Peninsula reminds us that the health of one part of creation is deeply linked to the rest. When one species suffers, the ripple effects eventually reach across the boundaries of land and sea, affecting mammals and potentially our own households. This groaning of the natural...
reflection.zh: 在阿德莱德的红狐和菲尔里厄半岛的海豚身上发现禽流感，提醒我们受造界某一部分的健康与其余部分紧密相连。当一个物种遭受苦难时，其连锁反应最终会跨越陆地和海洋的界限，影响到哺乳动物，甚至可能波及我们的家庭。这种自然界的叹息呼唤我们建立更深层的管家意识，并以祷告的心去关注雅伟委托我们照管的生命的脆弱性。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Statins can safely cut risk of heart attacks or strokes in healthy people aged over 70, world-first clinical trial shows
title.zh: 全球首项临床试验显示：70岁以上健康人群服用他汀类药物可安全降低心脑血管风险

summary.en: An Australian-led clinical trial has found that statins, a common cholesterol-lowering medication, can safely reduce the risk of heart attacks and strokes in healthy people over the age of 70. The study, which is the first of its kind to focus on this age group, reported a low risk of serious side effects, providing...
summary.zh: 一项由澳大利亚研究人员领导的全球首个临床试验发现，常见的降胆固醇药物——他汀类药物，可以安全地降低70岁以上健康人群患心脏病或中风的风险。该研究专门针对这一年龄段，结果显示严重副作用的风险较低，为老年人的预防性医疗保健提供了新的依据。

body.en: Australian-led trial finds low risk of side effects from common cholesterol-lowering medication for otherwise healthy older people Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Taking a common cholesterol-lowering medication can reduce the risk of a heart attack or stroke for people aged over 70, with a low risk of serious side effects, a world-first clinical trial led by Australian researchers has found. Statins are already commonly prescribed to people under the age of 75 who meet certain risk criteria, such as having diabetes and high cholesterol, to prevent them from having a major heart event such as a heart attack, stroke, or from requiring heart surgery. Continue reading...
body.zh: 澳大利亚主导的试验发现，对于健康的老年人来说，普通降胆固醇药物产生副作用的风险较低。澳大利亚研究人员领导的一项世界首个临床试验发现，服用普通降胆固醇药物可以降低 70 岁以上老年人心脏病发作或中风的风险，而且严重副作用的风险较低。他汀类药物已普遍用于 75 岁以下、符合某些风险标准（例如患有糖尿病和高胆固醇）的人，以防止他们发生心脏病、中风等重大心脏事件或需要进行心脏手术。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This breakthrough research honors the dignity of our later years by seeking ways to preserve health long after the typical prime of life. It reminds us that Yahweh’s care for us does not diminish with age, but continues to sustain us through every season. By applying medical wisdom to the needs of those over 70, we reflect a heart that values the elderly as...
reflection.zh: 这项突破性研究通过寻求在步入晚年很久之后依然保持健康的方法，体现了对生命尊严的尊重。它提醒我们，雅伟对我们的关怀并不会随着年龄的增长而减少，而是在每一个季节都持续扶持我们。通过将医学智慧应用于70岁以上人群的需求，我们反映出一种看重老年人的心怀，将其视为一个充满目标与活力的季节。

verse.textEn: Even to your old age and gray hairs I am he, I am he who will sustain you. I have made you and I will carry you; I will sustain you and I will rescue you.
verse.textZh: 直到你们年老，我仍这样；直到你们发白，我仍怀搋。我已造作，也必保抱；我必怀抱，也必拯救。

title.en: What weather can we expect across Australia this spring?
title.zh: 澳大利亚今年春天天气如何？

summary.en: After a warm winter, Australians are entering spring under the influence of an El Niño that is expected to intensify further.
summary.zh: 在经历了一个温暖的冬季之后，澳大利亚人即将进入春天，而厄尔尼诺现象预计将进一步加剧。

body.en:
Warmer-than-usual weather is expected to continue across much of Australia from winter into spring.

The Bureau of Meteorology (BoM) has released its long-range forecast for September to November, predicting that both daytime and overnight temperatures are likely to be above average in most of the country.

Rainfall is expected to be below average across parts of Australia's south and east, and above average across much of the western half of the country.

The bureau notes that spring is also a peak time of year for severe thunderstorms, especially along the east coast.

"The warmer forecast increases the risk of early-season heat, particularly across southern Australia," said David Crock, senior BoM meteorologist.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"While rainfall is expected to be below average in some areas, this does not mean it will be dry all the time. It means there is likely to be less rainfall than usual."

Spring rainfall is likely to be below average in much of Victoria, southern NSW and the ACT, north and east Tasmania, parts of eastern Queensland, southern South Australia and pockets of the far north Northern Territory.

Above average rainfall is expected across parts of north-west South Australia and across most of Western Australia, with the exception of the south-western corner.

The forecast coincides with a strengthening El Niño, expected to be one of the strongest on record, increasing the chances of hot, dry weather and raising concerns for farmers and bushfire agencies .

The spring bushfire outlook is varied across the country, with increased fire risks expected in some regions, including parts of Victoria, NSW and WA.

The BoM expects El Niño to strengthen and persist through spring and summer.

But while the climate driver is associated with drier conditions across parts of Australia, the agency said the strength of an El Niño doesn't always match its impacts on Australian rainfall.

"Oceans around Australia and globally are also much warmer than usual, adding moisture and energy that can fuel rain systems," Crock said.

A study published last week found the Pacific climate pattern that drives El Niño and La Niña is showing larger swings, with more frequent and intense El Niño events than at any time in the past millennium, adding to evidence that climate change is amplifying one of the world's most influential climate systems.

Australia's snow season, which runs from June to October, is set to be one of the worst on record, despite plenty of moisture passing over the Australian Alps.

title.en: As bird flu edges towards this remote territory, an unprecedented move is taking place
title.zh: 随着禽流感逼近这一偏远领地，一项前所未有的行动正在展开

summary.en: Researchers are being withdrawn from Macquarie Island in the Southern Ocean to protect their mental health as a worsening bird flu outbreak threatens thousands of elephant seals during breeding season. This unprecedented move by the Australian government acknowledges the severe psychological distress wildlife...
summary.zh: 随着禽流感疫情恶化并威胁到繁殖季节成千上万头象海豹的生命，研究人员正从南大洋的麦夸里岛撤离，以保护他们的心理健康。澳大利亚政府采取这一前所未有的行动，旨在承认野生动物科学家在目睹自然界大规模死亡事件时所面临的严重心理压力。

body.en:
The decision to evacuate a team of researchers to avoid the psychological distress of witnessing thousands of seal deaths shows the mental health of wildlife scientists is beginning to be taken seriously, experts say.

Researchers will be withdrawn from the Australian territory of Macquarie Island in the Southern Ocean to protect their mental health amid a worsening bird flu outbreak, the Australian Antarctic Division announced on Friday.

It's the first time the government has taken such a major action to safeguard the psychological well-being of its researchers.

The Department of Climate Change, Energy, Environment and Water said it was likely the virus would wipe out thousands of elephant seals and their pups during the upcoming breeding season.

"Imagine living and working in amongst thousands of seals within very close proximity in and around the station ... [and] the distress of seeing those animals, not being able to help them," the department's deputy secretary Sean Sullivan said.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

A mass mortality event would have "significant implications for the psychological safety of our staff" and safeguarding their well-being should be "the number one priority," Sullivan added.

While the island has yet to be officially affected by bird flu, the government's decision indicates it is taking the likelihood of the virus reaching its shores seriously.

But it is also a sign the government is taking the psychological well-being of its staff equally as seriously.

Environmental psychology, eco-grief expert and scientist Brianna Le-Busque said witnessing a mass casualty event would have "repeated and compounded" psychological effects on the 24 expeditioners who work and live on the island.

The World Heritage island is home to several species of seals, with more than 80,000 southern elephant seals, and millions of breeding seabirds including multiple penguin species.

"Researchers will have become very attached to that place and the species they are there to protect," the program director in environmental sciences at Adelaide University told AAP.

The particularly unique working conditions mean researchers could feel the loss even more.

Le-Busque said environmental crises can evoke profound psychological distress and feelings of helplessness.

Le-Busque said the staff extraction from Macquarie Island is the first time this major action has been undertaken solely due to psychological risk.

Sullivan defended the decision, saying preparations would be made over the next month to continue research and monitoring on the island in the researchers' absence.

title.en: Why this little-known meteor shower is one to watch this week
title.zh: 为什么这个鲜为人知的流星雨值得本周关注

summary.en: The Aurigid meteor shower, caused by debris from comet C/1911 N1 (Kiess) with a 2,000-year orbit, will be active this week, peaking on August 31 to September 1. While not as prolific as other showers, it is known for the speed of its meteors and its connection to the long-period comet.
summary.zh: 由彗星C/1911 N1（基斯彗星）的碎片引起的金牛座流星雨本周将活跃，该彗星的轨道周期约为2000年，流星雨预计在8月31日至9月1日夜间达到高峰。尽管不如其他流星雨那样多产，但它以流星的速度及其与这颗长周期彗星的联系而著称。

body.en:
A minor meteor shower will streak across the skies this week as Earth passes through debris left behind by a comet that takes about 2,000 years to orbit the sun.

The Aurigid meteor shower will remain active until 5 September, with activity expected to peak on the night of 31 August to 1 September.

According to experts, the Aurigids are not as prolific as better-known meteor showers such as the Perseids or Orionids, but are notable for the speed of their meteors — and their connection to the long-period comet C/1911 N1, known as Kiess.

For Australian stargazers, however, this year's shower will be a difficult one to spot.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Meteor showers occur when Earth passes through streams of dust and debris left behind by comets or asteroids as they travel around the sun.

As a comet approaches the sun, heat causes material from its icy nucleus to escape, leaving dust and rocky particles along its orbit.

When Earth crosses one of these debris trails, the particles enter our atmosphere at high speed and burn up, producing the streaks of light we see as meteors.

Andrew Tomkins, a professor at the School of Earth, Atmosphere and Environment at Monash University, told SBS News: "You can think of it as dirty snowballs."

The Aurigids are associated with Kiess, a long-period comet whose orbit takes it far beyond the planets of our solar system, named after astronomer Carl Clarence Kiess, who discovered it.

There are two broad groups of comets: short-period comets which take fewer than 200 years to orbit the sun, and long-period comets which take more than 200 years.

Short-period comets are generally thought to originate in the Kuiper belt beyond Neptune, while long-period comets are associated with the distant Oort Cloud.

He said the Oort Cloud is so distant that spacecraft such as the Voyager missions have not travelled through it. Scientists have inferred its existence from the behaviour and origins of long-period comets.

Kiess is one of those long-period comets, with an estimated orbital period of about 2,000 years. It was discovered in 1911 and is now billions of kilometres away.

The Aurigids are a relatively minor meteor shower, with a typical peak rate of around six meteors per hour under ideal observing conditions.

Tomkins said Aurigids enter Earth's atmosphere at about "66 or 67km per second".

That makes them considerably faster than many meteors associated with shorter-period comets.

Tomkins said meteors from short-period comets move at about 15km per second, while pieces of rocket debris, which can sometimes be mistaken for meteors, travel at around 8km per second.

body.zh: 本周，一场小型流星雨将划过天空，因为地球将穿过一颗绕太阳运行大约 2000 年的彗星留下的碎片。 御里座流星雨将持续活跃到 9 月 5 日，活动预计在 8 月 31 日至 9 月 1 日夜间达到顶峰。 据专家称，御夫座流星雨不像英仙座流星雨或猎户座流星雨等流星雨那样多产，但因其流星雨的速度而闻名，而且它们与长周期彗星 C/1911 N1（称为基斯）的联系而闻名。 然而，对于澳大利亚的观星者来说，今年的流星雨将很难观测到。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 当地球穿过彗星或小行星绕太阳运行时留下的尘埃和碎片流时，就会发生流星雨。 当彗星接近太阳时，热量导致其冰核中的物质逸出，在其轨道上留下灰尘和岩石颗粒。 当地球穿过这些碎片轨迹之一时，这些粒子高速进入我们的大气层并燃烧，产生我们所看到的流星光条纹。 莫纳什大学地球、大气和环境学院教授安德鲁·汤姆金斯告诉SBS新闻：“你可以把它想象成肮脏的雪球。” 御夫座流星雨与基斯有关，基斯是一颗长周期彗星，其轨道远远超出太阳系的行星，以发现它的天文学家卡尔·克拉伦斯·基斯的名字命名。 彗星分为两大类：绕太阳公转一周时间不到 200 年的短周期彗星和绕太阳运行一周超过 200 年的长周期彗星。 短周期彗星通常被认为起源于海王星以外的柯伊伯带，而长周期彗星则与遥远的奥尔特云有关。 他说，奥尔特云距离如此遥远，航海者号等航天器还没有穿过它。科学家根据长周期彗星的行为和起源推断出它的存在。 基斯彗星是长周期彗星之一，估计轨道周期约为 2000 年。它于 1911 年被发现，现在距地球数十亿公里。 御夫座流星雨是一场相对较小的流星雨，在理想的观测条件下，典型的峰值速率约为每小时六颗流星。 汤姆金斯说，御夫座流星雨以大约“每秒 66 或 67 公里”的速度进入地球大气层。 这使得它们比许多与较短周期彗星相关的流星要快得多。 汤姆金斯说，短周期彗星流星的移动速度约为每秒 15 公里，而火箭碎片有时会被误认为是流星，其移动速度约为每秒 8 公里。 御夫座流星雨也很不寻常，因为……

reflection.en: The Aurigid meteor shower, though minor, offers a glimpse into the vast, ordered cosmos, reminding us of the comet Kiess's precise 2,000-year journey. Isaiah 40:26 invites us to lift our eyes and consider the Creator who brings out the starry host by number, calling each by name. This celestial dance, from the smallest meteor to the longest-orbiting comet,...

verse.textEn: There is a time for everything, and a season for every activity under the heavens.

As Liat testified about living in...

title.en: WA Labor faces 'tough fight' as One Nation targets historic by-election win
title.zh: 西澳工党面临“艰难一战”，一国党剑指历史性补选胜利

summary.en: Recent polling indicates a surge in support for One Nation in the Secret Harbour electorate, while Labor's vote share has remained stable.
summary.zh: 最新民调显示，一国党在秘密港选区的支持率有所上升，但工党的得票率保持稳定。

body.en:
Labor's stranglehold on the nation's richest state is about to be tested with the rising popularity of One Nation putting a safe seat in doubt.

Voters in the beach-side seat of Secret Harbour, south of Perth, are heading to the polls on Saturday after long-serving MP and senior government minister Paul Papalia's mid-term retirement triggered a state by-election.

"The momentum appears to be with One Nation," political analyst John Phillimore told AAP.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

But the devil could be in the detail, with a recent survey showing support for Labor holding steady at 33 per cent of the primary vote in Western Australia.

One Nation was up three per cent since June, running equal with the Liberals, with 21 per cent of the vote.

"One Nation support is not as high as it is in other parts of the country, so you'd have to be a little bit cautious about calling it early," Phillimore, executive director of Curtin University's John Curtin Institute of Public Policy said.

"By the same token, in a by-election the government was always going to have a big swing against it."

WA Premier Roger Cook concedes it will be a battle to hold the outer suburban, mortgage-belt seat despite Labor's 11.5 per cent margin.

"At the moment, you see a surge on the east coast in popularity of One Nation," he told reporters on Friday.

Cook was also quick to point out that very little rides on the result for his government, which won 46 lower house seats out of 59 in the 2025 state election — the party's third successive landslide victory.

One Nation's performance in tradie-haven Secret Harbour will be of interest across the nation, particularly Victoria, which has a state election in November.

It could have longer-term implications for senior federal Liberal MP Andrew Hastie, whose marginal seat of Canning takes in the Secret Harbour electorate and is being openly targeted by One Nation.

Hastie, considered a future Liberal leader, has vowed to defend the seat which he retained last year on a reduced margin of 6.5 per cent.

One Nation is expected to soon announce a candidate for Canning in the next federal election.

For the latest from SBS News, download our app and subscribe to our newsletter .
body.zh: 随着“一国党”的日益受欢迎，工党对这个国家最富有州的控制即将受到考验，这使得其安全席位受到质疑。 长期任职的国会议员兼高级政府部长保罗·帕帕利亚(Paul Papalia)中期退休引发州补选，珀斯南部秘密港海滨席位的选民将于周六前往投票站。 政治分析家约翰·菲利摩尔 (John Phillimore) 告诉澳联社：“这一势头似乎属于一国党。” 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 但问题可能出在细节上，最近的一项调查显示，西澳大利亚州初选选票中工党的支持率稳定在 33%。 自 6 月以来，一国党的支持率上升了 3%，与自由党持平，得票率为 21%。 科廷大学约翰·科廷公共政策研究所执行主任菲利莫尔表示：“一国党的支持率并不像该国其他地区那么高，因此提前宣布这一计划必须要谨慎。” “出于同样的原因，在补选中，政府总是会大力反对。” 西澳州长罗杰·库克承认，尽管工党的优势率为 11.5%，但争夺远郊抵押贷款带席位将是一场战斗。 “目前，你会看到东海岸‘一国党’的受欢迎程度激增，”他周五告诉记者。 库克还很快指出，他的政府在2025年州选举中赢得了下议院59个席位中的46个席位，这对选举结果影响不大，这是该党连续第三次取得压倒性胜利。 One Nation 在贸易天堂 Secret Harbor 的表演将引起全国的关注，尤其是维多利亚州，该州将于 11 月举行州选举。 这可能会对高级联邦自由党议员安德鲁·哈斯蒂(Andrew Hastie)产生更长期的影响，他在坎宁的边缘席位占据了秘密港选民的席位，并且正成为一国党的公开攻击目标。 哈斯蒂被认为是未来的自由党领袖，他誓言要捍卫去年以 6.5% 的优势保住的席位。 预计一国党将很快在下届联邦选举中宣布坎宁的候选人。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

verse.textEn: It is God who judges: He brings one down, he exalts another.

title.en: 130,000 faces scanned in a week: The technology changing Australian policing
title.zh: 一周内扫描13万张人脸：改变澳大利亚警务的技术

summary.en: Australian police departments are increasingly using artificial intelligence for surveillance and predictive policing. In Western Australia, a trial of facial recognition software scanned 130,000 pedestrians in one week, comparing their faces against watchlists. Experts are warning about the need to set clear...
summary.zh: 澳大利亚警方越来越多地使用人工智能进行监控和预测性警务。在西澳大利亚州，一项面部识别软件的试验在一周内扫描了13万名行人，并将其面部与监视名单进行比对。专家们警告，需要为这项技术设定明确的界限，以避免出现反乌托邦的未来。

body.en:
Artificial intelligence is increasingly used by police departments across Australia, with experts warning that lines must be drawn over the technology's use, invoking the dystopian world depicted in George Orwell's novel Nineteen Eighty-Four as a potential future to avoid.

Police departments are starting to trial the use of AI technology for "various forms of surveillance" and "predictive policing", professor Toby Walsh, chief scientist at the UNSW AI Institute, told SBS News.

In WA, police have been trialling AI facial recognition software to scan pedestrians on the street and compare their faces against watchlists. In the trial's first week, 130,000 people were scanned, leading to 18 arrests.

Walsh said that while most people would be "pleased" with the result, he believes such public surveillance is "an erosion of the things that we used to value".

"The question is, how much are we willing to trade those values for the benefits that the technology is bringing?"

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Overseas, the rise of AI in surveillance technology has become an increasingly contested topic.

In the United States, citizens have been taking action against the surveillance cameras of the AI company Flock Safety, which has tens of thousands of devices across the country. Videos of people destroying the cameras have gone viral on social media.

Tom Sulston, head of policy at the advocacy group Digital Rights Watch, told SBS News that, while Flock cameras are not currently used outside of the US, "plenty" of companies in Australia are doing "similar things".

Palantir, the US data analytics firm contracted by military and US immigration forces, and Cellebrite, an Israeli digital forensics company working with law enforcement, both have tens of millions of dollars in government and private contracts in Australia.

"We should be concerned," Sulston said. "We have a right to go out in public without being surveilled, without having our biometric data uploaded to the cloud, and without it being used for purposes we don't really know."

Both have said that governments across the country need to rapidly turn their focus to expanding individual privacy laws, particularly as wearable surveillance technology like smart glasses become more widespread.

"We do have some legislation that covers public surveillance, but the more companies that get into that market, the more pressure there will be to relax them," Sulston said.

Walsh argues that a line between privacy and security "has to be drawn" as AI has made previously impossible levels of surveillance mundane.

"The one thing that George Orwell got wrong: it wasn't people watching people. It was computers,...
body.zh: 澳大利亚各地警察部门越来越多地使用人工智能，专家警告说，必须在该技术的使用上划定界限，并援引乔治·奥威尔小说《十九八十四》中描绘的反乌托邦世界作为潜在的未来。 新南威尔士大学人工智能研究所首席科学家托比·沃尔什教授告诉 SBS 新闻，警察部门正在开始尝试使用人工智能技术进行“各种形式的监视”和“预测性警务”。 在西澳，警方一直在试用人工智能面部识别软件来扫描街上的行人，并将他们的面部与监视名单进行比较。在审判的第一周，13 万人接受了扫描，导致 18 人被捕。 沃尔什表示，虽然大多数人会对结果感到“满意”，但他认为这种公共监视“是对我们过去重视的事物的侵蚀”。 “问题是，我们愿意用这些价值来换取技术带来的好处多少？” 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 在海外，人工智能在监控技术领域的兴起已成为一个日益引起争议的话题。 在美国，公民一直在对人工智能公司 Flock Safety 的监控摄像头采取行动，该公司在全国拥有数万台设备。人们毁坏摄像机的视频在社交媒体上疯传。 倡导组织“数字权利观察”(Digital Rights Watch) 的政策负责人汤姆·苏斯顿 (Tom Sulston) 告诉 SBS 新闻，虽然 Flock 摄像机目前在美国以外的地区尚未使用，但澳大利亚“很多”公司正在做“类似的事情”。 Palantir 是与军方和美国移民部队签约的美国数据分析公司，而 Cellebrite 是一家与执法部门合作的以色列数字取证公司，两者在澳大利亚都拥有价值数千万美元的政府和私人合同。 “我们应该担心，”苏尔斯顿说。 “我们有权在公共场合外出，而不会受到监视，不会将我们的生物识别数据上传到云端，也不会将其用于我们真正不知道的目的。” 两人都表示，全国各地的政府需要迅速将重点转向扩大个人隐私法，特别是随着智能眼镜等可穿戴监控技术变得越来越普遍。 苏尔斯顿说：“我们确实有一些涵盖公共监控的立法，但进入该市场的公司越多，放松监管的压力就越大。” 沃尔什认为，隐私和安全之间“必须划清界限”，因为人工智能已经使以前不可能达到的监控水平变得平凡。 “乔治·奥威尔犯错的一件事是：不是人在看人。而是电脑……

As experts warn against a 'dystopian world' akin to Orwell's *Nineteen Eighty-Four*, this reminds us to be prudent, discerning the potential dangers of new capabilities. title.en: More Australians are buying homes later. What does that mean for retirement?
title.zh: 更多澳大利亚人晚年购房。这对退休生活意味着什么？

summary.en: As more Australians become homeowners later in life, what happens when a mortgage long outlasts your working life?
summary.zh: 随着越来越多的澳大利亚人晚年才成为房主，当抵押贷款期限远超工作年限时，会发生什么？

body.en:
Share your feedback and help us improve this feature. Read more about how we use AI at SBS here.

The 52-year-old bought his first home about a decade ago and refinanced it in 2024, locking in a new 30-year loan term just before he turned 50.

He's among a growing cohort of Australians buying their first home later in life. People over the age of 40 accounted for nearly one in five first-home buyers last year (18.7 per cent), according to data from one of Australia's largest mortgage brokers, Aussie Home Loans.

At the other end, people under the age of 20 made up around a quarter of first-home buyers in 2005, compared with less than 0.5 per cent in 2025.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

As housing affordability pressures make it harder for young Australians to enter the market, solutions designed to ease the path to home ownership have increasingly focused on expanding access to credit — allowing buyers to borrow more, with smaller deposits or longer mortgage terms.

Low-deposit loans can be accessed through the federal government's 5 per cent deposit scheme , while family guarantor loans allow first-time buyers to borrow up to 100 per cent of the purchase price.

Meanwhile, more lenders are offering 40-year mortgage terms , meaning some borrowers could be signing up to make repayments well into their later years.

If a growing number of Australians are buying homes later while taking on larger loans for longer, what happens when they reach retirement still saddled with mortgage debt?

According to James Graham, a housing economics expert at the University of Sydney, without massively expanding housing supply, broadening access to credit alone is not a sustainable solution.

When the government introduced its 5 per cent deposit scheme last year, designed to help first-home buyers, the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) predicted the measure would likely "put at least some further upward pressure" on housing price growth.

By March, the value of new loans taken out by first-home buyers was around 11 per cent higher than before the scheme was expanded in October, with the increase largely reflecting bigger average loan sizes, according to the RBA.

Graham says buying a first home later in life could have consequences beyond carrying mortgage debt into retirement. Entering the market at 40 or 50 leaves less time to build housing wealth and can reduce people's ability to move as their lives change.

"People are likely to be locked in for longer," he explains, warning that some buyers may end up remaining in homes that were intended as a first step into the market rather than a last stop.

"It means that people can't move back to communities that...

reflection.en: The news that nearly one in five first-home buyers in Australia are over 40, with some taking on 30-year mortgages into their retirement years, highlights the growing challenge of long-term financial commitments. Proverbs 22:7 reminds us that debt can create a form of servitude, binding our future choices. In an uncertain economic landscape, this trend...

title.en: Pornography, the 'manosphere' and sextortion: How educators are taking on a growing crisis
title.zh: 色情内容、“男性圈”和性勒索：教育工作者如何应对日益严重的危机

summary.en: Sexual violence is rising amongst young Australians. This consent educator thinks curiosity is a potential solution.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚年轻人中的性暴力正在上升。这位性同意教育工作者认为好奇心可能是一个解决方案。

body.en:
This article contains references to child sexual abuse and sexual assault.

The death of a 16-year-old girl after a suspected sexual strangulation act has unearthed major concerns about the increasing rate of young people experiencing and perpetrating sexual violence.

Consent educator Sarnia Ralston told SBS News that sexual strangulation is "not a freak occurrence" in young people's sexual experiences.

"We need young people to know that sexual strangulation is not something that you can ever do safely," she said.

"The exposure to online pornography has a direct correlation to young people's expectations of sex."

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The girl's death comes days after three students were charged with the sexual assault of a 14-year-old girl in Bondi, and three boys were charged with the sexual assault of a 17-year-old girl in Sydney's McCarthur region.

"Escalating rates of sexual violence, particularly amongst young people, are a huge concern that we need to address," Social Services Minister Tanya Plibersek said in parliament.

"Almost 40 per cent of victims of sexual assault are between the ages of 10 and 17, and we know that online harms are spilling into real-life harm."

Plibersek said "sexual strangulation is becoming more commonplace" due to children being exposed to "violent and degrading pornography".

According to the Breathless Campaign, 57 per cent of young Australians have been strangled by a partner during sex and 51 per cent have strangled a partner during sex.

Ralston is the Queensland and Northern Territory projects executive manager and facilitator trainer for a primary prevention program called Love Bites.

Operated by the National Association for Prevention of Child Abuse and Neglect, Love Bites is a trauma-informed and evidence-based respectful relationships program teaching young people across Australia since 2003.

A national network of grassroots facilitators delivers it to young people aged 11 to 17.

Designed in line with Australia's consent curriculum, it's "scaffolded according to their developmental needs" and addresses topics like consent, technology-facilitated abuse, pornography and coercive control.

"It's a universal program that really challenges the drivers of violence ... we unpack what the attitudes and beliefs are that form somebody's actions or behaviours," said Ralston.

In 2022, almost 40 per cent of young people had already encountered online pornography by the age of 13.

Ralston said pornography and its effects are so pervasive that the Love Bites senior program is now being delivered to the youngest cohort.

Matthew 18:6 serves as a stark warning about the severe consequences for those who cause harm to children. This crisis calls for urgent attention to protect the...

title.en: Hannah Ferguson: ‘I’m not Zohran Mamdani, I’m not that cool. But that’s the bar I want to set’
title.zh: 汉娜·弗格森：“我不如佐兰·马姆达尼那么酷。但这就是我想设定的标准”

summary.en: Hannah Ferguson, under 30, has authored two books, established a progressive media company, and aims to unseat the current prime minister. The article follows her as she discusses her parliamentary aspirations in Sydney's inner-west, even after encountering an older couple who, while liking her, disagreed with her...
summary.zh: 汉娜·弗格森（Hannah Ferguson）不到30岁，已出版两本书，创办了一家进步媒体公司，并立志要取代现任总理。文章讲述了她在悉尼内西区讨论竞选议员的计划，即使在遇到一对虽然喜欢她但却反对她政治抱负的老夫妇之后。

body.en: She’s written two books, launched a progressive media firm and plans to dethrone the prime minister – all before she turns 30. What is she about? Hannah Ferguson has just left the home of an older couple who disagree that she should run for parliament when I meet her at the Lewisham West light rail stop on the Greenway in Sydney’s inner-west. It is a perfect sunny winter afternoon and we are in the geographical centre of Grayndler, the electorate she wants to take from the prime minister , Anthony Albanese. The couple emailed Ferguson after she announced her plans to run, declaring, she says, that they liked her but didn’t agree with her tilt for parliament. She tells me she asked to sit down with them and explain herself, and believes they’ve come around to the idea of her running – and might even support her. Continue reading...
body.zh: 她写了两本书，创办了一家进步媒体公司，并计划废黜总理——这一切都是在她 30 岁之前完成的。她在做什么？汉娜·弗格森 (Hannah Ferguson) 刚刚离开一对年长夫妇的家，当我在悉尼内西区 Greenway 的 Lewisham West 轻轨车站见到她时，他们不同意她应该竞选议会议员。这是一个完美的阳光明媚的冬日下午，我们正处于格雷德尔的地理中心，她想从总理安东尼·阿尔巴尼斯那里夺取选民。在她宣布参选计划后，这对夫妇给弗格森发了一封电子邮件，她说，他们喜欢她，但不同意她对议会的倾斜。她告诉我，她要求与他们坐下来解释自己的情况，并相信他们已经接受了她参选的想法，甚至可能会支持她。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Hannah Ferguson's drive to enter parliament and reshape public discourse embodies a commitment to justice and action. Micah 6:8 calls us to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with Yahweh. Ferguson's ambition, while perhaps not explicitly framed in these terms, reflects a desire to engage with the public square and pursue a vision for her community.
reflection.zh: 汉娜·弗格森（Hannah Ferguson）渴望进入议会并重塑公共话语，体现了她对正义和行动的承诺。弥迦书6章8节呼吁我们行公义，好怜悯，谦卑地与雅伟同行。弗格森的雄心壮志，即使没有明确以此为框架，也反映了她参与公共领域并追求社区愿景的愿望。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: This Australian crisis is entering a 'confronting' new phase
title.zh: 这场澳大利亚危机正进入一个“令人不安”的新阶段

summary.en: Older Australians accounted for more than half of the fatalities in a record high of drug-induced deaths, with 2,596 deaths documented in 2024, 80.5 percent of which were from unintentional overdose. Since 2008, drug-induced deaths have surpassed road fatalities.
summary.zh: 根据2024年记录的2596例药物致死事件，其中80.5%为意外过量，老年澳大利亚人占了死亡人数的一半以上，创下药物致死新高。自2008年以来，药物致死人数已超过道路交通事故死亡人数。

body.en:
This article contains references to substance abuse and suicide.

Drug-induced deaths have hit a record high, with older Australians accounting for more than half of the fatalities.

Australia's Annual Overdose Report, released by the Penington Institute, documented 2,596 drug-induced deaths in 2024, with 80.5 per cent being from unintentional overdose.

Since 2008, more Australians have died from drug-induced deaths than road fatalities — with an average of 31 years lost per death.

"The data is quite confronting," Jake Dizard, director of research at the Penington Institute, told SBS News.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The report found that the median age of people dying from drug overdose is increasing.

For the first time, those aged between 50 and 59 accounted for almost half of all unintentional overdose deaths.

Dizard said it could be attributed to "an ageing large cohort of people who started using drugs in the 1990s and early 2000s".

"As that cohort has got older, they have become more vulnerable to drug-induced death because of the length of time that they have been using drugs and the accumulating sort of comorbidities," he said.

The report also noted that of the 428 drug-induced suicides, 39 per cent were people aged 60 and over.

Australian Alcohol and Other Drugs Council CEO Melanie Walker said the report confirms that overdose is not a "young people problem".

"It affects young people. It also affects older people. Overdose can be from illicit drug use, or it can be from prescription drug use."

The report also found that men accounted for 72.7 per cent of unintentional drug-induced deaths, people living in regional and rural areas had higher rates of death than those living in capital cities, and Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people experienced higher rates of overdose.

In 2024, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people experienced an overdose rate of 29.3 per 100,000 compared to 6.6 per 100,000 for non-Indigenous people.

Opioids were responsible for 42 per cent of all drug-induced deaths in 2024, with heroin-related deaths rising from 101 deaths in 2001 to 488 deaths in 2024.

Amphetamines were involved in 772 deaths, a record high for the drug, and cocaine was involved in 141 deaths. Benzodiazepines, alcohol and antidepressants also contributed to drug-induced deaths.

Dizard said that the use of prescription opioids, such as oxycodone, has declined since 2021 — a trend seen across "a number of categories of prescription drugs".

Cocaine was the only recorded drug that saw a decrease in the median age of people dying from overdose.
