title.en: Tang says easier Huanggang crossings on the card
title.zh: 邓炳强称皇岗口岸过境将更便捷

summary.en: Officials announced that travelers at the redeveloped Huanggang Port will be able to use either their Hong Kong ID card or home-return permit for e-Channel crossings. This came after the government conducted its final stress test involving 20,000 civil servants, aiming to make cross-boundary travel more convenient...
summary.zh: 官员宣布，重建后的皇岗口岸将允许旅客使用香港身份证或回乡证通过电子通道过境。此前，政府进行了第四次也是最后一次压力测试，有2万名公务员参与，旨在通过“一地两检”安排，使跨境出行更加便利。

body.en: Travellers using e-Channels at the redeveloped Huanggang Port would be able to use either their Hong Kong ID card or the home-return permit to make the crossing. The announcement by Secretary for Security Chris Tang came as the government conducted its fourth and final stress test at the port facility on Saturday, which saw 20,000 civil servants take part. The port adopts a "joint clearance" arrangement, with travellers only needing to queue up once to have their documents and identity verified, rather than passing through separate immigration checkpoints on both sides. Tang said he hopes the new setup will make cross-boundary travel far more convenient. "I would like to announce that now for passengers using our e-Channels, whether you are going to the mainland or come back from the mainland to Hong Kong, you can use either your Hong Kong ID card or your [home-return permit]," he said. "Although some of you may use the facial recognition contactless system, please remember that you still need to bring along your Hong Kong ID card and your [home-return permit]." Tang noted that all 202 immigration counters and e-Channels were tested during Saturday's drill. About 300 vehicles also took part in a stress test for the "joint one-stop" lanes – a new automated vehicle clearance system. Tang said the process ran smoothly, with waiting times expected to stay under 10 minutes per vehicle, even during peak hours. Customs officers also demonstrated how X-ray machines and sniffer dogs are deployed to inspect suspicious vehicles. Additionally, the first and third mezzanine floors of the building were opened up for the first time to test departure and arrival clearances for vehicle passengers. Around 300 public transport vehicles participated in a stress test at the public transport interchange. As for Wi-Fi connectivity, Tang acknowledged there was room for improvement after some participants reported slow speeds. Overall, Tang hailed the drill as "smooth and successful", as clearance time stayed under 15 minutes for each traveller. He added that authorities would conduct an internal review before deciding whether another drill is necessary. Edited by Azam Khan
body.zh: 在重建后的皇岗口岸使用电子通道的旅客将可以使用香港身份证或回乡证过境。保安局局长邓克里斯 (Chris Tang) 宣布这一消息之际，政府周六在港口设施进行了第四次也是最后一次压力测试，共有 2 万名公务员参加。该口岸采取“联合通关”安排，旅客只需排队一次即可核实证件和身份，无需分别通过两侧单独的出入境检查站。唐表示，他希望新的设置能让跨境旅行更加便捷。他说：“我想宣布，现在使用我们e-道的旅客，无论是去内地还是从内地回香港，都可以使用香港身份证或回乡证。” “虽然有些人可能会使用面部识别非接触式系统，但请记住，您仍然需要携带香港身份证和[回乡证]。”唐指出，在周六的演习中，所有202个出入境柜台和电子通道都经过了测试。约300辆车辆还参加了“联合一站式”车道——一种新型自动车辆清关系统——的压力测试。唐说，整个过程进展顺利，即使在高峰时段，每辆车的等待时间预计也不会超过 10 分钟。海关官员还演示了如何部署X光机和嗅探犬来检查可疑车辆。此外，首次开放大楼一楼和三楼夹层，测试车辆乘客的出发和到达许可。约300辆公共交通车辆在公共交通交汇处参加了压力测试。至于 Wi-Fi 连接，在一些参与者报告速度缓慢后，唐承认还有改进的空间。总体而言，唐称赞此次演习“顺利且成功”，每位旅客的通关时间控制在15分钟以内。他补充说，当局将进行内部审查，然后再决定是否有必要再次进行演习。阿扎姆·汗编辑

Proverbs 11:14 reminds us that 'where there is no guidance, a people falls, but in an abundance of counselors there is safety.' This effort to streamline cross-boundary travel for convenience...

body.en: Chief Executive John Lee said on Saturday HK$50 million from the Disaster Relief Fund has been earmarked for those affected by the mudslide at Gyirong Port in the Xizang Autonomous Region. Expressing his condolences, he said the fund's advisory committee would handle the funding application in a prompt manner. Lee also extended his gratitude to frontline rescuers and wished timely support for those affected by the disaster. Edited by Azam Khan

title.en: Number of missing in Nepal, China floods soars to nearly 3,000
title.zh: 尼泊尔、中国洪涝失踪人数飙升至近3000人

summary.en: Rescuers in Nepal and China were still battling Saturday to locate thousands of people missing days after a deadly, tsunami-like wall of water and debris swept through the Himalayan region, engulfing villages. The number of missing soared close to 3,000 Saturday, latest figures...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Rescuers in Nepal and China were still battling Saturday to locate thousands of people missing days after a deadly, tsunami-like wall of water and debris swept through the Himalayan region, engulfing villages. A woman looks at photographs of the missing and dead following flash floods in Nepal, outside a hospital in Kathmandu on August 29, 2026. Photo: Prakash Mathema/AFP. The number of missing soared close to 3,000 Saturday, latest figures from both countries showed, with 633 bodies recovered — and reports of some dead possibly swept downstream as far away as India. In an area home to vast energy infrastructure projects, Nepal’s disaster authority added 933 hydropower workers to a missing persons list already including trekkers and pilgrims to Tibet’s sacred Mount Kailash. Those that made it out say they have lost everything and now face an agonising wait to discover the fate of missing loved ones, and the prospect of rebuilding their lives from nothing. “All the settlements near the river were swept away. There is nothing left,” survivor Buddhi Ram Dangol told AFP. Samjhana Thing said she had been waiting three days for news of her missing brother. Satellite image showing the aftermath of the China-Nepal flash flood, which occurred on Wednesday, August 26, 2026. Photo: Vantor via CC BY-NC 4.0. “We don’t know anything. Hopefully he is in a safe place,” she said. ‘Enormous’ trauma The trauma of Wednesday’s catastrophe has been “enormous”, and as many as 93,000 people may have been affected, the Red Cross said, with the death toll expected to rise. Emergency teams had been racing to retrieve survivors from affected zones, where the widespread devastation meant food and water supplies were running out. Compounding the search for the missing have been fears of further flooding in affected areas. The deluge of ice and mud caused huge lakes to form, and one of these formations has become a direct threat to emergency workers scouring the region for survivors. Embed from Getty Images Nepali police urged all rescuers to “immediately move to a safe location”, saying they had received information that “a water dam has burst again on the Tibetan side”. In Tibet, where Chinese authorities are the only source of information, Beijing suspended its rescue operation at the hardest-hit area of Gyirong over the risk of renewed flooding, before saying the threat had eased. State news agency Xinhua reported early Saturday morning that two villagers had been rescued in the area. ‘All swept away’ On the Nepali side of the border, the military located people trapped in the tunnel of the Trishuli 3A hydropower project, where they were working to find a way in...
body.zh: 周六，尼泊尔和中国的救援人员仍在努力寻找数千名失踪人员，几天前，一场致命的海啸般的水墙和残骸席卷了喜马拉雅地区，吞没了村庄。 2026 年 8 月 29 日，加德满都一家医院外，一名妇女正在查看尼泊尔山洪爆发后失踪人员和死者的照片。照片：Prakash Mathema/法新社。两国的最新数据显示，周六失踪人数飙升至近 3,000 人，已找到 633 具尸体，而有关部分死者的报道可能远至印度。在一个拥有大型能源基础设施项目的地区，尼泊尔灾害管理局将 933 名水电工人添加到失踪人员名单中，其中包括前往西藏圣山冈仁波齐的徒步旅行者和朝圣者。那些成功逃脱的人表示，他们失去了一切，现在面临着痛苦的等待，寻找失踪亲人的命运，以及白手起家重建生活的前景。幸存者Buddhi Ram Dangol告诉法新社：“河边的所有定居点都被冲走了。什么都没有留下。” Samjhana Thing 说，她已经等了三天才收到失踪弟弟的消息。卫星图像显示 2026 年 8 月 26 日星期三发生的中国-尼泊尔山洪爆发的后果。照片：Vantor，来自 CC BY-NC 4.0。 “我们什么都不知道。希望他在安全的地方，”她说。 “巨大”创伤 红十字会表示，周三灾难造成的创伤“巨大”，可能有多达 93,000 人受到影响，预计死亡人数还会上升。应急小组一直在努力从受影响地区救回幸存者，那里的大范围破坏意味着食物和水供应即将耗尽。由于担心受影响地区会进一步发生洪水，寻找失踪人员的工作变得更加复杂。大量的冰和泥浆形成了巨大的湖泊，其中一个湖泊已经成为紧急救援人员在该地区搜寻幸存者的直接威胁。尼泊尔警方敦促所有救援人员“立即转移到安全地点”，称他们收到“西藏一侧水坝再次决堤”的消息。在西藏，中国当局是唯一的信息来源。北京方面因洪水再次爆发的风险而暂停了在吉隆受灾最严重地区的救援行动，随后又表示威胁已经缓解。官方通讯社新华社周六凌晨报道称，两名村民在该地区获救。 “全部被冲走” 在边境的尼泊尔一侧，军方找到了被困在 Trishuli 3A 水电项目隧道中的人们，他们正在那里寻找出路……

title.en: China removes high-ranking officers Zhang Youxia and Liu Zhenli from key military body
title.zh: 中国解除主要军事机构高级军官张又侠和刘振立的职务

summary.en: China removed two high-ranking officers from the country’s main military body on Friday, state media reported, seven months after it was announced that Zhang Youxia and Liu Zhenli were being investigated for “serious violations of the law”. Zhang’s position as the more senior of...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: China removed two high-ranking officers from the country’s main military body on Friday, state media reported, seven months after it was announced that Zhang Youxia and Liu Zhenli were being investigated for “serious violations of the law”. Zhang Youxia, vice chairperson of the Central Military Commission (CMC), in Russia in 2017. Photo: Kremlin. Zhang’s position as the more senior of two vice chairmen on the Central Military Commission (CMC) had made him China’s highest-ranked general. In January though, the defence ministry said that Zhang and Liu were “suspected of serious violations of discipline and the law”, a common euphemism for corruption. The announcement fit into the sweeping anti-graft drive that has defined President Xi Jinping’s time in power — but Zhang’s fall from grace in particular shocked observers, given his seniority and the perception he was close to Xi. On Friday, state news agency Xinhua said in a report on a meeting of the standing committee of China’s parliament that “the meeting decided to remove Zhang Youxia from the post of Vice Chairman of the Central Military Commission of the People’s Republic of China”. Liu Zhenli. Photo: China gov’t. Liu, who was chief of staff of the CMC’s joint staff department, which oversees combat planning, was also removed, it said. The CMC is China’s most important military decision-making body, chaired by Xi. Technically, there are two — a state CMC and a Communist Party CMC. “For practical purposes, however, they are treated as one (and) the same in (China’s) bureaucracy,” Asia Society’s Lyle Morris has written. Friday’s announcement relates to Zhang and Liu’s positions in the state CMC rather than the Party one. Their removal will leave the CMC, which is supposed to have seven members, with only two known representatives: Xi and anti-corruption chief Zhang Shengmin. Zhang and Liu’s whereabouts are unknown, and no details have been given regarding the accusations against them. Chinese President Xi Jinping attends a China-US bilateral meeting at the Gimhae International Airport terminal, in Busan, South Korea, on October 30, 2025. Photo: The White House, via Flickr. At the time the investigation was announced, an editorial in the People’s Liberation Army (PLA) Daily said the two men had “seriously trampled on and undermined the system of ultimate responsibility resting with the CMC chairman” — that is, Xi.
body.zh: 据官方媒体报道，中国周五从国家主要军事机构撤换了两名高级军官，而此时距离宣布张又侠和刘振里因“严重违法”接受调查七个月。 2017 年，中央军委副主席张又侠在俄罗斯。照片：克里姆林宫。张作为中央军委两名副主席中级别较高的一位，这使他成为中国级别最高的将军。不过今年一月，国防部表示张和刘“涉嫌严重违纪违法”，这是腐败的常见委婉说法。这一宣布符合习近平主席执政时期的全面反腐运动，但考虑到张的资历以及他与习近平关系密切的看法，张的失宠尤其令观察人士感到震惊。周五，官方通讯社新华社在中国人大常委会会议的报道中称，“会议决定免去张又侠的中华人民共和国中央军事委员会副主席职务”。刘振利.照片：中国政府。报道称，担任中央军委联合参谋部参谋长的刘也被免职，该部负责监督作战计划。中央军委是中国最重要的军事决策机构，由习近平担任主席。从技术上讲，有两个——国家中央军事委员会和共产党中央军事委员会。亚洲协会的莱尔·莫里斯写道：“然而，出于实际目的，他们在（中国）官僚机构中被视为一个（且）相同的人。”周五的公告涉及张和刘在中央军委的职位，而不是党的一职。他们的撤职将使原本应有七名成员的中央军委只剩下两名已知的代表：习近平和反腐败总书记张生民。张和刘的下落不明，也没有提供有关对他们的指控的细节。 2025 年 10 月 30 日，中国国家主席习近平在韩国釜山金海国际机场航站楼出席中美双边会议。照片：白宫，来自 Flickr。在宣布调查时，《解放军报》的一篇社论称，这两人“严重践踏和破坏了中央军委主席负最终责任的制度”，即习近平。

title.en: New campus to reunite school split by Wang Fuk inferno
title.zh: 新校区将重新整合因宏福地狱而分裂的学校

summary.en: A primary school that saw its campus come perilously close to disaster during November's Wang Fuk Court inferno in Tai Po has moved to a new site ahead of the upcoming academic year. Tai Po Baptist Public School's new campus, located at nearby Fu Shin Estate, sits on a building...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: A primary school that saw its campus come perilously close to disaster during November's Wang Fuk Court inferno in Tai Po has moved to a new site ahead of the upcoming academic year. Tai Po Baptist Public School's new campus, located at nearby Fu Shin Estate, sits on a building that used to house another school. The new campus has seen extensive refurbishment, with the work carried out including upgrades on classrooms, toilets and the assembly hall as well as repainting of external walls, resurfacing of the sports ground and replacement of lifts. The renovation works and subsidies for purchasing new furniture and equipment cost an estimated HK$43.6 million. The Education Bureau has also provided a one-off HK$1 million grant to cover relocation expenses. In the aftermath of the November disaster, the school's students, while waiting for the new campus to be ready, were split up between two other campuses in Tai Po for the rest of the 2025/26 academic year. Officiating at the opening ceremony, Secretary for Education Christine Choi said the new campus marks a pivotal moment for staff and students to reunite in a safe, stable and welcoming learning environment. She also toured the facilities and met with teachers and students. Edited by Azam Khan
body.zh: 11 月大埔宏福苑大火中，一所小学的校园一度濒临灾难，现已在新学年之前搬迁至新址。大埔浸信会公立学校的新校园位于附近的富善村，坐落在一座曾经是另一所学校的建筑物上。新校区进行了大规模的翻新工程，包括升级教室、卫生间和礼堂，以及重新粉刷外墙、重新铺设运动场和更换电梯。装修工程以及购买新家具和设备的补贴预计耗资4,360万港元。教育局亦提供一次性100万港元补助金，以支付搬迁费用。 11 月灾难发生后，学校的学生在等待新校区竣工的同时，在 2025/26 学年余下的时间里被分散到大埔的另外两个校区。教育局局长蔡徐亭主持开幕仪式并表示，新校园标志着教职员工和学生在安全、稳定和温馨的学习环境中重聚的关键时刻。她还参观了学校设施并会见了老师和学生。阿扎姆·汗编辑

title.en: Mable Chan rules out cap on ride-hailing licences
title.zh: Mable Chan 排除了对叫车牌照的限制

summary.en: Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan said on Saturday that there would be no cap on the number of ride-hailing licences issued to companies. Her remarks came a day after the Transport Department invited applications for the licence. Speaking on Commercial Radio, Chan...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan said on Saturday that there would be no cap on the number of ride-hailing licences issued to companies. Her remarks came a day after the Transport Department invited applications for the licence. Speaking on Commercial Radio, Chan said applicants would be selected based on their meeting the government’s requirements and being financially sound. “We are requiring their paid-up capital to be no less than HK$50 million," she said. "According to our initial estimates, this will enable the companies to operate for at least half a year. Chan also said more than 9,000 drivers had signed up for a new combined written test for taxis and ride-hailing vehicles. The department would arrange for the tests to begin in mid-September, she added. On transport support for the new Huanggang Port, Chan said shuttle buses could be arranged for locals and visitors arriving at the crossing during public holiday peak hours. “We hope there can be short-haul shuttle bus routes to take inbound travellers from Huanggang Port to nearby areas such as Tuen Mun, Tai Po and other places, as we hope to disperse the crowds as quickly as possible,” she said. “After multiple drills, we, as well as bus operators, hope to keep improving in this area.” Chan added that a drill held today would involve 20,000 people, further scaling up the stress tests. Edited by Robert Kemp
body.zh: 运输及物流局局长陈美宝周六表示，向公司发放的网约车牌照数量不会受到限制。她是在运输署邀请申请该牌照的第二天发表这番言论的。陈在商业电台发表讲话时表示，将根据申请人是否符合政府要求且财务状况良好来选择申请人。 “我们要求他们的实收资本不少于5000万港元，”她说。 “根据我们的初步估计，这将使公司至少能运营半年。陈女士还表示，已有9000多名司机报名参加新的出租车和网约车联合笔试。部门将安排在9月中旬开始测试。在新皇岗口岸的交通支持方面，陈女士表示，在公共假期高峰时段，可以为当地人和到达口岸的游客安排接驳巴士。“我们希望能有短途接驳巴士”陈补充说，今天举行的演习将涉及 20,000 人，进一步扩大压力测试的规模。罗伯特·坎普编辑

verse.textEn: Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.
verse.textZh: 我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既做在我这弟兄中一个最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。

title.en: Hong Kong court acquits police officer of indecent assault charge after accuser’s testimony rejected
title.zh: 原告证词被驳回后，香港法院宣判警员非礼罪名不成立

summary.en: A Hong Kong court has found a police officer not guilty of indecent assault after rejecting the testimony of his accuser. Officer Ng Ka‑wai pleaded not guilty when he appeared at the Kowloon City Magistrates’ Courts on Friday. According to the case details, the 41-year-old...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: A Hong Kong court has found a police officer not guilty of indecent assault after rejecting the testimony of his accuser. Hong Kong Police Force. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Officer Ng Ka‑wai pleaded not guilty when he appeared at the Kowloon City Magistrates’ Courts on Friday. According to the case details, the 41-year-old allegedly touched the thigh of a female informant and opened a nude photo of her without her consent inside Tsim Sha Tsui Police Station on December 20 last year. The informant was in the station to report being blackmailed with nude photos and defrauded of HK$1.6 million. Police then arranged for Ng to assist the informant in giving a statement. According to the prosecution, the informant told Ng that a fraudster had sent her nude photos of herself using the “View Once” feature on WhatsApp to blackmail her. She then handed her phone to Ng, who she alleged opened one of the photos without her permission. She also alleged that Ng asked her to stand with him to check online bank statements, and then touched her thigh three times. Kowloon City Magistrates’ Courts. Photo: Candice Chau/HKFP. However, Magistrate Arthur Lam said on Friday that what the woman told the court was not consistent with her written statements. For example, the woman told the court that she only realised a suspected “View Once” nude photo had been opened after getting her phone back from the defendant. But during cross-examination, the defence cited her written statement, in which she said that the defendant showed her the nude photos on her mobile and commented on them while viewing them. 💡 If you are suffering from sexual or domestic violence, regardless of your age or gender, contact the police, Harmony House ( click for details ) and/or the Social Welfare Department on 28948896. Dial 999 in emergencies. Lam called the informant’s explanations unconvincing, and the court therefore did not accept her testimony. He ruled that Ng was not guilty of the charge and awarded him legal costs. A conviction for indecent assault in Hong Kong carries a maximum penalty of 10 years’ imprisonment.
body.zh: 香港一家法院在驳回原告的证词后，裁定一名警察无猥亵罪。香港警队。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。警员吴家伟周五在九龙城裁判法院出庭时表示不认罪。案件详情显示，41岁男子涉嫌于去年12月20日在尖沙咀警署内，未经女线人同意，触摸一名女线人的大腿，并打开其裸照。举报人在车站举报遭裸照敲诈，并被骗港币160万元。警方其后安排吴协助举报人供述。据检方称，线人告诉吴某，一名诈骗者利用 WhatsApp 上的“查看一次”功能向她发送了自己的裸照，以勒索她。然后她把手机交给了吴女士，她声称吴女士未经她的许可就打开了其中一张照片。她还声称，吴让她和他站在一起查看网上银行对账单，然后摸了她的大腿三下。九龙城裁判法院。照片：Candice Chau/HKFP。然而，裁判官林亚瑟周五表示，该女子在法庭上所说的与她的书面陈述不一致。例如，该女子告诉法庭，她从被告手中拿回手机后才发现一张疑似“查看一次”的裸照被打开。但在盘问中，辩方引用了她的书面陈述，称被告向她展示了手机上的裸照，并在观看时发表了评论。 💡 如果您遭受性暴力或家庭暴力，无论您的年龄或性别，请与警方、和谐之家（点击查看详情）和/或社会福利署联系：28948896。紧急情况请拨打999。林郑月娥称举报人的解释缺乏说服力，法庭因此不采纳她的证言。他裁定吴无罪，并判给他法律费用。在香港，非礼罪一旦定罪，最高可判处 10 年监禁。

reflection.en: This story draws attention to justice, dignity, and accountability. Micah 6:8 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with justice tempered by mercy, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到公义、尊严与问责。Micah 6:8提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以带着怜悯的公义来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Uber, Didi say preparing to apply for ride-hailing service licence as gov’t invites submissions
title.zh: 优步、滴滴表示正准备申请网约车服务牌照，政府已开放申请

summary.en: Ride-hailing services Uber and Didi have said they are preparing to apply for licences under a new scheme opened by the government on Friday, an effort to regulate the fast-growing industry.
summary.zh: 网约车服务公司优步（Uber）和滴滴出行（Didi）表示，它们正准备根据政府周五启动的新计划申请牌照，该计划旨在规范快速发展的行业。

body.en: Ride-hailing services Uber and Didi have said they are preparing to apply for licences under a new scheme opened by the government on Friday, an effort to regulate the fast-growing industry. The Uber app. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. In response to HKPF, Uber said on Friday: “We are preparing our application for a ride-hailing platform license with a firm commitment to delivering a safe, high-quality experience for passengers and strong support for driver-partners and the Hong Kong Government.” Uber’s reply came as the government opened applications for ride-hailing licences on Friday morning. This follows the passage of a bill last October that introduced laws intended to regulate the sector under a licencing regime. Under the new regime, all ride-hailing platforms must hold a licence to operate in Hong Kong. Ride-hailing drivers must must also hold a specific licence, which is due to be issued from November. Applications to sit the written test for this licence opened earlier this month . Operators applying for a platform licence must have a permanent office in Hong Kong and experience offering services in a city with a comparably large population, and must also provide evidence the company’s financial capacity. Ride-hailing app Didi. Photo: Rhoda Kwan/HKFP. In addition to US-based Uber, mainland China’s Didi has also indicated it will apply. Didi told local media that it welcomed the authorities’ announcement of the application details, and added that the clear criteria introduced by the government is imperative for the regulatory framework’s success. The company said it would submit its application “as soon as possible.” HKFP has reached out to Didi for comment. New legislation Ride-hailing platforms have grown rapidly in recent years by offering convenient services amid mounting public frustration directed at Hong Kong’s conventional taxi fleet. Uber first entered the local market in 2014, followed by Didi in 2018. But ride-hailing vehicles have since operated in a legal grey area with no dedicated legislation. The city’s taxi industry has long accused ride-hailing platforms of impacting cab drivers’ livelihoods . For years, they have pushed the government to introduce a mechanism regulating ride-hailing operators. Vehicles in Hong Kong. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The ride-hailing licence applications opened on Friday are a core part of the government’s long-awaited regulatory efforts. From next August, when the regulatory regime comes into full force, operators of ride-hailing platforms that do not have a licence will face a maximum fine of HK$1 million and up to a year in prison. Drivers convicted of carrying passengers for hire or reward without a permit will be disqualified from...
body.zh: 叫车服务优步和滴滴表示，他们正准备根据政府周五启动的一项新计划申请牌照，以规范这个快速增长的行业。优步应用程序。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。优步周五在回应香港警务处时表示：“我们正在准备申请网约车平台牌照，坚定承诺为乘客提供安全、优质的体验，并为司机合作伙伴和香港政府提供大力支持。”周五上午，政府开放打车牌照申请后，优步做出了回应。此前，去年 10 月通过了一项法案，该法案引入了旨在根据许可制度监管该行业的法律。根据新制度，所有网约车平台必须持有香港运营牌照。网约车司机还必须持有特定许可证，该许可证将于 11 月起颁发。参加该许可证笔试的申请已于本月初开放。申请平台牌照的运营商必须在香港拥有常设办事处，并具有在人口较多的城市提供服务的经验，还必须提供公司的财务能力证明。打车应用滴滴。照片：Rhoda Kwan/HKFP。除了美国的Uber外，中国大陆的滴滴出行也表示将申请。滴滴向当地媒体表示，欢迎当局公布申请细节，并补充说，政府出台的明确标准对于监管框架的成功至关重要。该公司表示将“尽快”提交申请。 HKFP 已联系滴滴征求意见。新立法近年来，随着公众对香港传统出租车队的不满情绪日益浓厚，网约车平台通过提供便捷的服务而迅速发展。优步于 2014 年首次进入当地市场，滴滴也于 2018 年进入。但此后，网约车一直处于法律灰色地带，没有专门的立法。该市的出租车行业长期以来一直指责叫车平台影响出租车司机的生计。多年来，他们一直推动政府引入监管网约车运营商的机制。香港的车辆。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。周五开放的网约车牌照申请是政府期待已久的监管工作的核心部分。从明年8月起，监管制度全面生效，无牌照的网约车平台运营商将面临最高100万港元的罚款和最高一年的监禁。未经许可载客或取酬而被定罪的司机将被取消资格...

reflection.en: As ride-hailing giants Uber and Didi prepare to apply for licenses under Hong Kong's new regulatory scheme, their actions reflect a commitment to operating within established civic structures. This willingness to submit to governing authorities, as outlined in Romans 13:1, is vital for a stable society and for businesses to contribute to the common good. It...
reflection.zh: 随着网约车巨头优步和滴滴准备根据香港新的监管计划申请牌照，它们的行动体现了在既定公民框架内运营的承诺。这种顺服执政掌权者的意愿，正如《罗马书》13:1所阐明的，对于社会稳定和企业为共同利益做出贡献至关重要。它提醒我们，即使在一个快速发展的行业中，与政府负责任的互动也能确保所有公民的安全和优质服务。

verse.textEn: Let everyone be subject to the governing authorities, for there is no authority except that which God has established.
verse.textZh: 在上有权柄的，人人当顺服他，因为没有权柄不是出于神的。

title.en: The London stock market dodged a bullet with Shein | Nils Pratley
title.zh: 伦敦股市避开了 Shein 这颗“子弹”

summary.en: Shein, the Chinese fast-fashion giant, is set to list in Hong Kong with a reduced valuation after a potential London IPO stalled. Despite intense wooing by UK politicians seeking to revitalize the local market with 'tech adrenalin,' significant concerns regarding Shein's business model and ethical practices led to a...
summary.zh: 中国快时尚巨头 Shein 在伦敦上市计划搁置后，将转往香港上市，但估值有所缩水。尽管英国政界此前为了振兴当地市场而积极拉拢，希望注入“技术兴奋剂”，但由于对其商业模式和伦理实践存在重大疑虑，伦敦金融界对于未能成事反而感到一种解脱。

body.en: China’s fashion giant will list in Hong Kong with a shrunken price tag – and big questions over its business model In a parallel world, we might now be preparing for the arrival on the London stock market of Shein, the giant Chinese-founded fast-fashion retailer. Or it could have happened already. The possibility of a London flotation was a running story during 2024 and into last year as politicians from both main parties engaged in behind-the-scenes wooing. Shein was seen as a shot of tech adrenalin for a listless local listings scene, and an opportunity to advertise the UK’s openness to international capital. Continue reading...
body.zh: 中国时尚巨头将以更低的价格在香港上市——其商业模式面临重大质疑在另一个平行世界中，我们现在可能正在为中国创办的大型快时尚零售商 Shein 登陆伦敦股市做准备。或者它可能已经发生了。从 2024 年到去年，随着两大主要政党的政治家都在幕后拉拢，在伦敦上市的可能性一直是一个热门话题。 Shein 被视为为当地无精打采的上市场景注入一剂科技肾上腺素，也是宣传英国对国际资本开放的机会。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The pursuit of rapid economic growth often tempts leaders to overlook the long-term health and ethical foundations of their institutions. While the 'tech adrenalin' of a massive IPO is attractive, true prudence involves recognizing when a short-term gain carries risks that outweigh the benefits. Yahweh values the wisdom that looks beyond the surface of a...
reflection.zh: 对经济快速增长的追求往往诱使领导者忽视机构的长期健康和伦理基础。虽然大规模 IPO 带来的“技术兴奋剂”极具吸引力，但真正的谨慎在于识别短期利益何时携带了超过收益的风险。雅伟看重那种能看透“缩水的价格标签”表面、审视内在工作诚信的智慧。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: The Guardian view on the Tiananmen vigil convictions: Hong Kong too has been silenced. Others should speak out | Editorial
title.zh: 《卫报》评论天安门守夜活动定罪：香港也被噤声。其他人应发声 | 社论

summary.en: Two activists in Hong Kong face jail sentences for organizing commemorations of the 1989 Tiananmen Square crackdown. For decades, Hong Kong was the only place in China where the annual vigil could publicly keep the memory of the pro-democracy protests alive, but recent crackdowns have suppressed these freedoms.
summary.zh: 两名香港社运人士因组织纪念1989年天安门镇压的活动而面临牢狱之灾。几十年来，香港是中国唯一可以公开纪念天安门民主抗议活动的地方，但最近的镇压已经扼杀了这些自由。

body.en: Two activists who organised commemorations of the bloody crackdown on China’s 1989 pro-democracy protests now face jail. Remembering is not a crime For decades, Hong Kong mourned when the mainland could not. Its huge annual Tiananmen vigil kept alive the memory of the 1989 pro-reform protests in Beijing, and of the massacre that suppressed them. Along with Macau, it was the only place in China where the anniversary could be publicly marked and the truth preserved. But the crackdown on the 2019 uprising in Hong Kong has crushed the freedoms that the region once enjoyed. That year’s vigil was the last. On Friday, two leaders of the Hong Kong Alliance, which organised the commemoration, were convicted of incitement to subversion under the draconian national security law. Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, and Chow Hang-tung, 41, face up to 10 years in jail. Do you have an opinion on the issues raised in this article? If you would like to submit a response of up to 300 words by email to be considered for publication in our letters section, please click here . Continue reading...
body.zh: 两名组织纪念中国 1989 年血腥镇压民主抗议活动的活动人士现在面临牢狱之灾。铭记不是犯罪 几十年来，香港一直在哀悼，而大陆却无法铭记。一年一度的天安门守夜活动让人们牢牢记住了1989年北京支持改革的抗议活动以及镇压抗议活动的大屠杀。它与澳门一样，是中国唯一可以公开纪念这一周年并保存真相的地方。但2019年香港起义的镇压摧毁了该地区曾经享有的自由。那一年的守夜活动是最后一次。周五，组织这次纪念活动的香港联盟的两名领导人根据严厉的国家安全法被判犯有煽动颠覆罪。 69 岁的李卓人和 41 岁的周恒东将面临最高 10 年的监禁。您对本文提出的问题有什么看法吗？如果您想通过电子邮件提交最多 300 字的回复，以便考虑在我们的信件部分发布，请单击此处。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The conviction of two Hong Kong activists for organizing a Tiananmen vigil highlights the silencing of memory and dissent. Proverbs 31:8 calls us to "speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves," a principle embodied by those who sought to keep the truth of 1989 alive. As freedoms are crushed in Hong Kong, this story reminds us of the moral...
reflection.zh: 两名香港社运人士因组织天安门守夜活动而被定罪，这凸显了记忆和异议被压制的情况。箴言31:8呼吁我们“为不能自辩的人开口”，这正是那些努力让1989年真相得以存留的人所体现的原则。随着香港自由的被扼杀，这个故事提醒我们，其他人有道德义务为那些被噤声的人发声。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.zh: “她不害怕任何人”：香港最后一位直言不讳的民主活动人士的监狱著作

summary.en: Chow Hang-tung has been detained since 2021, and written about everything from clothes to Tiananmen Square and the meaning of freedom Tiananmen Square vigil organisers in Hong Kong found guilty of ‘inciting subversion’ In one essay written from prison, Chow Hang-tung worries...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Chow Hang-tung has been detained since 2021, and written about everything from clothes to Tiananmen Square and the meaning of freedom Tiananmen Square vigil organisers in Hong Kong found guilty of ‘inciting subversion’ In one essay written from prison, Chow Hang-tung worries about her hairstyle before court appearances because there are no combs or mirrors in her cell. “In a place like prison, where anything that is personal is stripped away, it’s even more important to hold on to every means by which you can express yourself,” she writes. “Don’t let uniform, depersonalised rules, dress codes, schedules, and behavioural requirements grind down your edges and mould you into a ‘model citizen’”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 周恒东自 2021 年以来一直被拘留，并撰写了从服装到天安门广场以及自由的意义等各种内容。香港天安门广场守夜活动组织者被判犯有“煽动颠覆罪”。在一篇在狱中写的文章中，周恒东对自己出庭前的发型感到担忧，因为她的牢房里没有梳子或镜子。 “在监狱这样的地方，任何个人的东西都被剥夺了，更重要的是要坚持一切可以表达自己的方式，”她写道。 “不要让统一的、非个性化的规则、着装规范、时间表和行为要求磨掉你的棱角，把你塑造成‘模范公民’”。继续阅读...

reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到领导、智慧与公共责任。Proverbs 11:14提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以智慧、正直与服事来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

summary.en: Researchers have discovered that Western Australia’s iron-rich rocks can naturally generate hydrogen and that the process may be boosted to produce much larger amounts. If it can be scaled up, the vast formations beneath the Pilbara could become a major new source of...

body.en:
Researchers at Edith Cowan University (ECU) have identified a potentially important source of low-emission energy beneath Western Australia, where vast iron-rich formations may be capable of generating naturally occurring hydrogen.

The findings suggest that the region's geology could eventually support a new domestic energy source and, if developed at scale, a major hydrogen export industry.

The research focuses on magnetite, a mineral that is abundant in Western Australia's huge iron ore deposits across the Pilbara region.

Scientists from ECU's School of Engineering found that magnetite can release hydrogen gas when it reacts with hot water under conditions similar to those deep below the Earth's surface.

The team also discovered a way to stimulate the process. By injecting a solution into banded iron formations, the researchers were able to increase hydrogen generation, raising the possibility that naturally produced hydrogen could one day be deliberately enhanced underground.

"Australia could be sitting on a massive, untapped energy reserve -- and the potential is enormous," Associate Professor Alireza Keshavarz said.

"There is enough hydrogen for Australia to benefit for generations, and potentially enough for us to become a major exporter of clean energy to the rest of the world."

To investigate how the process works, the researchers placed magnetite samples in water at 200°C under high pressure for 60 days. Those conditions were designed to reproduce the hot, pressurized environment found deep underground.

The experiments gave researchers a clearer picture of how natural hydrogen can form within rock and what conditions are needed for production to continue over time.

The findings are especially significant for Western Australia because the region contains some of the largest banded iron formations on Earth.

"Western Australia has some of the world's largest banded iron formations. If we can unlock this resource at scale, it could be transformative for our energy future," lead author Kaveh Moghanirahimi said.

"We even see the potential for Western Australia to strengthen its energy independence during times of crisis through access to this naturally generated hydrogen."

Professor Stefan Iglauer, from ECU's School of Engineering, said the results bring researchers closer to understanding how hydrogen production might work in real underground rock formations rather than only in controlled laboratory settings.

"This work helps bridge the gap between laboratory experiments and real geological systems," Professor Iglauer said.

The study also found that the amount of magnetite alone does not determine how much hydrogen can be produced. The structure of the rock matters as well, particularly whether water can move through it and...
body.zh: 埃迪斯科文大学 (ECU) 的研究人员发现了西澳大利亚地下潜在的重要低排放能源来源，那里巨大的富铁地层可能能够自然产生氢气。 研究结果表明，该地区的地质最终可能支持新的国内能源，如果大规模发展，也可能支持主要的氢出口行业。 这项研究的重点是磁铁矿，这种矿物在西澳大利亚州皮尔巴拉地区的巨大铁矿床中储量丰富。 ECU工程学院的科学家发现，在类似于地球表面深处的条件下，磁铁矿与热水反应时可以释放氢气。 该团队还发现了一种刺激这一过程的方法。通过向带状铁地层中注入一种溶液，研究人员能够增加氢气的产生，从而提高了有一天可以在地下有意增强自然产生的氢气的可能性。 “澳大利亚可能拥有大量未开发的能源储备，而且潜力巨大，”副教授阿利雷扎·凯沙瓦兹 (Alireza Keshavarz) 说。 “澳大利亚有足够的氢气让几代人受益，并且有可能足以让我们成为世界其他地区清洁能源的主要出口国。” 为了研究该过程的工作原理，研究人员将磁铁矿样品放入 200°C 的高压水中 60 天。这些条件旨在重现地下深处的炎热、加压环境。 这些实验让研究人员更清楚地了解天然氢如何在岩石中形成，以及随着时间的推移持续生产需要什么条件。 这些发现对于西澳大利亚州尤其重要，因为该地区拥有地球上一些最大的带状铁矿层。 主要作者 Kaveh Moghanirahimi 表示：“西澳大利亚州拥有一些世界上最大的带状铁矿地层。如果我们能够大规模开发这种资源，它可能会改变我们的能源未来。” “我们甚至看到西澳大利亚州在危机时期通过使用这种自然产生的氢来加强其能源独立性的潜力。” ECU 工程学院的斯特凡·伊格劳尔 (Stefan Iglauer) 教授表示，这些结果使研究人员更加了解氢气生产如何在真正的地下岩层中进行，而不仅仅是在受控的实验室环境中进行。 “这项工作有助于弥合实验室实验和真实地质系统之间的差距，”伊格劳尔教授说。 研究还发现，磁铁矿的数量本身并不能决定可以产生多少氢气。岩石的结构也很重要，特别是水是否可以穿过它以及......

title.en: How the weather in space can affect us on Earth - and the team trying to protect us
title.zh: 太空天气如何影响地球：致力于保护我们的科研团队

summary.en: The Met Office and Aberystwyth University are collaborating to monitor solar flares and space weather, which can disrupt essential technologies like GPS and power grids. A dedicated team operates 24/7 to provide forecasts that help protect Earth's infrastructure from these cosmic disturbances.
summary.zh: 英国气象局与阿伯里斯特威斯大学正合作监测太阳耀斑和太空天气，这些现象可能会干扰全球定位系统（GPS）和电网等关键技术。一个专门的团队全天候运作，提供预报以保护地球基础设施免受这些宇宙干扰的影响。

body.en:
At the Met Office headquarters, the screens in one corner of the control centre are focussed on close up imagery of the Sun.

It is here that a space weather prediction team, one of only a small number worldwide, operates 24-hours a day, 365 days a year.

The weather in space has the potential to impact our lives here on Earth in a fundamental way. GPS, power grids and satellites are some of the vital technologies vulnerable to changes in the earth's magnetic field.

As a result, the Met Office has turned to Aberystwyth University researchers to help them improve their space weather forecasting abilities.

Space weather is mostly driven by activity on the Sun. Examples include solar flares, which are intense bursts of radiation.

The UK government has included severe space weather in its National Risk Register.

A 2025 estimate by Lloyds , external found that a severe space weather event could cost the world economy 2.4 trillion dollars ($2,400,000,000,000) over a five year period.

The Met Office has been working with key infrastructure operators since 2014 to try to keep us safe from those impacts, by producing forecasts using equipment on earth and satellites out in space.

Richard Stone, from the space forecasting team, said it allowed them "to diagnose anything that's happening on the Sun's surface, provide a forecast and alert the relevant users to be able to take mitigating actions".

Stone said the available technology was incredibly impressive, but still at an early stage.

"We've made great strides since 2014, but observations are still limited," he said.

Despite spotting an event on the Sun's surface around three days before it reaches Earth, there are no more sightings until it reaches satellites about one million miles away.

This gives scientists around one hour to more precisely predict its real effect on Earth and, if needed, warn partners of the mitigation needed to avoid disruption.

"It's like seeing a storm on the east coast of America and then not having any observations until it gets to Ireland," said Stone.

The agency has turned to a group of researchers, led by Aberystwyth University, to improve its forecasting abilities.

The project is being led by Professor Huw Morgan, who is Head of Space Physics at Aberystwyth University, working alongside Northumbria, Durham and Reading universities.

"This pre-warning is a huge mitigation of the danger posed by space weather," said Morgan.

"For example, it gives the National Grid an opportunity to prepare and avoid power cuts, or airlines can divert their flights from high latitude to safer lower latitudes.

"Compared to forecasting normal weather on Earth, space weather forecasting is really quite a developing field. I mean, it's yet to mature where we can give exact...
body.zh: 在英国气象局总部，控制中心一角的屏幕集中显示太阳的特写图像。 正是在这里，一个太空天气预报团队每年 365 天、每天 24 小时不间断地工作，是全球仅有的少数几个团队之一。 太空天气有可能从根本上影响我们在地球上的生活。 GPS、电网和卫星是一些容易受到地球磁场变化影响的重要技术。 因此，英国气象局求助于阿伯里斯特威斯大学的研究人员，帮助他们提高太空天气预报能力。 太空天气主要是由太阳活动驱动的。例子包括太阳耀斑，它是强烈的辐射爆发。 英国政府已将恶劣的太空天气纳入其国家风险登记册。 劳埃德银行 (Lloyds) 对 2025 年的预测显示，严重的太空天气事件可能会在五年内给世界经济造成 2.4 万亿美元（2,400,000,000,000 美元）的损失。 自 2014 年以来，英国气象局一直与主要基础设施运营商合作，通过使用地球上的设备和太空卫星进行预测，努力保护我们免受这些影响。 太空预测团队的理查德·斯通表示，这使他们能够“诊断太阳表面发生的任何情况，提供预测并提醒相关用户采取缓解措施”。 斯通表示，现有技术令人印象深刻，但仍处于早期阶段。 “自 2014 年以来，我们取得了长足进步，但观察结果仍然有限，”他说。 尽管在太阳到达地球前三天左右在太阳表面发现了一个事件，但直到它到达大约一百万英里外的卫星之前，没有更多的目击事件。 这让科学家们大约有一小时的时间来更准确地预测其对地球的实际影响，并在需要时警告合作伙伴需要采取哪些缓解措施以避免破坏。 “这就像在美国东海岸看到一场风暴，然后直到它到达爱尔兰才进行任何观测，”斯通说。 该机构已向阿伯里斯特威斯大学领导的一组研究人员寻求帮助，以提高其预测能力。 该项目由阿伯里斯特威斯大学空间物理学系主任休·摩根教授领导，与诺森比亚大学、达勒姆大学和雷丁大学合作。 摩根说：“这一预警极大地减轻了太空天气造成的危险。” “例如，它使国家电网有机会做好准备并避免断电，或者航空公司可以将航班从高纬度地区转移到更安全的低纬度地区。 “与预测地球上的正常天气相比，太空天气预报确实是一个相当发展的领域。我的意思是，它还没有成熟，我们可以给出准确的......

reflection.en: While we often focus on the weather at our feet, this collaboration reminds us that our modern life depends on the invisible stability of the heavens. By studying solar flares and magnetic fields, these researchers exercise a form of stewardship that anticipates risks before they strike. It is a reminder that Yahweh has given us the capacity to observe the...
reflection.zh: 虽然我们通常只关注地面的天气，但这项合作提醒我们，现代生活依赖于诸天之上那看不见的稳定性。通过研究太阳耀斑和磁场，这些研究人员履行了一种管家的职责，在风险发生前进行预判。这提醒我们，雅伟赋予了我们观察天空征兆的能力，以保护我们每天赖以生存的脆弱系统。

title.en: Your sleep may be hiding an early clue to Alzheimer’s
title.zh: 你的睡眠可能隐藏着阿尔茨海默病的早期线索

summary.en: Frequent micro-awakenings during sleep were linked to higher genetic risk for Alzheimer’s in healthy middle-aged adults who had no symptoms. The discovery raises the possibility that subtle changes during sleep could offer an early warning signal years before memory problems...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Could subtle changes during sleep reveal vulnerability to Alzheimer's disease years before memory problems become noticeable? Researchers at ULiège, supported by the Stop Alzheimer's Foundation, are investigating whether the sleeping brain may contain early clues.

Scientists from the University of Liège (GIGA Neurosciences) examined sleep patterns in more than 500 healthy people. Among participants in middle age, more frequent nighttime micro awakenings were associated with a higher genetic risk of developing Alzheimer's disease. That relationship was not detected among younger adults.

The findings, published in the journal Sleep , raise the possibility that sleep measurements could eventually help researchers identify people who may be more vulnerable to Alzheimer's before symptoms develop.

Researchers have spent years investigating connections between disturbed sleep and neurodegenerative diseases. The University of Liège study adds another piece to that research by suggesting that the relationship between sleep and Alzheimer's risk may begin well before recognizable symptoms emerge.

Because genetics play a partial role in Alzheimer's disease (Alzheimer's disease is neither purely hereditary nor entirely independent of genes), the researchers calculated a polygenic risk (i.e., summarizing the combined influence of your genes on your probability of developing a given disease in a single figure) for more than 500 healthy participants.

Most were young adults (aged 18 to 31), while the study also included an older group (aged 50 to 69). Importantly, the polygenic risk measured in the study remained low and cannot determine whether any particular person will eventually develop Alzheimer's disease.

The researchers then compared these genetic risk estimates with different characteristics of each participant's sleep.

The analysis revealed an association between genetic risk for Alzheimer's disease and the frequency of nighttime micro awakenings. These are very brief bursts of brain activity that can interrupt the normal sleep cycle without causing someone to become fully awake.

Among the younger participants, researchers found no connection between these micro awakenings and Alzheimer's genetic risk. A different pattern appeared in the older group. Participants who experienced more frequent micro awakenings also tended to have higher genetic risk, despite being healthy, relatively young and free of Alzheimer's symptoms.

"These micro-awakenings are therefore not insignificant," emphasizes Puneet Talwar, a researcher at the GIGA ULiège laboratory, "certain profiles could promote the accumulation of proteins involved in Alzheimer's disease and be associated with increased vulnerability."

body.zh: 睡眠期间的细微变化能否在记忆问题变得明显之前几年揭示出阿尔茨海默病的脆弱性？列日大学的研究人员在阻止阿尔茨海默病基金会的支持下，正在研究睡眠中的大脑是否可能包含早期线索。 列日大学 (GIGA Neurosciences) 的科学家检查了 500 多名健康人的睡眠模式。在中年参与者中，更频繁的夜间微觉醒与患阿尔茨海默病的遗传风险更高有关。在年轻人中没有发现这种关系。 这项发表在《睡眠》杂志上的研究结果提出了一种可能性，即睡眠测量最终可以帮助研究人员在症状出现之前识别出可能更容易患阿尔茨海默病的人。 研究人员花了数年时间研究睡眠障碍与神经退行性疾病之间的联系。列日大学的研究为该研究增添了另一项内容，表明睡眠与阿尔茨海默氏症风险之间的关系可能早在可识别症状出现之前就开始了。 由于遗传学在阿尔茨海默氏病中发挥部分作用（阿尔茨海默氏病既不是纯粹的遗传性，也不是完全独立于基因），研究人员计算了 500 多名健康参与者的多基因风险（即将基因对患某种特定疾病的概率的综合影响总结为一个数字）。 大多数是年轻人（18 至 31 岁），而该研究还包括老年群体（50 至 69 岁）。重要的是，该研究中测量的多基因风险仍然很低，无法确定任何特定的人最终是否会患上阿尔茨海默病。 研究人员随后将这些遗传风险估计值与每个参与者睡眠的不同特征进行了比较。 分析揭示了阿尔茨海默病的遗传风险与夜间微醒的频率之间存在关联。这些是非常短暂的大脑活动爆发，可能会中断正常的睡眠周期，但不会导致人完全清醒。 在年轻的参与者中，研究人员发现这些微觉醒与阿尔茨海默氏症的遗传风险之间没有联系。老年群体中出现了不同的模式。经历更频繁的微觉醒的参与者也往往有更高的遗传风险，尽管他们健康、相对年轻并且没有阿尔茨海默氏症症状。 GIGA ULiège 实验室的研究员 Puneet Talwar 强调说：“因此，这些微觉醒并非无关紧要，某些特征可能会促进与阿尔茨海默病相关的蛋白质的积累，并与脆弱性增加有关。” 研究人员还检查了...

title.en: Scientists discover why damaged nerves struggle to heal
title.zh: 科学家发现受损神经难以愈合的原因

summary.en: Scientists have identified a protein that acts like a brake on the nervous system’s ability to repair damaged connections. Blocking AHR helped injured nerve fibers regrow and improved movement and sensation in mice with nerve or spinal cord injuries. The discovery could...
summary.zh: 科学家们发现了一种蛋白质，它就像神经系统修复受损连接能力的“刹车”。阻断AHR有助于受损神经纤维再生，并改善了患有神经或脊髓损伤小鼠的运动和感觉。这一发现可能……

body.en:
Researchers at the Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai have identified a molecular mechanism that appears to restrict the ability of injured neurons to regrow damaged axons. The findings, published in the journal Nature , suggest that blocking a protein known as the aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AHR) could promote nerve regeneration and improve recovery after damage to peripheral nerves or the spinal cord.

Axons are long extensions of nerve cells, or neurons, that transmit signals throughout both the central and peripheral nervous systems. These fibers are essential for communication between nerve cells. When axons are damaged or severed, recovery depends heavily on whether neurons can rebuild those connections.

In adult mammals, however, neurons have only a limited capacity to regenerate their axons. As a result, injuries involving nerves or the spinal cord can cause long-lasting or permanent problems with movement and sensation. Understanding what prevents stronger regrowth has been a major challenge for researchers.

The new research points to AHR as an important regulator of how neurons respond to injury.

"When neurons are injured, they must deal with stress while also trying to regrow their axons," said Hongyan Zou, MD, PhD, Professor of Neurosurgery, and Neuroscience, at the Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai and the study's senior author. "We discovered that AHR functions like a brake that shifts neurons toward managing stress rather than rebuilding damaged connections."

Researchers found that active AHR signaling suppresses axon growth. When they removed AHR from neurons or used drugs to block its activity, damaged axonal fibers regenerated more successfully. In mouse models involving peripheral nerve damage and spinal cord injury, suppressing AHR also led to better recovery of movement and sensation.

Additional experiments helped explain why AHR has this effect. Following an injury, the protein supports a protective response that helps neurons maintain protein quality control -- a process known as proteostasis. This system helps injured neurons withstand cellular stress, but it also limits the production of new proteins required for rebuilding axons.

Without active AHR, neurons appear to change priorities. They increase the production of new proteins and turn on biological pathways associated with growth and axon regeneration. The researchers found that this response also relies on another factor called HIF-1α, which helps control genes involved in metabolism and tissue repair.

"This discovery shows that neurons use AHR to balance survival and regeneration," Dr. Zou explained. "By releasing this brake, we can push neurons into a state that favors repair."

body.zh: 西奈山伊坎医学院的研究人员发现了一种分子机制，该机制似乎可以限制受损神经元再生受损轴突的能力。发表在《自然》杂志上的研究结果表明，阻断一种被称为芳基碳氢化合物受体（AHR）的蛋白质可以促进神经再生并改善周围神经或脊髓损伤后的恢复。 轴突是神经细胞或神经元的长延伸，在中枢和周围神经系统中传递信号。这些纤维对于神经细胞之间的通讯至关重要。当轴突受损或切断时，恢复在很大程度上取决于神经元是否能够重建这些连接。 然而，在成年哺乳动物中，神经元再生轴突的能力有限。因此，涉及神经或脊髓的损伤可能会导致长期或永久性的运动和感觉问题。了解是什么阻碍了更强的再生一直是研究人员面临的重大挑战。 新研究指出 AHR 是神经元如何应对损伤的重要调节因子。 “当神经元受伤时，它们必须应对压力，同时努力使轴突再生，”西奈山伊坎医学院神经外科和神经科学教授、该研究的资深作者 Hongyan Zou 博士说。 “我们发现 AHR 的功能就像刹车一样，使神经元转向管理压力，而不是重建受损的连接。” 研究人员发现，活跃的 AHR 信号传导会抑制轴突生长。当他们从神经元中去除 AHR 或使用药物阻断其活性时，受损的轴突纤维再生得更成功。在涉及周围神经损伤和脊髓损伤的小鼠模型中，抑制 AHR 也能更好地恢复运动和感觉。 其他实验有助于解释为什么 AHR 具有这种效果。受伤后，该蛋白质支持保护性反应，帮助神经元维持蛋白质质量控​​制——这一过程称为蛋白质稳态。该系统帮助受伤的神经元承受细胞压力，但它也限制了重建轴突所需的新蛋白质的产生。 如果没有主动的 AHR，神经元似乎会改变优先级。它们增加新蛋白质的产生并开启与生长和轴突再生相关的生物途径。研究人员发现，这种反应还依赖于另一种称为 HIF-1α 的因子，它有助于控制参与新陈代谢和组织修复的基因。 “这一发现表明神经元利用 AHR 来平衡生存和再生，”Zou 博士解释道。 “通过释放这种刹车，我们可以将神经元推入有利于修复的状态。” AHR 首次被识别是因为它能够检测...

title.en: Many cities buried urban streams. Here's how to bring them back
title.zh: 许多城市掩埋了城市河流。以下是如何将它们带回来

summary.en: As many cities developed, streams that once flowed on the surface were buried underground to make way for growing infrastructure. However, as heavier rainfall, extreme weather and aging infrastructure place growing pressure on cities, these buried streams could become part of...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及管家责任、供应与公共福祉。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

As many cities developed, streams that once flowed on the surface were buried underground to make way for growing infrastructure. However, as heavier rainfall, extreme weather and aging infrastructure place growing pressure on cities, these buried streams could become part of the solution.

Restoring streams to the surface—a practice known as stream daylighting—can help manage stormwater, restore habitats and create greener, more walkable public spaces. But recognizing these benefits is easier than delivering a successful project.

Municipalities must find feasible sites, coordinate across departments, secure funding and plan for long-term maintenance. But they must also ensure that environmental improvements benefit existing residents rather than contribute to displacement.

My research on stream daylighting compares two contrasting approaches in Seoul, South Korea, and Zürich, Switzerland. The findings suggest that municipalities don't need to choose between a single large project and many small interventions. They need flexible programs that can identify the right approach for each site and apply lessons from one project to the next.

Between 2003 and 2005, Seoul restored the Cheonggyecheon stream through a rapid, centralized and costly project along one major downtown corridor. The city removed an elevated highway and integrated the restored stream with public transit, cycling infrastructure, pedestrian bridges, walkways and public spaces.

The example shows what stream daylighting can accomplish when political leadership, infrastructure renewal and major public investment align. It also exposes the risks associated with large flagship projects. The project required substantial capital investment and continues to incur maintenance costs.

Critics have questioned its ecological integrity because pumps supply water to the channel . Redevelopment around the corridor also increased land values and displaced some smaller businesses.

Zürich's Bachkonzept , or stream concept, took a different approach. The city began with pilot projects in the 1980s and restored numerous smaller stream segments over several decades.

Zürich linked the projects to sewer management, infrastructure renewal, ecological restoration and neighborhood planning. Daylighted streams now pass through residential areas, parks and public spaces. Paths, small bridges, seating, playgrounds and recreational areas accompany many of them.

No single project in Zürich has the public profile of Seoul's Cheonggyecheon. Together, however, the projects form a distributed network that improves watershed function,...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 随着许多城市的发展，曾经流过地表的溪流被埋在地下，为不断发展的基础设施让路。然而，随着强降雨、极端天气和老化的基础设施给城市带来越来越大的压力，这些埋藏的溪流可能成为解决方案的一部分。 将溪流恢复到地表（一种称为溪流采光的做法）可以帮助管理雨水、恢复栖息地并创造更绿色、更适合步行的公共空间。但认识到这些好处比交付一个成功的项目更容易。 市政当局必须找到可行的地点，跨部门协调，确保资金并制定长期维护计划。但他们还必须确保环境改善有利于现有居民，而不是造成流离失所。 我对河流采光的研究比较了韩国首尔和瑞士苏黎世的两种截然不同的方法。研究结果表明，市政当局不需要在单个大型项目和许多小型干预措施之间进行选择。他们需要灵活的计划，能够为每个地点确定正确的方法，并将一个项目的经验教训应用到下一个项目。 2003 年至 2005 年间，首尔通过一项沿着市中心主要走廊的快速、集中且耗资巨大的项目恢复了清溪川。该市拆除了一条高架高速公路，并将修复后的河流与公共交通、自行车基础设施、人行天桥、人行道和公共空间融为一体。 这个例子展示了当政治领导、基础设施更新和主要公共投资一致时，溪流采光可以实现什么目标。它还暴露了与大型旗舰项目相关的风险。该项目需要大量资本投资，并持续产生维护成本。 批评者质疑其生态完整性，因为水泵向河道供水。走廊周围的重建也增加了土地价值并取代了一些小型企业。 苏黎世的 Bachkonzept 或流概念采取了不同的方法。该市于 20 世纪 80 年代开始试点项目，并在几十年内恢复了许多较小的河段。 苏黎世将这些项目与下水道管理、基础设施更新、生态恢复和社区规划联系起来。白天的溪流现在流经住宅区、公园和公共场所。其中许多都配有小路、小桥、座位、游乐场和休闲区。 苏黎世没有一个项目具有首尔清溪川的公众形象。然而，这些项目共同形成了一个分布式网络，可以改善流域功能……

title.en: Rethinking bluegreen aphid control as insecticide resistance spreads
title.zh: 随着杀虫剂耐药性的蔓延，重新思考蓝绿蚜虫的控制

summary.en: When an insecticide application fails to control bluegreen aphid, application conditions may not be the only cause. Research has identified resistant populations across southern Australia, confirming that repeated reliance on broad-spectrum insecticides is no longer sustainable.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

When an insecticide application fails to control bluegreen aphid, application conditions may not be the only cause. Research has identified resistant populations across southern Australia, confirming that repeated reliance on broad-spectrum insecticides is no longer sustainable.

Bluegreen aphid (BGA) affects alfalfa, medic, clover and pulse crops through feeding damage and virus transmission. Populations can increase rapidly, completing a generation in around 10 days under favorable conditions.

Following the first confirmation of insecticide resistance in BGA in 2021–22, research conducted from 2022 to 2025 investigated its distribution and potential alternative controls. BGA populations were collected from pasture, pasture seed and pulse crops across South Australia, Victoria and southern New South Wales, particularly where control failures had been reported. Laboratory bioassays compared these populations with insecticide-susceptible BGA.

The research identified another 21 populations resistant to one or more organophosphate, carbamate or synthetic pyrethroid insecticides. Resistant populations were found from the Eyre Peninsula to near Tamworth and across several parts of Victoria.

Resistance was particularly common in alfalfa but was also detected in lentil crops on the Yorke Peninsula and in Victoria's Wimmera and Mallee regions. Resistance to organophosphates and synthetic pyrethroids was generally more common and stronger than resistance to pirimicarb.

The project tested flupyradifurone, sulfoxaflor and flonicamid against resistant and susceptible BGA. No field-evolved resistance or cross-resistance to these active ingredients was detected, indicating that they may offer alternative control options. Registrations and permits differ between products and crops and may change.

Growers must check current Australian Pesticides and Veterinary Medicines Authority requirements and follow label directions before use.

Researchers also identified 132 parasitoid wasps collected from 25 locations across South Australia, New South Wales and Victoria. Every specimen was Aphidius ervi, suggesting that natural control of BGA may depend heavily on this species. Aphidius ervi develops inside aphids and eventually kills them.

While it is commercially available in Australia, further research is needed to determine whether targeted releases would be effective and economical in broadacre systems. In the meantime, avoiding unnecessary broad-spectrum insecticide applications can help protect existing parasitoid populations and other beneficial insects.

title.en: Strong winds and thunderstorms kick off the bank holiday weekend
title.zh: 强风和雷暴拉开了银行假日周末的序幕

summary.en: Cooler and showery conditions will continue across the weekend and into Monday, bringing a record-breaking summer to a rather damp close as Matt Taylor explains.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
After weeks of scorching heat and drought the summer's swan song is set to be one of frequent downpours as well as gales for some.

Areas of heavy rain and showers are expected to sweep across parts of the UK on each day of the weekend, which is a bank holiday for many.

This could make for some soggy moments at many of the festivals taking place over the coming days.

Strong winds and gales may also cause problems for travellers and holidaymakers in southern parts of the UK.

Let us start with the good news - for many of us it won't be a complete washout of a weekend. It is certainly worth looking deeper into your weather app forecasts to see the hourly breakdown as showers can sometimes be tricky to forecast .

Most areas will still see some drier and sunnier moments through the three days, with parts of north and west Scotland perhaps seeing very little rainfall at all. During the sunnier spells the late August sunshine still has enough strength to make it feels reasonably warm too.

However, on Saturday the forecast shows several zones of heavy showers sweeping across England and Wales especially. Like recent days some of these could be torrential and thundery, especially in the southern half of England and Wales. For northern parts of England the showers are likely to merge into longer spells of rain during the afternoon.

Given the downpours already this week, some parts of the Midlands and northern England are more susceptible to the risk of flash flooding.

Sunday may start dry and bright for many, perhaps with some mist and fog patches in central and northern areas of the UK.

It is northern parts this time where there may be some early showers, but through the afternoon another zone of heavy and thundery showers are expected to sweep across the country from the west. For some in East Anglia and south-east England it may stay dry until late in the day.

South-eastern parts of the UK might get lucky again on bank holiday Monday. Scattered showers in the west during the morning will gradually develop more widely through the day, but these shouldn't be as intense as those on the previous two days.

If bouts of rain wasn't enough, parts of southern England and Wales will be buffeted by strong winds at times too. This may make travel and camping a challenge at times.

The strongest winds of the weekend are expected on Saturday across southern counties of England and Wales as well as the Channel Islands. Some hills and coasts could experience gusts of 40 to 50mph.

Monday will be a blustery day more widely across the UK, but again it will be southern areas seeing the strongest gusts - generally 30-40mph.

This will make for a cooler feeling spell of weather at times. Throughout the weekend temperatures across the UK will be around 15 to 22...
body.zh: 经过数周的酷暑和干旱后，夏季的绝唱将是频繁的倾盆大雨和大风。 预计周末每天都会有大雨和阵雨席卷英国部分地区，周末对许多人来说是银行假日。 这可能会在未来几天举行的许多节日中造成一些潮湿的时刻。 强风和大风也可能给英国南部地区的旅行者和度假者带来问题。 让我们从好消息开始——对我们许多人来说，这不会是一个彻底的周末。当然值得更深入地查看天气应用程序的天气预报，以了解每小时的细分情况，因为阵雨有时很难预测。 在这三天里，大多数地区仍会出现一些干燥和阳光明媚的时刻，苏格兰北部和西部的部分地区可能降雨量很少。在阳光明媚的时期，八月下旬的阳光仍然有足够的强度，让人感觉相当温暖。 然而，周六的天气预报显示，英格兰和威尔士的几个地区将有大阵雨。与最近几天一样，其中一些可能会出现暴雨和雷雨，特别是在英格兰和威尔士的南半部。对于英格兰北部地区，下午阵雨可能会合并为较长时间的降雨。 鉴于本周已经下了暴雨，中部地区和英格兰北部的部分地区更容易遭受山洪爆发的风险。 对于许多人来说，周日可能会开始干燥而明亮，英国中部和北部地区可能会出现一些薄雾和大雾。 此次北部地区可能会出现一些早期阵雨，但整个下午预计另一场强阵雨将从西部席卷全国。对于东安格利亚和英格兰东南部的一些地区来说，天气可能会一直干燥到傍晚。 英国东南部地区周一银行假日可能会再次走运。西部早上的零星阵雨将在一天中逐渐扩大，但不会像前两天那么强烈。 如果阵阵降雨还不够，英格兰南部和威尔士的部分地区有时也会受到强风的袭击。这有时可能使旅行和露营成为挑战。 预计周六将出现周末最强风，席卷英格兰和威尔士南部各县以及海峡群岛。一些山丘和海岸可能会遇到时速 40 至 50 英里的阵风。 周一英国各地将迎来大风天气，但南部地区的阵风将再次最强，风速一般为 30-40 英里/小时。 这有时会让人感觉天气凉爽。整个周末英国气温将在 15 至 22 左右...

title.en: The race to stop England running out of water
title.zh: 阻止英格兰缺水的竞赛

summary.en: Who is to blame for the summer drought, and can England future-proof its water supplies?
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及受造之物关怀与环保责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
It was from his local water board and it read: "River levels are low but have recovered enough to allow one night of irrigation tonight."

Like much of the lower half of England, Daniel's fourth-generation farm had seen barely any rain in nearly three months.

He shows us what is left of the peas and wheat crop at his 300-hectare site in Suffolk.

"There's no water in the river so half my crop is completely and utterly ruined."

With river levels falling so low that taking any more water out of them risked endangering wildlife, in July the Environment Agency (EA) temporarily stopped Daniel and thousands of other farmers from watering their crops from the river.

The kind of increasingly frequent heatwaves we have experienced and greatly reduced rainfall that we could see over successive summers with climate change, plus a projected increase in demand for water, have raised the prospect that England could at some point run out of water.

The result could be that by 2055 England will face a shortfall of five billion litres in public water supply a day, almost enough to fill Wembley Stadium four and a half times daily. A mixture of low rainfall, high temperatures and demand put pressure on water supply in England more so than elsewhere in the UK.

It is all a far cry from when, in 1818, John Keats wrote: "It is impossible to live in a country which is continually under hatches… Rain! Rain! Rain!"

But what is really to blame for England finding its water supply so under threat? And are there ways of securing its future?

Back in the 1980s, people in England and Denmark were using water at a similar rate. But no longer.

Residents in Denmark now consume 97 litres of water per person per day, according to Danva, the country's water and wastewater industry body. The daily consumption per person in England is 136.5 litres.

"We've actually doubled the amount of water we use per person, on average, in the last 50, 60 years," points out Nicci Russell, who runs Waterwise, a water efficiency campaign organisation.

She points to changing habits over generations - from a family having a shared bath once a week to having multiple showers a week, sometimes a day.

Households are responsible for nearly 60% of water use in England and Wales. If we had domestic water consumption patterns more like Denmark, Russell says, more than half the 2055 shortfall would be wiped out.

Russell says, even with projected population growth, if everyone in England knocked a minute off their shower time, for example, it would save nearly one billion litres of water a day by 2050.

But water companies have been running campaigns urging us to use less water, seemingly with limited success.

title.en: How AI‑powered policing is endangering the public's trust in police
title.zh: 人工智能警务如何危及公众对警察的信任

summary.en: Since the release of ChatGPT in 2022, artificial intelligence (AI) has dominated the cultural landscape. Uptake across various sectors, including law enforcement, quickly followed, usually with minimal foresight and little to no guardrails, like effective policies or laws, to...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Since the release of ChatGPT in 2022, artificial intelligence (AI) has dominated the cultural landscape. Uptake across various sectors, including law enforcement , quickly followed, usually with minimal foresight and little to no guardrails, like effective policies or laws, to govern AI use.

The largely unregulated use of AI in law enforcement is deeply concerning; it jeopardizes police legitimacy and could compromise the integrity of the justice system because it means the public cannot trust that evidence used by police is not compromised by AI .

Procedural justice, or the perception of fairness, is key to police legitimacy. It's maintained through both unbiased law enforcement practices and the sharing of accurate information with the public and courts.

It's well documented that AI programming is rife with bias and distortions of information. Evidence even suggests that AI bias can be " worse than reality ."

While debates about bias and problems with AI are ongoing, it's clear that the selective use of AI by police is inherently biased and must therefore immediately cease.

Police use of technology to manipulate evidence is developing into a standardized practice in law enforcement, due primarily to how easy it is for anyone to use AI.

In June, for example, a frontline senior detective in the United Kingdom improperly used AI to "create evidential material in a number of cases." Police in the United States and Canada , meanwhile, have officially published AI-generated images of drug seizures.

The continued integration of AI into facial recognition and surveillance technologies has also raised concerns over the dangers of misidentification . AI is known to be more likely to be wrong than correct in identifying images of women and people with darker skin tones .

Earlier this year, police in North Dakota used AI facial recognition to misidentify a Tennessee grandmother in connection with crimes she didn't commit; as a result, she was held in custody for more than five months.

In Maryland late last year, an officer drew a gun on an unsuspecting teenager because an AI-driven high school surveillance system had misidentified a bag of chips as a possible firearm.

These cases, among others, illustrate the dangers of AI use in law enforcement. Despite the known risks, police agencies have inexplicably forged ahead with this fundamentally flawed technology.

body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 自 2022 年 ChatGPT 发布以来，人工智能 (AI) 一直主导着文化景观。包括执法部门在内的各个部门很快就开始采用，但通常缺乏远见，几乎没有任何护栏（例如有效的政策或法律）来管理人工智能的使用。 人工智能在执法中的使用基本上不受监管，这一点令人深感担忧；它危及警察的合法性，并可能损害司法系统的完整性，因为这意味着公众不能相信警察使用的证据不会受到人工智能的损害。 程序正义，或者说公平感，是警察合法性的关键。它是通过公正的执法实践以及与公众和法院共享准确信息来维持的。 有充分证据表明，人工智能编程充满了偏见和信息扭曲。有证据甚至表明人工智能的偏见可能“比现实更糟糕”。 虽然关于人工智能的偏见和问题的争论仍在继续，但很明显，警察选择性使用人工智能本质上是有偏见的，因此必须立即停止。 警方利用技术操纵证据正在发展成为执法的标准化做法，这主要是因为任何人都可以轻松使用人工智能。 例如，今年 6 月，英国一名前线高级侦探不当使用人工智能“在多起案件中创建证据材料”。与此同时，美国和加拿大警方正式发布了人工智能生成的毒品缉获图像。 人工智能不断融入面部识别和监控技术也引起了人们对错误识别危险的担忧。众所周知，人工智能在识别女性和肤色较深的人的图像时，错误的可能性大于正确的可能性。 今年早些时候，北达科他州警方使用人工智能面部识别技术误认了一位田纳西州的祖母，因为她并没有犯下任何罪行；结果，她被关押了五个多月。 去年年底，在马里兰州，一名警官用枪指着一名毫无戒心的青少年，因为人工智能驱动的高中监控系统将一袋芯片误认为是可能的枪支。 这些案例说明了人工智能在执法中使用的危险。尽管存在已知的风险，警察机构却莫名其妙地继续使用这种存在根本缺陷的技术。 通过 Phys.org 获取每日见解的超过 100,000 名订阅者探索科学、技术和太空领域的最新动态。订阅我们的免费时事通讯并获取有关突破、创新和研究的最新信息……

Nyfors directs attention to people whose carbon footprint is already in line with...
summary.zh: 赫尔辛基大学博士生蒂娜·尼福斯（Tina Nyfors）研究了“充裕”（sufficiency）——一种既能保持在环境限度内，又能确保人们拥有足够的生活方式和组织社会原则。尼福斯特别关注那些碳足迹已符合充裕标准的人，称他们为“充裕阶层”。他们的生活方式对气候影响适中，同时仍能满足他们的需求。

body.en: Tina Nyfors, who recently defended her doctoral thesis at the University of Helsinki, studied sufficiency, a way of living and a principle for organizing society to stay within environmental limits while ensuring that people have enough. Nyfors directs attention to people whose carbon footprint is already in line with sufficiency and refers to them as the sufficiency class. Their way of life has a moderate climate impact yet still meets their needs.
body.zh: 蒂娜·尼福斯 (Tina Nyfors) 最近在赫尔辛基大学进行了博士论文答辩，她研究了充足性、一种生活方式以及组织社会在确保人们拥有充足资源的同时保持在环境限制范围内的原则。 Nyfors 将注意力集中在碳足迹已经达到充足水平的人群，并将他们称为充足类别。他们的生活方式对气候影响不大，但仍能满足他们的需求。

title.en: The discovery of the Great Barrier Reef's whale maternity ward
title.zh: 大堡礁鲸鱼产房的发现

summary.en: What began with a simple call to action 17 years ago has resulted in the Whitsundays region establishing world-class protection for migrating humpback whales. Tourism operators' observations of unusual whale behavior in 2009 led to scientific inquiry, culminating in this significant discovery.
summary.zh: 17年前，一个简单的行动呼吁开启了惠特桑迪地区为迁徙的座头鲸建立世界一流保护的历程。2009年，旅游经营者观察到座头鲸的异常行为，引发了科学研究，最终促成了这一重要发现。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

It started with a simple message: "This is the year to do something small for something huge." Now, 17 years later, the Whitsundays region has some of the best protection in the world for migrating humpback whales.

Sightings of unusual humpback whale behavior began to mount in 2009 as tourism operators in the Whitsundays reported observations of 'fluking' to the Reef Authority's Eye on the Reef network. Perplexed by what they were seeing, they reached out to scientists to understand the behavior.

What followed was a major research effort that ultimately led to the discovery of a globally important whale calving area in the Whitsundays.

Master Reef Guides Program Manager Crystal Lacey said the operators were reporting sightings of a behavior known as 'fluking,' in which whales float upside down with their tails raised above the water's surface.

"It was an unusual behavior they had never seen before. Not even the whale scientists knew what it meant at the time. So that uncertainty sparked a major research effort, which combined citizen science through the tourism operators' observations and scientific research.

"It was one of the region's largest citizen science efforts, recording whale sightings and calves through Eye on the Reef. Just in that one year, there were 780 adults and 153 calves sighted in the Whitsundays."

While tourism operators counted whales and calves, scientists mapped the seafloor, monitored water temperatures, tracked whales by satellite and surveyed the region from the air. Together, they gathered evidence that revealed the Whitsundays as one of the Great Barrier Reef's most important humpback whale calving areas.

"We discovered the Whitsundays provide the sheltered, warm and shallow waters humpback whales need to give birth and raise newborn calves."

The breakthrough solved one of the biggest mysteries surrounding humpback whales on the Great Barrier Reef—where they give birth. The discovery subsequently led to the establishment of the Whitsundays Whale Protection Area, where cetaceans are given higher levels of protection than in any other area of the Marine Park.

The Whale Protection Area strengthens the region's plan of management by setting rules for how people interact with whales. These include minimum approach distances for vessels and aircraft and a ban on swimming with whales. Breaches of these regulations are enforceable by law.
